<section id="HB14E8E4844374199AA2E46808C120EA3"><enum>346.</enum><header>Pilot program on optimization of aerial refueling and fuel management in contested logistics environments through use of artificial intelligence</header> 
<subsection id="H1810BC59AED84039909EE7A7E82C65B3"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Design of pilot program</header> 
<paragraph id="H6A13C5C70E8C4EF887D4C56DE8D5DCED"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Design</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer of the Department of Defense, in collaboration with the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment and the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, shall design a pilot program to optimize the logistics of aerial refueling and fuel management in the context of contested logistics environments through the use of advanced digital technologies and artificial intelligence (in this section referred to as the <quote>pilot program</quote>).</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H00BBD835061B4588BFEEEEB45B0BA92F"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Coordination and consultation</header><text>In designing the pilot program, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer shall—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H089AF0403E854C7A974730CCE3E607E7"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">coordinate with the Commander of the United States Transportation Command and the Commander of the United States Indo-Pacific Command regarding the activities to be carried out under the pilot program, to ensure the pilot program will align with existing operational requirements; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H883BBFAB038D436D9938E4903CC2D852"><enum>(B)</enum><text>seek to consult with relevant experts in the fields of artificial intelligence, logistics, aviation, and fuel management.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H00106729298849C79A7E51A2746A5E7A"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Objectives</header><text>The objectives of the pilot program shall include the following:</text> <paragraph id="H40BF317F7A9A4323A60CF4B8AD9D18B3"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Assessing the feasibility and effectiveness of artificial intelligence-driven approaches in enhancing aerial refueling operations and fuel management processes compared to existing mission planning processes executed by members of the Air Force with relevant training.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6572DD667CCF4ACBAE074481289C780E"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Identifying opportunities to reduce fuel consumption, decrease operational costs, and minimize the environmental impact of fuel management while maintaining military readiness.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4CDB710227A74E75997C8C4DDCC0600B"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Evaluating the interoperability and compatibility of artificial intelligence-enabled systems with the existing logistics infrastructure of the Department of Defense.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA0082C45912343A2BB58BE2165B214B4"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Enhancing situational awareness and decision-making capabilities through real-time data analysis and predictive modeling.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFEB6BE9F47D147938C2FA0421285CE85"><enum>(5)</enum><text>Addressing potential challenges and risks associated with the integration of artificial intelligence and other advanced digital technologies, including challenges and risks involving cybersecurity concerns.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H6BE45DF8509F4A88B5EB844844A08152"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Commencement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer, in collaboration with the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment and the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, shall commence the pilot program.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H1B9013F7465F4AD8A677A5E9E95D7F40"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the House of Representatives and the Senate a report on—</text> 
<paragraph id="H899E2DBE542240869943DDBD672E4446"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the design of the pilot program under subsection (a);</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H3E3164AB7E0442958F7F88F090E137E4"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the status of any efforts underway to commence the pilot program under subsection (c); and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC5F5972CFC584F32B02C6C3E5B19442C"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any planned future activities to be carried out under the pilot program to test expected outcomes regarding improved efficiencies or other benefits that may be derived from artificial intelligence-driven approaches to aerial refueling operations and fuel management.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HCDD6EC40ABD84E55B1D9A1F1B6ACFE5C"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Termination</header><text>The authority to conduct the pilot program under this section shall terminate on January 1, 2027.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H30A33322CA054145814B9375D7946E25" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>347.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation on availability of funds to expand leased facilities for Joint Military Information Support Operations Web Operations Center</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">None of the funds authorized to be appropriated by this Act or otherwise made available for fiscal year 2024 for Operation and Maintenance, Defense-wide, may be obligated or expended to expand leased facilities for the Joint Military Information Support Operations Web Operations Center until the Secretary of Defense submits to the congressional defense committees a validated manpower study for such center that includes the following:</text> <paragraph id="HF373920938924A27AFD10744677C5568" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Validated estimates of the number of personnel from the United States Special Operations Command and the other combatant commands that will be housed in leased facilities of such center.</text></paragraph>

<section id="HAF15A46F7EA64D0AA233FBFF9174F60F" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>350.</enum><header>Strategy and assessment on use of automation and artificial intelligence for shipyard optimization</header> 
<subsection id="H371882FCA42046C58F9F0D15DE1ED1D2"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Strategy</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the Navy, in coordination with the Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program of the Department of the Navy, shall develop and implement a strategy to leverage commercial best practices used in shipyards to improve the efficiency of operations and to demonstrate a digital platform that uses artificial intelligence to analyze data on the maintenance and condition of shipboard assets of the Navy at shipyards, for the purpose of improving the readiness of the Armed Forces, predicting and diagnosing issues prior to the occurrence of such issues, and lowering maintenance costs.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HC138071C49DF46D1B02A49DB62E1B3BC"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Assessment</header><text>The Secretary of the Navy shall conduct an assessment of the costs of maintenance delays on shipboard assets of the Navy and the potential cost savings of adopting artificial intelligence predictive maintenance technologies to assist in the determination of the condition of in-service equipment and estimate when maintenance should be performed prior to failure or end of life of such equipment. Such assessment shall include—</text> 
<paragraph id="H2CE1FBCB670047A4BF1CAF48A6825AC3"><enum>(1)</enum><text>an analysis of maintenance delays and costs due to unplanned and unpredicted maintenance issues;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6E5F8FE173B84827818CF850C56E5867"><enum>(2)</enum><text>an evaluation of opportunities to demonstrate commercial best practices at shipyards, including the demonstration of artificial intelligence technologies to ensure timely predictions for individuals responsible for maintenance and planning at shipyards by connecting datasets, executing models, and providing outputs in near real-time;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCE7170A642C64581B321E0C5F8521FB5"><enum>(3)</enum><text>an identification of shipyard assets of the Navy with sufficient data available to enable near-term demonstrations of artificial intelligence predictive maintenance technologies, and an estimate of resources needed within the Navy to accelerate such demonstrations with respect to such assets; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE38B1924DFA740A3894EEBA412B175B3"><enum>(4)</enum><text>an identification of any policy or technical challenges to implementing artificial intelligence or machine learning for purposes of carrying out the Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program of the Department of the Navy.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE66E616392374386989E1B0369D3E16D"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Briefing</header><text>Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of the Navy shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on—</text> <paragraph id="H7AF94EEBF053424AA53250FAD48B74E2"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the strategy under subsection (a);</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HBA21F54B98F642C899BF5D5A617FB5DC"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the results of the assessment under subsection (b); and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H58CA8BBA258044958E53DC7FB1EE0631"><enum>(3)</enum><text>a plan to execute any measures pursuant to such assessment.</text></paragraph></subsection></section>

<paragraph id="H75E4761F467C4FE7A86D3220AE7FFCAE" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Army Reserve, 174,800.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H549E37248FC64474A9CC369FC30D1A90" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Navy Reserve, 57,200.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6018C40892B34B0FBBEC2598BD86747A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Marine Corps Reserve, 32,000.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA79FB02C774C4B428B1B003E8506D10E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Air National Guard of the United States, 105,000.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H992697CAFABB41F996D7A61AB7A12B5B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Air Force Reserve, 69,600.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H9877ECC61D2A4C8891B11A5FD39E3449" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Coast Guard Reserve, 7,000.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBB6F43D12EED4C71A7692315616A0F59" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">End strength reductions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The end strengths prescribed by subsection (a) for the Selected Reserve of any reserve component shall be proportionately reduced by—</text> <paragraph id="HF648841A2A164439B10A266D465B5CF5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the total authorized strength of units organized to serve as units of the Selected Reserve of such component which are on active duty (other than for training) at the end of the fiscal year; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H2A294B77ED9540DA8F48AF0803AAAE7C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the total number of individual members not in units organized to serve as units of the Selected Reserve of such component who are on active duty (other than for training or for unsatisfactory participation in training) without their consent at the end of the fiscal year.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HF99849D538F642BD829B73BACF96FD1D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">End strength increases</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Whenever units or individual members of the Selected Reserve for any reserve component are released from active duty during any fiscal year, the end strength prescribed for such fiscal year for the Selected Reserve of such reserve component shall be increased proportionately by the total authorized strengths of such units and by the total number of such individual members.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H11D73D1CABB84B9BA83B79C3A4163BB9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>412.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">End strengths for Reserves on active duty in support of the Reserves</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Within the end strengths prescribed in section 411(a), the reserve components of the Armed Forces are authorized, as of September 30, 2024, the following number of Reserves to be serving on full-time active duty or full-time duty, in the case of members of the National Guard, for the purpose of organizing, administering, recruiting, instructing, or training the reserve components:</text> <paragraph id="H87D65DF7A5FE4D828AF1A51F566CA4EF" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Army National Guard of the United States, 30,845.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H1B07FD9A52234882965540A5C985AF36" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Army Reserve, 16,511.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBBEE2C59BC534C7D99585A16A468E839" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Navy Reserve, 10,327.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE9FB5F09694B4840A96F0BC085E54836" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Marine Corps Reserve, 2,355.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7B4FC2CF5A2741F7ADA34E8578DB2AC3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Air National Guard of the United States, 25,333.</text></paragraph>

<section id="H704F29AC3F01461F99700FCCC689C3B3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15101.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers in designated competitive categories</header> 
<subsection id="HDBE9A227F8684D3B8364CBEA66B68BE3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Authority to designate competitive categories of officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each Secretary of a military department may designate one or more competitive categories for promotion of officers under section 14005 of this title that are under the jurisdiction of such Secretary as a competitive category of officers whose promotion, retirement, and continuation on the reserve active-status list shall be subject to the provisions of this chapter.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H7E61B3CBE6C84BFE9132602C7F31137A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation on exercise of authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of a military department may not designate a competitive category of officers for purposes of this chapter until 60 days after the date on which the Secretary submits to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives a report on the designation of the competitive category. The report on the designation of a competitive category shall set forth the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="H02CE16C472854063A09608CC41C79EFA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A detailed description of officer requirements for officers within the competitive category.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6FA188CB589C428FB799F9CD38B4816C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An explanation of the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to each particular grade, and an estimate of promotion timing, within the competitive category.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H89241596772A48AB9EFD0C6B113658F5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An estimate of the size of the promotion zone for each grade within the competitive category.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5D4DAFF8BA324F44B792CF5F3DAAD065" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of any other matters the Secretary considered in determining to designate the competitive category for purposes of this chapter.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H3E3CEC5E61B04346A88AA5E353A5A99A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15102.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Selection for promotion</header> 
<subsection id="H37EE94A635F34229812EB124CC3B6012" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in this section, the selection for promotion of officers in any competitive category of officers designated for purposes of this chapter shall be governed by the provisions under chapter 1403 of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HF293A7F8D7E14367BDE17DE711EF824D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">No recommendation for promotion of officers below promotion zone</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 14301(d) of this title shall not apply to the selection for promotion of officers described in subsection (a).</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA3E66597E4944472ADB2FC103C90174B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Recommendation for officers to be excluded from future consideration for promotion</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In making recommendations pursuant to chapter 1403 of this title for purposes of the administration of this chapter, a selection board convened under section 14101(a) of this title may recommend that an officer considered by the board be excluded from future consideration for promotion under this chapter.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HF4DC88A86DED48AB9C1FAF4E655C627F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15103.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Eligibility for consideration for promotion</header> <subsection id="HB31D4C75BF534E8E83B10D3306DCC82F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided by this section, eligibility for promotion of officers in any competitive category of officers designated for purposes of this chapter shall be governed by the provisions of sections 14301, 14303, and 14304 of this title.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H04B929DD9C4341FEB2A459456754CE5C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Inapplicability of certain time-in-grade requirements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Sections 14303 and 14304 of this title shall not apply to the promotion of officers described in subsection (a).</text></subsection> <subsection id="H91FC22598AA5485F9DBCEA5B29F7E817" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Inapplicability to officers above and below promotion zone</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The following provisions of this title shall not apply to the promotion of officers described in subsection (a):</text> 
<paragraph id="H28861413656D401386CC1E926FB4554A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The reference in section 14301(b) to an officer above the promotion zone.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFB6F63568B54485E8BD1F16C62652C55" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 14301(d).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2D649419198C4E75AACAB86F33A6FB10" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Ineligibility of certain officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The following officers are not eligible for promotion under this chapter:</text> <paragraph id="H19397767444A4407B312F2AD96CE3E95" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer described in section 14301(c) of this title.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC064D00F67D54BBEBD93FF87FB9F0201" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer not included within the promotion zone.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H35F763F76E494ECB9A7052913FE49E07" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer who has failed of promotion to a higher grade the maximum number of times specified for opportunities for promotion for such grade within the competitive category concerned pursuant to section 15104 of this title.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6BE30895872B4BED8562A9FD8BA292FC" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer recommended by a selection board to be removed from consideration for promotion in accordance with section 15102(c) of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H7783903F78CA4144B7F081837068BF82" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15104.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Opportunities for consideration for promotion</header> <subsection id="HC3E89D340D9A4C4785D70438319C8FC3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Specification of number of opportunities for consideration for promotion</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In designating a competitive category of officers pursuant to section 15101 of this title, the Secretary of a military department shall specify the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers of the armed force concerned within the category for promotion to each grade above the grade of first lieutenant or lieutenant (junior grade), as applicable.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE3C2FB1C51D54D1B80892663CBEFD691" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limited authority of secretary of military department to modify number of opportunities</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of a military department may modify the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers of an armed force within a competitive category for promotion to a particular grade, as previously specified by the Secretary pursuant subsection (a) of this subsection, not more frequently than once every five years.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HB7F09384995F444C86A104D2DDE45327" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Discretionary authority of Secretary of defense to modify number of opportunities</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense may modify the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers of an armed force within a competitive category for promotion to a particular grade, as previously specified or modified pursuant to any provision of this section, at the discretion of the Secretary.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H135940A9D0A74418AE6502B79A5D66A7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation on number of opportunities specified</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers of an armed force within a competitive category for promotion to a particular grade, as specified or modified pursuant to any provision of this section, may not exceed five opportunities.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H4B18D73E99B84BFAA0B1050ACD74CF13" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Effect of certain reduction in number of opportunities specified</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">If, by reason of a reduction in the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion under this section, an officer would no longer have one or more opportunities for consideration for promotion that were available to the officer before the reduction, the officer shall be afforded one additional opportunity for consideration for promotion after the reduction.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H1D4BAB1615A54BA4A4E502E3138A61B3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15105.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Promotions</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Sections 14307 through 14317 of this title shall apply in promotions of officers in competitive categories of officers designated for purposes of this chapter.</text></section> <section id="H66B554A0A20241A4AB058FF21B5C0ABD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15106.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Failure of selection for promotion</header> <subsection id="H2CB89CAF394648678A75FC9A3F3688C5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in this section, sections 14501 through 14513 of this title shall apply to promotions of officers in competitive categories of officers designated for purposes of this chapter.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H6E5A621080A64E179B7BDE60D9E05FA5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Inapplicability of failure of selection for promotion to officers above promotion zone</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The reference in section 14501 of this title to an officer above the promotion zone shall not apply in the promotion of officers described in subsection (a).</text></subsection> <subsection id="H1EAF1C16E3EC498895A17EC803984F77" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Special selection board matters</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The reference in section 14502(a)(1) of this title to a person above the promotion zone shall not apply in the promotion of officers described in subsection (a).</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HAADE75B5954E4C6F82E8AF388DC37D8E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Effect of failure of selection</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In the administration of this chapter pursuant to subsection (a)—</text> <paragraph id="H5D86A780B8684ACB908EB63599DF5F8F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">an officer described in subsection (a) shall not be deemed to have failed twice of selection for promotion for purposes of section 14502(b) of this title until the officer has failed selection of promotion to the next higher grade the maximum number of times specified for opportunities for promotion to such grade within the competitive category concerned pursuant to section 15104 of this title; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB28721AB761645F9896EA2C2777C5165" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any reference in sections 14504 through 14506 of this title to an officer who has failed of selection for promotion to the next higher grade for the second time shall be deemed to refer instead to an officer described in subsection (a) who has failed of selection for promotion to the next higher grade for the maximum number of times specified for opportunities for promotion to such grade within the competitive category concerned pursuant to such section 15104.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HBEC97A5CF9364F478DE3E7F78D611AF2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15107.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Retirement: retirement for years of service; selective early retirement</header> <subsection id="HFF97AF4DFE934C59A27B1E26E0F73F28" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Retirement for years of service</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Sections 14507 through 14515 of this title shall apply to the retirement of officers in competitive categories of officers designated for purposes of this chapter.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H6F97EAE429EC478EB3A71C97A6D85B0E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Selective early retirement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 14101(b) of this title shall apply to the retirement of officers described in subsection (a).</text></subsection></section> <section id="HAAB3E8254B7E4316BAAB20D3FD14F019" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15108.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Continuation on the Reserve Active-Status List</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Sections 14701 through 14703 of this title shall apply in continuation or retention on a reserve active-status list of officers designated for purposes of this chapter.</text></section> 
<section id="HEFC3430D66F549C1B88204263018BDC1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>15109.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Other administrative authorities</header> 
<subsection id="HBD146ED66076471EA54D60F0A840ACEA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The following provisions of this title shall apply to officers in competitive categories of officers designated for purposes of this chapter:</text> <paragraph id="H18E32CF6DF0F489EBD5A55A02370E986" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 14518, relating to continuation of officers to complete disciplinary action.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB7BAB596ED134B3B85EA176D2068AB76" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 14519, relating to deferment of retirement or separation for medical reasons.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HDA380618329A4CCB99A29FDF2C8472B9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 14704, relating to the selective early removal from the reserve active-status list.</text></paragraph>

<subsection id="H348FA8F0BBCF4AB19C2EDB5D1828607F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Temporary waiver</header> 
<paragraph id="H9561024F2EBA4E4090CFD9536312F89A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall establish a process under which a covered individual may be granted a temporary waiver of the prohibition under subsection (a) if—</text> <subparagraph id="HEDE37250153641F882CDC469FC239B73" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the individual, or a Federal agency on behalf of, and with the consent of, the individual, submits to the Secretary a written application for a waiver in such form and manner as the Secretary determines appropriate; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H857119EBB08D444593152145F8E482EA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Secretary determines that the waiver is necessary to advance the national security interests of the United States.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB8FA73DEEA9D48928D88085EA6F91EB8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Period of waiver</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A waiver issued under paragraph (1) shall apply for a period not exceeding 5 years. The Secretary may renew such a waiver.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H672267AF6BEB4CEF8EFAFE4A1BD988F4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Revocation</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary may revoke a waiver issued under paragraph (1) to a covered individual with respect to a covered-post service position if the Secretary determines that the employment of the individual in the covered-post service position poses a threat to national security.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H865BD90E90434DB9A39CBF4FBCBD6DA1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notification</header> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H901EC1EE91324334AC18850A0A977F3E"><enum>(A)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 30 days after the date on which the Secretary issues a waiver under paragraph (1) or revokes a waiver under paragraph (3), the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives written notification of the waiver or revocation, as the case may be. </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB83C6119DBFB4ABAA9A7EF31420C7F4B"><enum>(B)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A notification required by subparagraph (A) shall include the following:</text> <clause id="H70CB0C430CA040F7A579314B24694E20" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">With respect to a waiver issued to a covered individual—</text> 
<subclause id="H3D7E211437114C299CA4A5274B35F36C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(I)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the details of the application, including the position held by the individual in the armed forces;</text></subclause> <subclause id="HE3E45DF6819549FF9B7BF4695DED811F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(II)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the nature of the post-service position of the individual;</text></subclause> 
<subclause id="H7AD080800BF148B7B958823ADD13FB7F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(III)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a description of the national security interests that will be advanced by reason of issuing such a waiver; and</text></subclause> <subclause id="H3113D0ED01984F9CBC9EBAE7C7B065FA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(IV)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the specific reasons why the Secretary determines that issuing the waiver will advance such interests.</text></subclause></clause> 
<clause id="HD9BCCF8307624E258B974E92D8946A13" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">With respect to a revocation of a waiver issued to a covered individual—</text> <subclause id="H5714A88165C64F8C933D09F2662601F9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(I)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the details of the waiver, including any renewals of the waiver, and the dates of such waiver and renewals; and</text></subclause> 
<subclause id="H4E015A17FA32454F9B49A2404EF5C6D7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(II)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the specific reasons why the Secretary determined that the revocation is warranted.</text></subclause></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H58A2B35422434585B0E99E1BC24A2AB9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Certification of prohibition</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In implementing the prohibition under subsection (a), the Secretary shall establish a process under which each member of the armed forces is, before the member retires or is otherwise separated from the armed forces—</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H0571B33D6E294BF2913203F2E18306FC"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">informed in writing of the prohibition, and the penalties for violations of the prohibition; and </text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H75E2104122714673AEE871AA63A528EC"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">required to certify that the member understands the prohibition and those penalties.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA999156DF3DA4B3F8AE315678736E86C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Penalties</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In the case of a covered individual who knowingly and willfully fails to comply with the prohibition under subsection (a), the Secretary may, as applicable—</text> <paragraph id="H415D997A916C451DA4819C700EA08E55" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">withhold any pay, allowances, or benefits that would otherwise be provided to the individual by the Department of Defense; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HEE32E8AB4BB54B2BAF8AAD0FD2C8668A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">revoke any security clearance of the individual.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HC1418E0B0B164E9395C94E539917C775" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Annual reports</header> <paragraph id="H4CA41E3FC5ED47258201BF50F223E242" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Requirement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than March 31, 2024, and annually thereafter, the Secretary shall submit to the congressional defense committees a report on covered post-service employment occurring during the year covered by the report.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC735FB99BCA74EBEB4186EF0647CCB2F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each report required by paragraph (1) shall include the following:</text> <subparagraph id="H2F288B10DA8D4C118387DC72198378AD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The number of former covered individuals who occupy a covered post-service position, broken down by—</text>

<clause id="H5359283AF3F04D439CAD2BA0BE65D400" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the nature of the services provided as part of the covered post-service employment.</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H905326B0DCAE455FA88DF1D6DFF4294D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment by the Secretary of whether—</text> 
<clause id="H9011696E3134413DB512DF2C563F9ED7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Department of Defense maintains adequate systems and processes for ensuring that former members of the armed forces are submitting required reports relating to their employment by foreign governments;</text></clause> <clause id="H8F4499FA4863487AA556345828B730E3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">all covered individuals who occupy a covered post-service position are in compliance with this section;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H063C5F1E78D248E48ECAFCA73F9D86B5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the services provided by the covered individuals who occupy a covered post-service position pose a current or future threat to the national security of the United States; and</text></clause> <clause id="HEF1993772F6B4DD2B0A82D056CA03137" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iv)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">there is any credible information or reporting that any covered individual who occupies a covered post-service position has engaged in activities that violate Federal law.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>

<subparagraph id="H22EE2B544FD94736B057FEA58ED259AC" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">As applicable, a description of the risk to national security and the activities that may violate Federal law.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H836E8DC72C2F48A6B1F2514FCDE67AE3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(g)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Rule of construction</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section may be construed to indemnify or shield covered individuals from prosecution under any relevant provision of title 18.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H10CF52AE8F794698A62BE3ABE24D9420" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(h)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Definitions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section:</text> <paragraph id="HDEB7057001DD491B8709BD9F782ECFD4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Covered individual</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>covered individual</term> means an individual who has retired or otherwise separated from an active or reserve component of the Armed Forces.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9218CE997184438A981F63C927938356"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Covered post-service employment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>covered post-service employment</term> means direct or indirect employment by, representation of, or any provision of advice or services relating to national security, intelligence, the military, or internal security to—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H2FEEA489E41C4A9FA695F8729F75C387"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the government of—</text> 
<clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H26A563667A7E402491D6AF11AE513D73"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a country of concern (as defined in section 1(m) of the State Department Basic Authorities Act of 1956 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/22/2651a">22 U.S.C. 2651a(m)</external-xref>)); or </text></clause> <clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H6F6B8F38AA6D4639BFF7E7B2F1FD9FFF"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a country the Secretary of Defense determines acts as a proxy or passthrough for services for a country of concern; or</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H45B6C545824D4C719F669721CFB55507"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any company, entity, or other person the activities of which are directly or indirectly supervised, directed, controlled, financed, or subsidized, in whole or in major part, by a government described in subparagraph (A).</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE6A5A8D6157E43799C1977ED88CAA37F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Covered post-service position</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>covered post-service position</term> means a position of employment described in paragraph (2).</text></paragraph></subsection></section><after-quoted-block display="yes">.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection>

<subsection id="H2F1A8B4CF29B4D3A882C26B43A470AEE"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Requirement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">If the number of nonprior service enlisted personnel covered under section 520 of title 10, United States Code, exceeds 10 percent of the total number of persons originally enlisted in an Armed Force during a fiscal year, the Secretary concerned shall establish a future servicemember preparatory course within the Armed Force concerned.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H4A9B4ED0A9494464B4FF8F46BD1F07C1"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Purpose</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The course established under subsection (a) shall be designed to improve the physical and aptitude qualifications of military recruits.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HD17631EEE5CA4EE5942C66A440BDD3F7"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Criteria</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each course established under this section shall comply with the following requirements:</text> <paragraph id="H7C46A405AC164464A28199AEE5286387"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Enrollment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">All nonprior service enlisted persons whose score on the Armed Forces Qualification Test is below the thirty-first percentile must be enrolled in the course prior to attending initial basic training.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H086BF9A2D3C84AE2851AAEF1188ED10B"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Graduation requirement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Prior to attending initial basic training, all enlisted persons attending the course established under this section must achieve a score on the Armed Forces Qualification Test that is at least 10 points higher than the individual’s most recent score taken prior to the individual’s date of enlistment.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF9CA4F0AC89941A4A019BFF732C9AD8E"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Effect of course failure</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Any enlisted person who fails to achieve course graduation requirements within 180 days of enlistment shall be separated under regulations prescribed by the Secretary concerned.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H14AFF17E1EB742BFA02BAE49F284037C"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">If a preparatory course under this section is established by the Secretary concerned, the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and House of Representatives a report on the structure and results of the course for the preceding fiscal year by December 1st of the subsequent fiscal year. The report shall include the following elements:</text> <paragraph id="HC57A36AE6E5A47AE886D258617FE1CA9"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The number of individuals who attended the preparatory course.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H132D366F477C4313AB46A5F6330E1576"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The number of individuals who graduated the preparatory course.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD46463152FF84EAFBAB2DDF325ACF02C"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The average improvement in the Armed Forces Qualification Test score for individuals who graduated from the prepatory course.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HAFC9A1A55D9B4F4DA5DEB6BC3B63AE2F"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Any other matter the Secretary determines relevant.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HEF0B2AC8B0C249158529F469480111CE"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Sunset</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The requirements of this section shall expire on September 30th, 2028.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H3935BD76797041AF99766E41F3C87DEF"><enum>547.</enum><header>Pilot program on cardiac screenings for military accessions</header> 
<subsection id="H568E73390D6748BDB30A8434EE12A788"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than September 30, 2024, the Secretary of Defense shall carry out a pilot program to provide an electrocardiogram to individuals who undergo military accession screenings. Each such electrocardiogram shall be provided—</text> <paragraph id="HD62F615F24664915B84BFD67EAD30F5F"><enum>(1)</enum><text>on a mandatory basis;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0206D96815914ECAA3B8115094AD968E"><enum>(2)</enum><text>at no cost to the recipient; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H26D07F698C9148A7941C7EF26810E962" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text>in a facility of the Department of Defense or by a member or employee of the military health system.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7065AAF0E35C42C1983BCCBBBC991702"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Purposes</header><text>In carrying out the pilot program, the Secretary shall—</text> <paragraph id="H71748B8B4ED14729A70C54FBD7AE07CE"><enum>(1)</enum><text>determine the costs (including protocols and personnel and equipment for each location where the Secretary carries out the pilot program) and benefits to the Department of providing an electrocardiogram to every individual who undergoes a military accession screening;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6D50A08025E84C1BB4F9859BADD3FB95"><enum>(2)</enum><text>develop and implement appropriate processes to assess the long-term impacts of electrocardiogram results on military service; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H1E097A10FBFE457493585A09A6E8B163"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">consult with experts in cardiology to develop appropriate clinical practice guidelines for cardiac screenings, diagnosis, and treatment.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H00C030B757384413AB49CFD71914A549"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Briefing</header><text>Not later than 180 days after the date on which the pilot program terminates, the Secretary shall provide to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives a briefing on the pilot program. Such briefing shall include the following:</text> <paragraph id="H51E60EE2336543ACB73D4E8625F0FE9F"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The results of all electrocardiograms provided to individuals under the pilot program—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H792ECDA4DDFB426FA9C6E771BF723B45"><enum>(A)</enum><text>disaggregated by Armed Force, race, and gender; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H80E4AD7C774B4695988987C8DFDB2AD3"><enum>(B)</enum><text>without any personally identifiable information.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H55C76D32AD7A44B8B8034B21B95BF8ED"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The rate of significant cardiac issues detected pursuant to electrocardiograms provided under the pilot program, disaggregated by Armed Force, race, and gender.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4892406DE2FF4D0CB653DC4F9DFFBF37"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The number of individuals, if any, who were disqualified from accession based solely on the result of an electrocardiogram provided under the pilot program.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HAE21068220FF46F389995859BAA92144"><enum>(4)</enum><text>The cost of carrying out the pilot program.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H77F1C0FECC4D4C7187A3AD2E9F5AC795"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Termination</header><text>The pilot program shall terminate after three years after its implementation.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H5885E1F96E804F05AD94FC490BC6ECB2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>548.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Community college Enlisted Training Corps demonstration program</header> 
<subsection id="HFF5884F8883345789E10F82504A8FBF8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Demonstration program</header> 
<paragraph id="H967701491A2941CAB054B3279D97DC5F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than August 1, 2025, the Secretary concerned shall establish within each military department an Enlisted Training Corps demonstration program for the purpose of introducing students to the military, and preparing selected students for enlisted service in the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, or Space Force.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H714C6437BEFE4263B9C0D3F888F467DA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Location</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Demonstration programs established under this section shall be located at a community or junior college. No program may be established at a military college or military junior college as defined for purposes of section 2107a of title 10, United States Code.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H757625344B544642A14C7DBD4E54B8C6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Eligibility for membership</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">To be eligible for membership in a program under this section, a person must be a student at an institution where a unit of the Enlisted Training Corps is located.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HD2460464D2CD464BA742D0ADC942D957" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Instructors</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary concerned may assign as an instructor for a unit established under this section an individual eligible to serve as an instructor under section 2111 or section 2031 of title 10, United States Code. Instructors who are not currently members on active duty shall be paid in a manner consistent with section 2031 of title 10, United States Code.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE73145C0BF0A4C47A7236FB6F04BD921" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Financial assistance</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the military department concerned may provide financial assistance to persons enrolled in a unit of the Enlisted Training Corps in exchange for an agreement in writing that the person enlist in the active component of the military department concerned upon graduation or disenrollment from the community college. Financial assistance provided under this subsection may include tuition, living expenses, stipend, or other payment.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HF10283F828104912AA572B4DB79D9F52" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Curriculum</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary concerned shall ensure that any programs created under this section include as part of the curriculum the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="HF8192263A32F4EFF87098A3C2FAD1C60" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An introduction to the benefits of military service.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H0B738E6270014FD9A3690CCC94B309C1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Military history.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7B8CCF760B8C4A7C939953110238C650" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Military customs and courtesies.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H0958BE3866BC4BAABC8CA2E50EB4C5F4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Physical fitness requirements.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H4894B60A24394578A2A5958B56A6DB69" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Instruction on ethical behavior and decision making.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H0253600C8C504AD8B65BA5B6A1CE07F6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(f)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Reporting requirement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter until the date specified by subsection (g), the Secretary of Defense shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives a report on the status of the demonstration program required by this section. </text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2C5D2BF08D15425294569D76816A08E8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(g)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Sunset</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The requirements of this provision shall sunset on September 30, 2030. </text></subsection></section> <section id="H1A3B61BE620245348E1855040564A0F4" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>549.</enum><header>Annual briefings on military recruitment practices in public secondary schools and community colleges</header> <subsection id="HE9FCE096B7AD40DCAE6F49B072C76D6E"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Briefings required</header><text>Not later than December 31, 2024, and on an annual basis thereafter through December 31, 2028, the Secretary of Defense shall provide to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives a briefing on military recruitment practices carried out in public secondary schools and community colleges during the calendar year preceding the date of the briefing.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H4BD41FEBE196452891157134B5B3E2BE"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Elements</header><text>Each briefing under subsection (a) shall include, with respect to the year covered by the briefing, the following:</text> <paragraph id="H3679A0C74EAB4D6794B57F2BC18818FD"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Identification of the public secondary schools and community colleges visited by military recruiters.</text></paragraph>

<subsection id="H60AC10F98E904F3AB194C0FFF3A690A1"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Disaggregation</header><text>The information required under each of a paragraphs (1) through (3) of subsection (b) shall be set forth separately—</text> <paragraph id="H1CC4B07DA4CB4458AD85BF6D0763F536"><enum>(1)</enum><text>by ZIP code, in the case of information concerning community colleges; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0878FC64E1B444DB91B744E4039E3A29"><enum>(2)</enum><text>by local educational agency, in the case information concerning public secondary schools.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H62949980FE88458282E8C2A71CC7D824"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section, the terms <quote>local educational agency</quote> and <quote>secondary school</quote> have the meanings given those terms in section 8101 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/20/7801">20 U.S.C. 7801</external-xref>).</text></subsection></section></subtitle>

<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAC982ADF879B4295A0D03DEB49C8466C"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by amending subsection (d) to read as follows:</text> <quoted-block id="H6D90A0CA6DCD408F8AE4FFB87FF3A638" style="OLC" act-name="" display-inline="no-display-inline"> <subsection id="H24FE7999C8554A8AB1D3B1860955C3D4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="H2C68415E9EF44D7F96398AB87F0C4B53"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Instead of, or in addition to, detailing officers and noncommissioned officers on active duty under subsection (c)(1), the Secretary of the military department concerned may authorize qualified institutions to employ, as administrators and instructors in the program—</text>

<paragraph id="H8CAA5DA605504F389088471D019500DF"><enum>(3)</enum><text>An overview of policies and procedures in place in DODEA schools for administrators and teachers to communicate and coordinate with parents and guardians of students in such schools in cases in which students have a demonstrated need for mental health and wellness support.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE2E535D176524EF38D0928A25CB77E9B"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Any recommendations for new policies, programs, or resources to improve mental health and wellness support for students enrolled in DODEA schools.</text></paragraph>

<subsection id="H47A38E52F5F943648E493A54DCD80771"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Mental health and wellness considerations</header><text>In considering student mental health and wellness for purposes of this section, the Secretary of Defense shall, at a minimum, take into account the following conditions:</text> <paragraph id="HF00191B569A644EE8714350CC3029808"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Depression.</text></paragraph>

<paragraph id="HE76568880BCF4CD5BFBAE20C786618CB"><enum>(6)</enum><text>Substance abuse.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H57863E2A7F2D4CEAAF5B962C18FD8DBD"><enum>(7)</enum><text>Dual diagnosis conditions.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HA0A0DC3D02CF4CB68466BAB4697ED47D"><enum>589.</enum><header>Rights of parents of children attending schools operated by the Department of Defense Education Activity</header> 
<subsection id="H3C653956EBC8485DB4D6D367B5C9C820"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline"><external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/10/108">Chapter 108</external-xref> of title 10, United States Code, is amended by inserting after <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/2164">section 2164</external-xref> the following new section:</text> <quoted-block id="HE7ACC36DAC114B83A7775901E2970C3B" style="USC"> <section id="HD2DAD7E13FB3405586F5D11DEA82B7E5"><enum>2164a.</enum><header>Rights of parents of children attending schools operated by the Department of Defense Education Activity</header></section> <subsection id="H7D8B1332F46743F2A1976037C1B17927"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The parent of a child who attends a school operated by the Department of Defense Education Activity has the following rights:</text> 
<paragraph id="HE4B3DEFDCC0247FBB66B506F6B338A75"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The right to review the curriculum of the school.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H3A6CBAB3D6C940128331BE289839C779"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The right to be informed if the school or the Department of Defense Education Activity alters the school’s academic standards or learning benchmarks.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H4C7DBDC04F3F4FA3BF503B7D852D2113"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The right to meet with each teacher of their child not less than twice during each school year.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HCCDA03F83EEE45269F0DB962D4B0A4C2"><enum>(4)</enum><text>The right to review all instructional materials used by their students.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA3CEC9B0219546CFBE40A3663B6FA771"><enum>(5)</enum><text>The right to inspect a list of the books and other reading materials contained in the library of the school.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H69CC97BEC1304D4FAB747A42A36EE7A3"><enum>(6)</enum><text>The right to address the school advisory committee or the school board.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HDA10F03789C5404A851A6016863FF06F"><enum>(7)</enum><text>The right to data about the school’s discipline policy and any disciplinary action that results in a suspension or expulsion from the school, unless such disclosure is prohibited by law.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HCF6E1D3DDDC24B128EE319911872BA6C"><enum>(8)</enum><text>The right to information about any plans to eliminate gifted and talented programs or accelerated coursework at the school.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HEFE2AEB1D655499296E3C4569E417984"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Disclosures and notifications</header><text>Consistent with the parental rights specified in subsection (a) and except as provided by subsection (c), a school operated by the Department of Defense Education Activity shall—</text> <paragraph id="H62CFCB31AA234DF283B2C886CBA03D29"><enum>(1)</enum><text>post on a publicly accessible website of the school—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H25ADB82236324CCFA1724E2CB8F804E6"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the curriculum for each course and grade level;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H203F1B1F7FCB4484A51DBFBC35C09A1A"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the academic standards or other learning benchmarks used by the school; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HFB3949F832F34ADA9B71F025F6376353"><enum>(C)</enum><text>notice of any proposed revisions to such standards or benchmarks and a copy of any such revisions; </text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4CCF9AD369254F10A5A11D13FA728C0E"><enum>(2)</enum><text>provide the parent of a child attending the school with—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H7684D8A5CDE948E2B2564A56134B2F83"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the opportunity to meet in person with each teacher of their child not less frequently than twice during each school year at a time mutually agreed upon by both parties; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H1230E4674F0D4A6888E8A6A79D95305A"><enum>(B)</enum><text>notice of such opportunity at the beginning of each school year;</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF26C45491A3B4D78B7DB6FB206279FA2"><enum>(3)</enum><text>provide parents access to the online school library catalog;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H8D057BB0E61E42868D2E0C665BCE32AC"><enum>(4)</enum><text>notify parents in a timely manner of any plans to eliminate gifted and talented programs or accelerated coursework at the school;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA1DC9B23E6EB43E3877E622EC3854845"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">except as provided by paragraph (6) or subsection (c), notify parents of any medical examinations or screenings the school may administer to their child and receive written consent from parents for any such examination or screening prior to conducting the examination or screening;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6F724A60A38C42C29536CC782023FFBD"><enum>(6)</enum><text>in the event of an emergency that requires a medical examination or screening without time for parental notification, promptly notify parents of such examination or screening and provide an explanation of the emergency that prevented notification prior to such examination or screening; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC33BB48F00054221A477B87F2B0C3571"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">notify parents of any medical information that will be collected on their child, receive written parental consent prior to collecting such information, and provide parents an opportunity to inspect such information at the parent's request.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HE7FA8106B67D49C8B591B119D14FA90B"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Exceptions</header> <paragraph id="HA91750A0182D4D3083F554F988BFD84E" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Paragraph (5) of subsection (a) and paragraph (3) of subsection (b) shall not be effective until the day that is two years after the date of the enactment of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCDB7634F9853439E9D592A4CA4CE0716" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>A requirement set forth in subsection (b) shall not apply in a case in which the requirement would violate any applicable provision of a Federal or State statute or regulation.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H92C00B32ACB24AAA9BAC719A00D57C46"><enum>(d)</enum><header>School advisory committees and boards</header><text>Not less frequently than four times per year, a school advisory committee or school board for a school operated by the Department of Defense Education Activity shall provide parents of children attending the school with the opportunity to address the advisory committee or school board on any matters relating to the school or the educational services provided to their children.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HD127B6FCEFC64488A9C531E2F80013B8"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> <paragraph id="HAEDE30D66DF74C419C104F519C43BAFC"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The term <quote>medical examination or screening</quote>—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H641C0AB196FE43E98E4499A0ACD5C00F"><enum>(A)</enum><text>means a physical examination provided by a health care provider; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H04EF119FC5534E49AB0667597EADD931"><enum>(B)</enum><text>does not include an evaluation by, or an encounter with, non-clinical school staff.</text></subparagraph></paragraph>

<section id="H487F2C7DEC4E4944AD75C03CB8F292CB" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>627.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">OCONUS cost-of-living allowance: adjustments</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 617 of the James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/117/263">Public Law 117–263</external-xref>) is amended by striking subsections (a), (b), and (c) and inserting the following:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H025F8D654EEC49029FC9E881B470240F"> <subsection id="H4BCD905FCF2B4750AD33C51CDAE284A0"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Reductions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense may reduce an OCONUS COLA in accordance with this subsection.</text> 
<paragraph id="HA2D1B610BFD24AAFBD6ABF31412E4B4B"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Frequency</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary may not announce a reduction to an OCONUS COLA for a location outside the continental United States more than twice per calendar year.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H2A4C874EF0FF43A99FFC19789F9268A9" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Maximum reduction</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A reduction to an OCONUS COLA may not exceed the lesser of—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H01E4A7A26AA24D57880F4BE9F392541B"><enum>(A)</enum><text>10 OCONUS COLA index points; or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H59942E7D2FE445FEAD502EFDA9538A71"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the number of OCONUS COLA index points by which the cost of living of the permanent duty station of the covered member exceeds the average cost of living index in the continental United States.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H4174A6CC191443308D3BBC2EF91CC8FE"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Limitations</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Paragraphs (1) and (2) shall not apply to a reduction on the basis of—</text> <subparagraph id="H7DB0BDEFB2114593A2E88188AD5B9313"><enum>(A)</enum><text>a change in the rate of exchange of foreign currencies; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HA9F47D1199774470A8BFB1BEC2790784"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a permanent change of station for a covered member.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HEBD6F51CCE0B4700B1A583B732331BB9"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Implementation</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary may phase in a reduction under this subsection.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H9CAEFF1715834609A6FDBFF5CC9ABE21"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Increases</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary may increase an OCONUS COLA at any time.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HD813D3D10E0E4AA7891B05B528A02AFE"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Reporting</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than February 1 of each year, the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and House of Representatives a report regarding reductions and increases to OCONUS COLAs during the previous calendar year. Such report shall include the following elements:</text>
