<section id="HDD02A75CC34E4A099B6A7A878C712B2C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1080.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Modification of definition of domestic source for title III of the Defense Production Act of 1950</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H84021F0A7D2244ECA3D6C90FA309E0CB"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 702(7) of the Defense Production Act of 1950 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/4552">50 U.S.C. 4552(7)</external-xref>) is amended—</text> <paragraph id="H72B8A9A73AB342FBB27B2000F4734019" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by redesignating subparagraphs (A) and (B) as clauses (i) and (ii), respectively, and by moving such clauses, as so redesignated, two ems to the right;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE9749509BE79424585C640261FE81D2F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by striking <quote>The term</quote> and inserting the following:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H975ED99699504E08873DF4AD30910F40"> <subparagraph id="H076C891ECA944464A2392CDA9F3D7651" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in subparagraph (B), the term</text></subparagraph><after-quoted-block display="yes">; </after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9893954AD1F34082B19704BDDE98EC85" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in clause (ii), as redesignated by paragraph (1), by striking <quote>subparagraph (A)</quote> and inserting <quote>clause (i)</quote>; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBBFC6561161B4A8E8F92E8F746F1EC32" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by adding at the end the following new subparagraph (B):</text> 
<quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9E46DE093AB24AE88434E21D24AFC9E6"> 
<subparagraph id="HB5A2B8688F724028AA3C1FE97DB002C3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Domestic source for title III</header> 
<clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H53839E9322024152B17993E494F5209F"><enum>(i)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">For purposes of title III, the term <term>domestic source</term> means a business concern that—</text> <subclause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H911CBCBBADE64B91ABF8A81D53685CE5"><enum>(I)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">performs substantially all of the research and development, engineering, manufacturing, and production activities required of such business concern under a contract with the United States relating to a critical component or a critical technology item in—</text> 
<item id="HD06EF88E42E545278D39C96FF2F66276" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(aa)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the United States or Canada; or</text></item> <item id="HB22232750F3B4695BA4013FDADFE0A17" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(bb)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">subject to clause (ii), Australia or the United Kingdom; and</text></item></subclause> 
<subclause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFC57C64DCF8B41AC90303845A366A58B"><enum>(II)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">procures from business concerns described in subclause (I) substantially all of any components or assemblies required under a contract with the United States relating to a critical component or critical technology item.</text></subclause></clause> <clause id="H1207BBAC9FB847B6BA1CD1DA5A83844C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitations on use of business concerns in Australia and United Kingdom</header> <subclause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HD6768DF77AF046D3AF98A5D447DF93B1"><enum>(I)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A business concern described in clause (i)(I)(bb) may be treated as a domestic source only for purposes of the exercise of authorities under title III relating to national defense matters that cannot be fully addressed with business concerns described in clause (i)(I)(aa).</text></subclause> 
<subclause id="H21A949EEC55249F1AB61008060C968B5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(II)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">National defense matter defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">For purposes of subclause (I), the term <term>national defense matter</term> is a matter relating to the development or production of—</text> <item commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9BBE38FFDD4F49BBB2667A86D2B4E64C"><enum>(aa)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a defense article, as defined in section 301 of title 10, United States Code; or </text></item> 
<item commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE57F0E5AE15F4DC585A53D6AA6790873"><enum>(bb)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">materials critical to national security, as defined in section 10(f) of the Strategic and Critical Materials Stock Piling Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/98h-1">50 U.S.C. 98h–1(f)</external-xref>).</text></item></subclause></clause></subparagraph><after-quoted-block display="yes">.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H87F85646FDD04CA08FD88CFF50D2C542" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Reports on exercise of title III authorities</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Title III of the Defense Production Act of 1950 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/4531">50 U.S.C. 4531 et seq.</external-xref>) is amended by adding at the end the following new section:</text> 
<quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H7326884A49794FE089B4E1EF181ED06B"> 
<section id="HC70A7034A132430188E33A66E18722EC" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>305.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Reports on exercise of authorities</header> 
<subsection id="H0709453A346C4DFA86139AE0128B790B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The President, or the head of an agency to which the President has delegated authorities under this title, shall submit a report and provide a briefing to the appropriate congressional committees with respect to any action taken pursuant to such authorities—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA3754D297C714707AD0B814D9E696092"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">except as provided by paragraph (2), not later than 30 days after taking the action; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HEBA5F163EF0244EBAC06B965293CD600"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in the case of an action that involves a business concern in the United Kingdom or Australia, not later than 30 days before taking the action.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H02C5348FD77D449BB2C8CD004776EC92"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H11F1F96578D34393915E1AA8678CED26"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each report and briefing required by subsection (a) with respect to an action described in that subsection shall include—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HC4AF0B3382334C4FBE03242DE9A579ED"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a justification of the necessity of the use of authorities under this title; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAD2CA0E73D604895B8A5BEBE278A3550"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a description of the financial terms of any related financial transaction.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H8995C88DC93F41DB90DA3B80B59E1657"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Additional elements relating to business concerns in the United Kingdom or Australia</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each report and briefing required by subsection (a) with respect to an action described in paragraph (2) of that subsection shall include, in addition to the elements under paragraph (1)—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB8F716557681423595A769EBA3ABD371"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a certification that business concerns in the United States or Canada were not available with respect to the action; and</text></subparagraph>

<clause id="H70F28435FF6A432FB1FCA53AD6C6A6D3"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate;</text></clause> <clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H4398F46BC82149678587131BF953BCCA"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate;</text></clause> 
<clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H2BC01B8061504B8DA02A94CC68287099"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology of the House of Representatives;</text></clause> <clause id="HB3EB06D3D1A84801A038B64341FB25F5"><enum>(v)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services of the House of Representatives; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="H6F0993462417498DBA90873C398A1690"><enum>(vi)</enum><text>the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H97D66982A76D4D2692D9F0D749E7E31B"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Commerce</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Commerce shall submit to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate and the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology of the House of Representatives a comprehensive report, for the period beginning on the date of the enactment of this Act and ending on December 31, 2035, on—</text>

<clause id="H8727D7EB82AA4C5084444D83A32C7CF8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the National Winter Season Operations Plan;</text></clause> <clause id="H21A5BE8BACA846329CFBFFD0B605D82F"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">emerging technologies that offer new, improved, and innovative ways to collect data for improved forecasts of strength and landfall for hurricanes, atmospheric rivers, and winter storms; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="H3E62112DB61E4E1FB6AE27A12BCECB4D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>any other operational requirements relating to weather reconnaissance;</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HE01A1871145D449EB9213F9861A18093" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">how taskings that the 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron of the Air Force Reserve Command is unable to accomplish could affect the ability of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration to fulfill its mission; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE60C327675D14DE8A3496CA568E8B57C"><enum>(C)</enum><text>how taskings that the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration is unable to accomplish could affect the ability of the 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron of the Air Force Reserve Command to fulfill its mission.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H1DCA7C7ABFA2411BB94CB14EC0C937A5"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Transfer of funds</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the Air Force may transfer funds to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration for additional hurricane monitoring and response activities that fulfill the mission of the Air Force, including transfers of funds for the compensation of personnel and for the provision of other such services, funds, facilities, and other support services as necessary.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H81A8D8CFC15545D5A7029B647738B16F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1091.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Sense of Congress regarding authority of Secretary of Defense with respect to irregular warfare</header> 
<subsection id="HC89D0DEBA7864E34A5A1E86DF21801B8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">It is the sense of Congress that the Secretary of Defense has the authority to conduct irregular warfare operations, including clandestine irregular warfare operations, to defend the United States, allies of the United States, and interests of the United States, when such operations have been appropriately authorized.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HD3B4C16695F144C09F0BFE78BFF8739B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Rule of construction</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section shall be construed to constitute a specific statutory authorization for any of the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="H6CDEE4A7643645BEB939A06BD828800A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The conduct of a covert action, as such term is defined in section 503(e) of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3093">50 U.S.C. 3093(e)</external-xref>).</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB8DA15F6F2194FA1B1E930A17DCEC028" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The introduction of United States Armed Forces, within the meaning of the War Powers Resolution (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/93/148">Public Law 93–148</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/1541">50 U.S.C. 1541 et seq.</external-xref>), into hostilities or into situations wherein hostilities are clearly indicated by the circumstances. </text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H53D4DEDCEA7841A4927573CA155E9B51" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1092.</enum><header>Red Hill health impacts</header> 
<subsection id="H512D28BC86B8478989D265F27D388FC3"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1FC4DC9836D64EF6A485D740B9874072"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Review</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense (referred to in this section as the <quote>Secretary</quote>), in coordination with the Director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs, and such State and local authorities or other partners as the Secretary considers appropriate, shall—</text> <subparagraph id="H8E4EDC12DF39423C939C0D0DFE12415B"><enum>(A)</enum><text>review the Federal programs and services available to individuals exposed to petroleum;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE750DD29147341C6A7073CC8074C4870"><enum>(B)</enum><text>review current research on petroleum exposure in order to identify additional research needs; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA9ABF2A3EC784A7FA84BA6CCA5B598FE"><enum>(C)</enum><text>undertake any other review or activities that the Secretary determines to be appropriate.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H90C58649D9E84636A01CE7A001048E02"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Report</header><text>Not later than one year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter for six subsequent years, the Secretary shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report on the review and activities undertaken under paragraph (1) that includes—</text> <subparagraph id="H9671CA3959C744EAAEF8D539EB1B95C4"><enum>(A)</enum><text>strategies for communicating and engaging with stakeholders on the Red Hill Incident;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H7881E3DF368549298F829C985F4C4FDD" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the number of impacted and potentially impacted individuals;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HB8BA7183B8394D6CA44DC91F74805711"><enum>(C)</enum><text>measures and frequency of follow-up to collect data and specimens related to exposure, health, and developmental milestones as appropriate; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H5E4C1072FEF9406491493FE9449C57E3"><enum>(D)</enum><text>a summary of data and analyses on exposure, health, and developmental milestones for impacted individuals. </text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBEAD9B02402349B0B3AF71B412DA1C02"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Consultation</header><text>In carrying out paragraphs (1) and (2), the Secretary shall consult with non-Federal experts, including individuals with certification in epidemiology, toxicology, mental health, pediatrics, and environmental health, and members of the impacted community.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2C01173430DB4B91A5C422C55DA9288B"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Red Hill epidemiological health outcomes study</header> 
<paragraph id="HFACCB5A6A6394BA9AEF2AB7C5500AC16"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Contracts</header><text>The Secretary may contract with independent research institutes or consultants, nonprofit or public entities, laboratories, or medical schools, as the Secretary considers appropriate, that are not part of the Federal Government to assist with the feasibility assessment required by paragraph (2).</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H808EA008A45945A28CC86F5D58C4CC98"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Feasibility assessment</header><text>Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees the results of a feasibility assessment to determine the necessity of an epidemiological health outcomes study and to inform the design of the potential epidemiological study or studies to assess health outcomes for impacted individuals, which may include—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HB78093B71B8141CF925798488765B479"><enum>(A)</enum><text>a strategy to recruit impacted individuals to participate in the study or studies, including incentives for participation;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H53ED28A820754F7E8D8208D29DC63835"><enum>(B)</enum><text>a description of protocols and methodologies to assess health outcomes from the Red Hill Incident, including data management protocols to secure the privacy and security of the personal information of impacted individuals;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H96ED9739BCAC490981F133459208DAC1"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the periodicity for data collection that takes into account the differences between health care practices among impacted individuals who are—</text> <clause id="H25D6144F54BE4C809BFF4A507CED0126"><enum>(i)</enum><text>members of the Armed Forces on active duty or spouses or dependents of such members;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H9B2B5F17B4604BD998CEA0E8FA674456"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>members of the Armed Forces separating from active duty or spouses or dependents of such members;</text></clause> <clause id="H00E4799696F54CE982D617FBB98048BA"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>veterans and other individuals with access to health care from the Department of Veterans Affairs; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="H6EBD9319B9A847848DC71CD65450DC96"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>individuals without access to health care from the Department of Defense or the Department of Veterans Affairs;</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HEAA0AFE1E54147399754C0CB90C5CA05"><enum>(D)</enum><text>a description of methodologies to analyze data received from the study or studies to determine possible connections between exposure to water contaminated during the Red Hill Incident and adverse impacts to the health of impacted individuals;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HEFAE4BA163E24AB0AF6AD5439ADE20DA"><enum>(E)</enum><text>an identification of exposures resulting from the Red Hill Incident that may qualify individuals to be eligible for participation in the study or studies as a result of those exposures; </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H55DFD3EC9E614B079340F6B0A644B33E"><enum>(F)</enum><text>steps that will be taken to provide individuals impacted by the Red Hill Incident with information on available resources and services; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HBAFD6DB3076E40EA8C1F64723C357627"><enum>(G)</enum><text>a final determination on whether it is feasible to conduct an epidemiological health outcomes study.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H07D9D746991449EA94FCF3B1DC9CDB20"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Notifications; briefings</header><text>If the Secretary determines, upon completion of the feasibility assessment under paragraph (2), that an epidemiological health outcomes study is feasible and necessary, not later than one year after the completion of the feasibility assessment under paragraph (2), the Secretary shall—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H4904217CE36A4235AA938414267F4A42"><enum>(A)</enum><text>notify impacted individuals on the interim findings of the study or studies; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H960B8B3BE4B242EC9412DF9A3C50835C"><enum>(B)</enum><text>brief the appropriate congressional committees on the interim findings of the study or studies.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HC096BBEB4AEF4EAE86B704462FBF3CA9"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section:</text> <paragraph id="HF6A579FFFE9D4A78B6CF03DFA58A6BF3" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Appropriate congressional committees</header><text>The term <term>appropriate congressional committees</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HF33F69D47A754475B17481F0965C4FD5" commented="no"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services and the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H1448B5144CBF44E79BF4F8A2FB9CFABD" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Committee on Veterans’ Affairs of the Senate;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H8876053681454C7380C62D11BD236421" commented="no"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of the Senate; </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HBEC63091DCFF4116ABD5B9E90DC03231" commented="no"><enum>(D)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services and the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives; </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HDA0CC90418FC44C4BBCE34B770577273" commented="no"><enum>(E)</enum><text>the Committee on Veterans’ Affairs of the House of Representatives; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H695469F2993B474692F4B8AFAE14015F"><enum>(F)</enum><text>the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H10ABCB4F54EE4271865369C2DBA6E825"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Impacted individual</header><text>The term <term>impacted individual</term> means an individual who, at the time of the Red Hill Incident, lived or worked in a building or residence served by the community water system at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, Oahu, Hawaii.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HCF3874523334433EBDDC052131635754"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Red Hill Incident</header><text>The term <term>Red Hill Incident</term> means the release of fuel from the Red Hill Bulk Fuel Storage Facility, Oahu, Hawaii, into the sole-source basal aquifer located 100 feet below the facility, contaminating the community water system at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam on November 20, 2021.</text></paragraph></subsection></section></subtitle></title>

<section id="HF4BD01C15A5A419FBBD6E47EF5682D60" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1101.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Diversity, equity, and inclusion personnel grade cap</header> 
<subsection id="HFDDFF3B00BB944799CDC9D2249A5A9E6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary concerned may not appoint to, or otherwise employ in, any position with primary duties as described in subsection (b) a civilian employee paid annual pay at a rate that exceeds the equivalent of the rate payable for GS–10, not adjusted for locality.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HA3A3C3BDBDFC4279B3A3C46A1F0D19BC" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Covered duties</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The duties referred to in subsection (a) are as follows:</text> 
<paragraph id="H31CA66036CD0498582D598D87BC7A19A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Developing, refining, and implementing diversity, equity, and inclusion policy.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE063E4902020430BA31302C344D57C97" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Leading working groups and councils to developing diversity, equity, and inclusion goals and objectives to measure performance and outcomes.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8E9EE2F628C64CA9BE95A0C74865E0C8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Creating and implementing diversity, equity, and inclusion education, training courses, and workshops for military and civilian personnel.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HA23C04F18DBF4A3695C79D7D0AB50353" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Applicability to current employees</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Any civilian employee appointed to a position with duties described in subsection (b) who is paid annual pay at a rate that exceeds the amount allowed under subsection (a) shall be reassigned to another position not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act. </text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H02121059804E46D3B4F91A0EA23184EF" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1102.</enum><header>Authorization to pay a living quarters allowance for Department of the Navy civilian employees assigned to permanent duty in Guam for performing work, or supporting work being performed, aboard or dockside, of U.S. naval vessels</header> 
<subsection id="HA98F2FEE258D4B4387A4F2553D1E4BAC"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Allowance</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">When Government owned or rented quarters are not otherwise provided without charge to a covered employee, the Secretary of the Navy may grant to a covered employee one or more of the following allowances:</text> <paragraph id="HD556EAF8205D4038AF7B5BEEC1282422"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A living quarters allowance for rent, heat, light, fuel, gas, electricity, and water. The Secretary is authorized to pay such allowance by reimbursement or by advance payments.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9662CD231B8149E7B1408980237754FD"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Under unusual circumstances, as determined by the Secretary, payment or reimbursement for extraordinary, necessary, and reasonable expenses, not otherwise compensated for, incurred in initial repairs, alterations, and improvements to the privately leased residence in Guam of a covered employee—</text> <subparagraph id="H1267954AE14842DD927F16768763E10F"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the expenses are administratively approved in advance; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HCEF220AA2C2A4AA28383A9C87DD0168A"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the duration and terms of the lease justify payment of the expenses by the Government.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H76EBFE2D6AFF4FE5A0E88C55735720BD"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Covered employee defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section, the term <quote>covered employee</quote> means any civilian employee of the Department of the Navy who is assigned to permanent duty in Guam for performing work or supporting work being performed, aboard or dockside, of U.S. naval vessels.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="HABDB04F9F822448292F55EF67210C8CC"><enum>1103.</enum><header>Consolidation of direct hire authorities for candidates with specified degrees at science and technology reinvention laboratories</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 4091 of title 10, United States Code, is amended—</text> <paragraph id="HBC911107BE5F4A60AA65B064B2C04B3E"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in subsection (a)(1), by striking <quote>bachelor’s degree</quote> and inserting <quote>bachelor’s or advanced degree</quote>;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H29786CD75B274B5E9329611FC157121D"><enum>(2)</enum><text>in subsection (c)—</text> <subparagraph id="HC3DA050C1B1A4B218DD07E642E881877"><enum>(A)</enum><text>in the subsection heading, by striking <quote><header-in-text level="subsection" style="OLC">calendar year</header-in-text></quote> and inserting <quote><header-in-text level="subsection" style="OLC">fiscal year</header-in-text></quote>;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HA0FBB30DDD8D4DF0A68EEB5C4BB633B9"><enum>(B)</enum><text>in the matter preceding paragraph (1), by striking <quote>calendar year</quote> and inserting <quote>fiscal year</quote>;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H007E9DBC6CE443A9821DC47CB2BEDA34"><enum>(C)</enum><text>in paragraph (1), by striking <quote>6 percent</quote> and inserting <quote>11 percent</quote>; and</text></subparagraph>

<quoted-block style="USC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HBEFACD26DB01428191FE14F6887620A5"> 
<section id="H1CD5DA3CB0D0424E867C272E3A2FE090" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>127d.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Support of special operations for irregular warfare</header> 
<subsection id="H6DBC4C8A6B154D2A91CD1B99C4380F31" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense may, with the concurrence of the relevant Chief of Mission, expend up to $20,000,000 during any fiscal year to provide support to foreign forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals engaged in supporting or facilitating ongoing and authorized irregular warfare operations by United States Special Operations Forces.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H8CC4C23AF7B74884AA532DCE951EB440" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Funds</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Funds for support under this section in a fiscal year shall be derived from amounts authorized to be appropriated for that fiscal year for the Department of Defense for operation and maintenance.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA4C684D3D5FB46CCA483CA7F8D3169E8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Procedures</header> 
<paragraph id="H3C0768DB3BB2413DB153A4E752B00CAA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The authority in this section shall be exercised in accordance with such procedures as the Secretary shall establish for purposes of this section.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6886B6E6FE5B4A448F04CA9E60B4BD44" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The procedures required under paragraph (1) shall establish, at a minimum, the following:</text> 
<subparagraph id="HD344E6E902454742A6FD5CF191487C05" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Policy guidance for the execution of, and constraints within, activities under the authority in this section.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H54DAA09704E242FBB44B2657C21A2961" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The processes through which activities under the authority in this section are to be developed, validated, and coordinated, as appropriate, with relevant entities of the United States Government.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE37D92C831684DC383727937B6D90120" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The processes through which legal reviews and determinations are made to comply with the authority in this section and ensure that the exercise of such authority is consistent with the national security of the United States.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H674FFC185DF14016B5FF3E60CCBC5821" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The processes to ensure, to the extent practicable, that before a decision to provide support is made, the recipients of support do not pose a counterintelligence or force protection threat and have not engaged in gross violations of human rights.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H90499FFFDF434B468F25BF0723AA80F2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The processes by which the Department shall keep the congressional defense committees fully and currently informed of—</text> <clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H90472F1DD61E40ABAD3350C6212C66C8"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the requirements for the use of the authority in this section; and</text></clause> 
<clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3169E07FADBE4C9EA2E5C04FCDF74649"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">activities conducted under such authority.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5377BBC5B53242ECA11DFD503D266B9E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notice to Congress on procedures and material modifications</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary shall notify the congressional defense committees of the procedures established pursuant to this section before any exercise of the authority in this section, and shall notify such committee of any material modification of the procedures.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H4BE4820F42944945A1F9BCC5D234827C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Construction of authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section shall be construed to constitute a specific statutory authorization for any of the following:</text> <paragraph id="H1FC33A5399E54AF2973F605AB6A60CA0" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The conduct of a covert action, as such term is defined in section 503(e) of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3093">50 U.S.C. 3093(e)</external-xref>).</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB704C3BBFB794818873D19406801894D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The introduction of United States Armed Forces (including as such term is defined in section 8(c) of the War Powers Resolution ( <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/1547">50 U.S.C. 1547(c)</external-xref>)) into hostilities or into situations wherein hostilities are clearly indicated by the circumstances.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HAA4561E90F7645AB96C9CABE493A7827" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The provision of support to regular forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals for the conduct of operations that United States Special Operations Forces are not otherwise legally authorized to conduct themselves.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8D880F84373342F7AEB195BD630D5465" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The conduct or support of activities, directly or indirectly, that are inconsistent with the laws of armed conflict. </text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H45D885A611F74A1C99B7678072281D29" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation on delegation</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The authority of the Secretary to make funds available under this section for support of a military operation may not be delegated.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HC543B9870F7C490F95EDAB7E435CE08B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(f)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Programmatic and policy oversight</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Assistant Secretary of Defense for Special Operations and Low-Intensity Conflict shall have primary programmatic and policy oversight within the Office of the Secretary of Defense of support to irregular warfare activities authorized by this section. </text></subsection> <subsection id="H6BAD89D0EBB04C118009A36E48349802" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(g)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notification</header> <paragraph id="H490083B8002B47B9AD7B38E41F264F7C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 15 days before exercising the authority in this section to make funds available to initiate support of an ongoing and authorized operation or changing the scope or funding level of any support under this section for such an operation by $500,000 or an amount equal to 10 percent of such funding level (whichever is less), the Secretary shall notify the congressional defense committees of the use of such authority with respect to such operation. Any such notification shall be in writing.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H1C14C1FDD1A545249F955A459ACFDBCE" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A notification required by this subsection shall include the following:</text> <subparagraph id="HD37D3ECF89474CDD8C15338CB49FEA98" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The type of support to be provided to United States Special Operations Forces, and a description of the ongoing and authorized operation to be supported.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HD8DDCD65BB5D4164871297474F1E84F7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of the foreign forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals engaged in supporting or facilitating the ongoing and authorized operation that is to be the recipient of funds.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HE72BA5FD4E8644B28ADD02676CBBCF14" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The type of support to be provided to the recipient of the funds, and a description of the end-use monitoring to be used in connection with the use of the funds.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HED649F087A724319ACE26EDAF5E5749B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The amount obligated under the authority to provide support.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H9C73E32D015A465897886AEF9C1AD028" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The duration for which the support is expected to be provided, and an identification of the timeframe in which the provision of support will be reviewed by the commander of the applicable combatant command for a determination with respect to the necessity of continuing such support.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE96A11DC65AB4E1A8856EFF4666925DE" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(F)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The determination of the Secretary that the provision of support does not constitute any of the following:</text> <clause id="H8534D9AFC0B9408D955DC9BF05A91E31" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An introduction of United States Armed Forces (including as such term is defined in section 8(c) of the War Powers Resolution (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/1547">50 U.S.C. 1547(c)</external-xref>)) into hostilities, or into situations where hostilities are clearly indicated by the circumstances, without specific statutory authorization within the meaning of section 5(b) of such Resolution (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/1544">50 U.S.C. 1544(b)</external-xref>).</text></clause> 
<clause id="HE90176750E244BE98947CB719EDA1478" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A covert action, as such term is defined in section 503(e) of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3093">50 U.S.C. 3093(e)</external-xref>).</text></clause> <clause id="H7F74BBE3F6214B5EB6F6186C2EC2952D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An authorization for the provision of support to regular forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals for the conduct of operations that United States Special Operations Forces are not otherwise legally authorized to conduct themselves.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H1A973FF44881404193A391F1882BBC41" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iv)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The conduct or support of activities, directly or indirectly, that are inconsistent with the laws of armed conflict. </text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H8C841AC85D4B4C4BA81EED9E909AD210" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(h)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notification of suspension or termination of support</header> <paragraph id="HD9D4CB304B264BCCB361B10E634E1916" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 48 hours after suspending or terminating support to any foreign force, irregular force, group, or individual provided pursuant to the authority in this section, the Secretary shall submit to the congressional defense committees a written notice of such suspension or termination.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9DBD501B6F6B4E739C21D583BACDEFA9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The written notice required by paragraph (1) shall include each of the following:</text> <subparagraph id="HA3981E7093E84E9D85C069AF9E354091" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of the reasons for the suspension or termination of such support.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H5A2563BC2E3541EE9FAD182D17550C17" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of any effect on regional, theater, or global campaign plan objectives anticipated to result from such suspension or termination.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HB1832A66741E4616A994576FF39815FD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A plan for such suspension or termination, and, in the case of support that is planned to be transitioned to any other program of the Department of Defense or to a program of any other Federal department or agency, a detailed description of the transition plan, including the resources, equipment, capabilities, and personnel associated with such plan.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBF7DDF5C3FCB4256932557984DF0AB52" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Biannual reports</header> 
<paragraph id="H8C7263CEF8D74626BA1DA49A75828D35" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report on preceding fiscal year</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 120 days after the close of each fiscal year in which subsection (a) is in effect, the Secretary shall submit to the congressional defense committees a report on the support provided under this section during the preceding fiscal year.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H27965AA5A2994B82BC7432E59155E486" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report on current calendar year</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline"> Not later than 180 days after the submittal of each report required by paragraph (1), the Secretary shall submit to the congressional defense committees a report on the support provided under this section during the first half of the fiscal year in which the report under this paragraph is submitted.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE5BE8001E6F84FC4BBB65B0AD4267B75" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each report required by this subsection shall include the following:</text> <subparagraph id="H9886CB2FCEBD4482989E64AA91B718BD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A summary of the ongoing irregular warfare operations, and associated authorized campaign plans, being conducted by United States Special Operations Forces that were supported or facilitated by foreign forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals for which support was provided under this section during the period covered by such report.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H05711FA46F504AD0B9124CDCCB0D2E4B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of the support or facilitation provided by such foreign forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals to United States Special Operations Forces during such period.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H11E9913932AE4BFA86760AA5C7835532" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The type of recipients that were provided support under this section during such period, identified by authorized category (foreign forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals).</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H8A7B750BDB684F0DA3317149751E8772" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A detailed description of the support provided to the recipients under this section during such period.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H96DBF3FAE36F4E2CB54AB9349382889D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The total amount obligated for support under this section during such period, including budget details.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC94BCAEDA9734F1EB346C31BB314589E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(F)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The intended duration of support provided under this section during such period.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HB1CAED46EFE445F1B5F99550A197C778" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(G)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment of value of the support provided under this section during such period, including a summary of significant activities undertaken by foreign forces, irregular forces, groups, or individuals to support irregular warfare operations by United States Special Operations Forces.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H143F1D64531B44908382C2EA9E69F4EB" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(H)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The total amount obligated for support under this section in prior fiscal years.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HE34CC1340E494170B03EE40234E18AE3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(j)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Quarterly briefings</header> <paragraph id="H5CAFE7AB6D6F4BA08C57694DE612872F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not less frequently than quarterly, the Secretary shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the use of the authority provided by this section, and other matters relating to irregular warfare, with the primary purposes of—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1CB6355330194E7FB8DC4CE7957E815E"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">keeping the congressional defense committees fully and currently informed of irregular warfare requirements and activities, including emerging combatant commands requirements; and </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H159FBB57BA44480CB779CBFE3B41D80A"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">consulting with the congressional defense committees regarding such matters.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HAB12F919E57C46DA91D3589E09D16819" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each briefing required by paragraph (1) shall include the following:</text> <subparagraph id="HA3B1405A1010471FBB2DD17BC1F7139D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An update on irregular warfare activities within each geographic combatant command and a description of the manner in which such activities support the respective theater campaign plan and the National Defense Strategy.</text></subparagraph>

<subparagraph id="HEED5B9BF74B14E188EFE5E65628B4E68"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>In engaging in research and development projects pursuant to subsection (a) of section 4001 of this title by a contract, cooperative agreement, or grant pursuant to subsection (b)(1) of such section, the Secretary of Defense may enter into such contract or cooperative agreement, or award such grant, through the Defense Security Cooperation University.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H0F4C2AA9D0C948ADA44EA466C8A4BE06"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Treatment as government-operated federal laboratory</header><text>The Defense Security Cooperation University shall be considered a Government-operated Federal laboratory for purposes of section 12 of the Stevenson-Wydler Technology Innovation Act of 1980 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/3710a">15 U.S.C. 3710a</external-xref>).</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HDF23270E5E55464F91C11D99D4A3F2AA"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Acceptance of research grants</header> 
<subparagraph id="H1C69C8B8C04748148B6BCE04471A7E13"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The Secretary of Defense, through the Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, may authorize the President of the Defense Security Cooperation University to accept qualifying research grants. <subparagraph id="H2B5AA9D5BD8B4AEA91C419DB2378F765"><enum>(C)</enum><header>Entities from which grants may be accepted</header><text>A grant may be accepted under this paragraph only from a corporation, fund, foundation, educational institution, or similar entity that is organized and operated primarily for scientific, literary, or educational purposes.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HBA355322833B41A08492885D37180D68"><enum>(D)</enum><header>Administration of grant funds</header><text>The Director of the Defense Security Cooperation Agency shall establish an account for administering funds received as research grants under this section. The President of the Defense Security Cooperation University shall use the funds in the account in accordance with applicable provisions of the regulations and the terms and condition of the grants received.</text></subparagraph>

Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/117/263">Public Law 117–263</external-xref>) is amended by striking <quote>None of the funds</quote> and all that follows through <quote>2023</quote> and inserting <quote>None of the funds authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2023 or 2024</quote>.</text></section> <section id="H2F85F698BE654C0C97FB8AE495DF2614" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1245.</enum><header>Study and report on lessons learned regarding information operations and deterrence</header> <subsection id="HDBA02D28DB3E4335876A171A5E49AEF6"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Study</header> <paragraph id="HCD0FF9993F6848A79E65003110A665CF"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The Secretary of Defense shall seek to enter into a contract or other agreement with an eligible entity to conduct an independent study on lessons learned from information operations conducted by the United States, Ukraine, the Russian Federation, and member countries of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization during the lead-up to the Russian Federation’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and throughout the conflict.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCE06FBF5772848D6B613DE88B3FCF7E9"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Elements</header><text>The study required by paragraph (1) shall include—</text> <subparagraph id="HE3DAAA98193F4017A065D958D5B941A8"><enum>(A)</enum><text>an assessment of information operations capabilities of the Russian Federation prior to, and since, the full-scale invasion of Ukraine;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC8CED1D7703A4720BE88CF4D04C0FD7F"><enum>(B)</enum><text>an assessment of notable successes or challenges with regard to the information operations conducted by the United States, NATO member countries, and Ukraine prior to, and since, the full-scale invasion of Ukraine; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H26F0375B982D4848AA978EE943575384"><enum>(C)</enum><text>recommendations for improvements to United States information operations to enhance effectiveness, as well as recommendations on how information operations may be improved to support the maintenance of deterrence.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2245E73414BF4F86AF08305D2CA9AA87"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Report</header> 
<paragraph id="H620B9A1CB417453D95A6B16D3140FC75"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, Secretary of Defense shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives a report on the results of the study required by subsection (a) in its entirety, along with any such comments as the Secretary considers relevant.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6DCCD2357C1349A5BB9050159D31DDA7"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Form</header><text>The report required by paragraph (1) shall be submitted in unclassified form but may include a classified annex.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H52C10AA692D7443F8AC4AA161B887550"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Eligible entity defined</header><text>In this section, the term <quote>eligible entity</quote> means—</text> <paragraph id="H4D73F5A0472F4B8294EE2E1341C99016"><enum>(1)</enum><text>a federally funded research and development center; or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD828234887114D1DA496A76310416CF0"><enum>(2)</enum><text>an independent, nongovernmental institute described in <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/26/501">section 501(c)(3)</external-xref> of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such Code that has recognized credentials and expertise in national security and military affairs appropriate for the assessment.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H1BB8312AE72A4DE3B6ABA1A0C281CD79" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1246.</enum><header>Prohibition on New START treaty information sharing</header> <subsection id="H5FBA6712B1834F63A89972C37BF8DC27"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Prohibition</header><text>None of the funds authorized to be appropriated by this Act or otherwise made available for fiscal year 2024 for the Department of Defense may be made available to provide the Russian Federation with notifications as required by the New START Treaty.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H05F9FD1DE049402992782EA610D851F2"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Waiver</header><text>The Secretary of Defense, with the concurrence of the Secretary of State, may waive the prohibition in subsection (a) if the Secretary of Defense certifies to the appropriate congressional committees in writing that—</text> <paragraph id="HB858D2B6AC8648D38CDC96453D319103"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the Russian Federation is providing similar information to the United States as required by the New START Treaty; or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE341B9A8D4544858B2168ACACA25B29F"><enum>(2)</enum><text>it is in the national security interest of the United States to unilaterally provide such notifications to the Russian Federation</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HB66A3848C6FB45C3A341238148B81ABF"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section—</text> 
<paragraph id="HE86D5CB33B064D348CD8BF19471F8FF0"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the term <quote>appropriate congressional committees</quote> means—</text> <subparagraph id="H98E7470C50C845EB93DDA85917ADE8C4"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services and the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE452090278DB4BD4ABF46376015672B2"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services and the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate; and</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD0CF7451FE434D7EB827C31976AB15A5"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the term <quote>New START Treaty</quote> means the Treaty between the United States of America and the Russian Federation on Measures for the Further Reduction and Limitation of Strategic Offensive Arms, signed at Prague April 8, 2010, and entered into force February 5, 2011.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H2B6EFE95C4CD43C4BDCAE470D90EB968" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1247.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Black Sea security and development strategy</header> 
<subsection id="H252FD130EE5C430096EE83CA65EE377F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The President shall direct the National Security Council to develop an interagency strategy with regard to the Black Sea region and Black Sea states—</text> <paragraph id="H140E97C79DEC4F959ABF69B249FFE0E4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to increase coordination with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and the European Union;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HEB47EE27F8C142C981419EF81FEB830A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to deepen economic ties;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HEB0B5085D210487DBAD2C452DD738A02" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to strengthen energy security;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HAABCE53975D14E1080D760B2294FE980" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to support efforts to bolster their democratic resilience; and </text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD8E753186D2641A8B35D962E85EA3378" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to enhance security assistance with regional partners in accordance with the values and interests of the United States.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE5EDE602EE6640188C93F135E0055845" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Purpose and objectives</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The strategy authorized under subsection (b) shall have the following goals and objectives:</text> <paragraph id="HBE4165B1B42B4961BC30CAD1AE2320A2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Ensuring the efficient and effective delivery of security assistance to regional partners in accordance with the values and interests of the United States, prioritizing assistance that will bolster defenses, increase regional cooperation on Black Sea security, and improve interoperability with NATO forces. </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HBE899ABA4CF34FD0BDA9C2B976E2AF9D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Bolstering United States support for the region’s energy security and integration with Europe and reducing the region’s dependence on Russia while supporting energy diversification. </text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H62B44262711B4B338F3487DA317B77E1"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Working with partners and allies to mitigate the impact of economic coercion by the Russian Federation and the People’s Republic of China on Black Sea states and identifying new opportunities for foreign direct investment from the United States and cooperating countries and the enhancement of United States business ties with regional partners in accordance with the values and interests of the United States. </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H951A4ED873CF4AC7B32C497D35552DB6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Increasing high-level engagement between the United States and regional partners, including reinforcing economic growth, infrastructure development, and enhancing trade with a focus on improving high-level economic cooperation.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H2FC17B5884CA4BBE89E1D61754EA5522" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Increasing United States coordination with the European Union and NATO member states to maximize effectiveness and minimize duplication. </text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H76A0ED307CFE470B973EB271162D81E0" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Activities</header> 
<paragraph id="HC9A9B45382B542B6B83992FD90631B0B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Security</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The strategy authorized under subsection (b) should include the following elements related to security:</text> <subparagraph id="H29602B17804D43649C7115A651F295B0" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A plan to increase interagency coordination on the Black Sea region.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC223146AAAC6458A9AA1C14D74CE28ED"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A plan to coordinate and synchronize security assistance with Black Sea states, focused on Ukraine, Romania, Bulgaria, Moldova, and Georgia, with the aim of increasing regional cooperation on Black Sea security.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H869F4A9B62B64A409D0663ED9104AF26"><enum>(C)</enum><text>A plan to enhance collaboration with Black Sea states to recognize and respond to Russian disinformation and propaganda in the Black Sea region.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H4267109F9BFF4C2882D19682A159E1F2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Economic prosperity</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The strategy authorized under subsection (b) shall include the following elements related to economic prosperity:</text> <subparagraph id="HCDAFDC05252342358DA0E759EEBBA17C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A strategy to foster dialogue between experts from the United States and from the Black Sea states on economic expansion, foreign direct investment, strengthening rule of law initiatives, and mitigating economic coercion by the Russian Federation and the People’s Republic of China.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0182DB6626CC4F6494D26B094F3D6444" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A strategy for all the relevant Federal departments and agencies that contribute to United States economic statecraft to expand their presence and identify new opportunities for private investment with regional partners in accordance with the values and interests of the United States. </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H80D7A9EE23C7492E976AD163D94B7DDB" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Assessments on energy security, focusing on the immediate need to replace energy supplies from the Russian Federation, and recognizing the long-term importance of broader energy diversification.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HCBFAECCC6709431699D3EB1E4FA6EB2C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Assessments of potential food security solutions, including sustainable, long-term arrangements.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H35E37653602A4951A032CCF4C59A6DE6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Democratic resilience</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The strategy authorized under subsection (b) shall include the following elements related to democratic resilience:</text> 
<subparagraph id="HC9DFB9AEF4744B4CBC6D1D829F139BA1"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A plan to increase independent media and United States-supported media initiatives to combat foreign malign influence in the Black Sea region.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H53D6F042E4F44D30BA37692695E4D641"><enum>(B)</enum><text>A plan to increase mobilization of initiatives spearheaded by the Department of State and the United States Agency for International Development to counter Russian propaganda and disinformation in the Black Sea region.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H1C0A1871E5E94346BED2998F25760D78" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Identification of necessary authorities and budgetary resources</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The President shall identify any necessary authorities or budgetary resources required, by agency, to support the implementation of the strategy for fiscal years 2025 and 2026.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H15AF6DEC717B4826B45C0332E698F578"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Submission of strategy and resource assessment</header><text>The President shall submit to the appropriate committees of Congress—</text> 
<paragraph id="HDF31731919B543C7AD13AD6932404E27"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the strategy authorized by subsection (b) not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE9620BDA00244584A55A5F7B5B78AFCD"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the authority and resourcing assessment required by subsection (d) not later than 360 days after such date of enactment.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HF5AA75A1DB39412CA4C706B46280153F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(f)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Definitions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section:</text> <paragraph id="H9E91E7CFF3B74EDA9DF4447C2D268DFA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Appropriate committees of Congress</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>appropriate committees of Congress</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HAF10061EA6C141199F33FE855AA97289" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the <committee-name committee-id="">Committee on Foreign Relations, the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Appropriations, the Select Committee on Intelligence, </committee-name>and the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources of the Senate; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H04513F72BE9A4ADA8F45F7237320B39D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the <committee-name committee-id="">Committee on Foreign Affairs, the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Appropriations</committee-name>, the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD4FE107D38EA4ECBAEA7076B6FC73762" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Black Sea states</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>Black Sea states</term> means—</text> <subparagraph id="HF9522FC3B7034CB4A76E0E07C60E6E3F"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Bulgaria;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HB984187A829F4F538AF2746146B523D3"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Georgia;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H786A19D32CE64FB7B2F6B9FA258A746B"><enum>(C)</enum><text>Moldova;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H81D1DB1DD512438CA15CD27300D6319E"><enum>(D)</enum><text>Romania;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H193CEC96625E44A1A6C1C41E2BAB3A2A"><enum>(E)</enum><text>Turkey; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H5250E361307D49488F7562EFF0987110"><enum>(F)</enum><text>Ukraine.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H528C818F71A94143863D85CB7D32C85F"><enum>1248.</enum><header>Revival of authority for participation of NATO naval personnel in submarine safety programs</header> <subsection id="H578BECD663694F078128DD22D1241264"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Subsection (e) of section 8634 of title 10, United States Code, is repealed.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H79E9432EC65E4434A1BE22EF6A931990"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Conforming amendment</header><text>Subsection (a) of such section 8634 is amended by striking <quote>the Secretary of the Navy may conduct a program</quote> and inserting <quote>the Secretary of the Navy may conduct a program beginning on or after the date of the enactment of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024</quote>.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H4AB66A594B4B459E8A4094D4B0B56E30" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1249.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Extension and modification of training for Eastern European national security forces in the course of multilateral exercises</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 1251 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2016 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/333">10 U.S.C. 333</external-xref> note) is amended—</text>
