<subparagraph id="H9D5ED3DBAB694C1D8164C8888A6BDA3C"><enum>(C)</enum><text>by striking paragraph (3).</text></subparagraph></paragraph></section> <section id="H5154A77947344275B0F61CDB4A12A297" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1512.</enum><header>Cybersecurity enhancements for nuclear command, control, and communications network</header> <subsection id="HD6521FA614B24C2CA3D8779A52C9CE39"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment of cross-functional team</header> <paragraph id="H422A12ACBE6C493F8F4C5D14A65D9556"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, and consistent with section 911(c) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2017 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/114/328">Public Law 114–328</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/111">10 U.S.C. 111</external-xref> note), the Secretary of Defense shall establish a cross-functional team to develop and direct the implementation of a threat-driven cyber defense construct for the systems and networks that support the nuclear command, control, and communications (commonly referred to as <quote>NC3</quote>) mission (in this section referred to as the <quote>cross-functional team</quote>). </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8CAC6E61BF774C768ACAA2B3A6E84FBD"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Composition of cross-functional team</header> 
<subparagraph id="H289B031DCEE4490EA2CDC138DCF65BAC"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The cross functional team shall be composed of senior officers selected from among each of the military departments, the Defense Information Systems Agency, the National Security Agency, the United States Cyber Command, the United States Strategic Command, and any other organization or element of the Department of Defense determined appropriate by the Secretary.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H375A269A17C342F784C9DB4E83147DE4"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Leadership</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary shall designate a senior officer from those selected under subparagraph (A) to serve as the leader of the cross-functional team.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H3FFA9CF416C040F58A4E9EC695E90049"><enum>(C)</enum><header>Staff</header><text>The Secretary shall ensure the heads of the organizations and elements specified in subparagraph (A) detail staff to support the cross-functional team in carrying out the duties under paragraph (3).</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H25F20EB2048E4B94A0981E61961C308A"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Duties</header><text>The duties of the cross-functional team shall be to enhance the cyber defense of the systems and networks that support the nuclear command, control, and communications mission.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HEFE453127D5D41C3BEEF9887D5D50679"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Required construct, plan of action, and milestones</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the leader of the cross-functional team designated pursuant to subsection (a)(2)(B) shall develop a threat-driven cyber defense construct, and associated plans and milestones, to enhance the security of the systems and networks that support the nuclear command, control, and communications mission. Such construct shall be based on—</text> <paragraph id="H421049AD7A1742A1AF4F6E66C2F34F4D"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the application of the principles of the approach to cybersecurity commonly referred to as <quote>zero trust architecture</quote>;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H932E5B3CE4FD455E8452F8B03D466FB0"><enum>(2)</enum><text>an analysis of appropriately comprehensive endpoint and network telemetry data; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H35CA5F61A447418781C5BAD35298A328"><enum>(3)</enum><text>control capabilities enabling rapid investigation and remediation of indicators of compromise and threats to mission execution.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA56B7A44234F43D4A6EAF2368851BFA9"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Annual briefings</header><text>During the 60-day period beginning on the date that is 30 days before the date on which the President submits to Congress the budget of the President pursuant to section 1105(a) of title 31, United States Code, for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2028, the Secretary shall provide to the appropriate congressional committees a briefing on the implementation of this section. </text></subsection> <subsection id="HB99E3B30664C43E780ADA100A0DCAB42"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Termination</header> <paragraph id="HFDB4898C8C7C40AAA9216B12CB3BF781"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Except as provided in paragraph (2), the cross-functional team under this section shall terminate on October 31, 2028.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA2E37EEE3CE84AA6B00AA83646E4FCB1"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Extension authority</header><text>The Secretary of Defense may extend the date of termination under paragraph (1) as the Secretary determines appropriate.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H74B358A3C8C54F82AB7F631B3D915CCA"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Appropriate congressional committees defined</header><text>In this section, the term <quote>appropriate congressional committees</quote> means—</text> 
<paragraph id="H7557EE256D044D478B86996B682E3E3A"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the congressional defense committees; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H057081556CC947F9914D3921117FEC22"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H4B1035DAD8904EE48B10BB5B55847BB8" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1513.</enum><header>Pilot program relating to semiconductor supply chain and Cybersecurity Collaboration Center</header> 
<subsection id="H5DC24C077AAD459EBD32E390357A9ED6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense, in coordination with the Director of the National Security Agency, shall commence the conduct of a pilot program under which the Cybersecurity Collaboration Center of the National Security Agency may collaborate with, including by entering into contracts or other agreements with, eligible persons under subsection (c), for the purpose of assessing the feasibility and advisability of improving the cybersecurity of the semiconductor supply chain (in this section referred to as the <quote>pilot program</quote>). </text></subsection> <subsection id="HC7166E2295E84D17A14748B2A3C46490" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Program objectives</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Under the pilot program, the Secretary of Defense shall seek to improve the cybersecurity of the supply chain for the design, manufacturing, assembly, packaging, and testing of semiconductors, including through the following:</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H210716CEAD7D44A6B7D6E84281EACF08"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Improving the cybersecurity of processes for such design, manufacturing, assembly, packaging, and testing.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H921A5D5C3F47462997159F101DAE3B2B"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Protecting against cyber-driven intellectual property theft with respect to such design, manufacturing, assembly, packaging, and testing.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H8D3AE284C7AE4807A518EDBF4D4591F7"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Reducing the risk of disruptions caused by cyberattacks to the supply chain for such design, manufacturing, assembly, packaging, and testing.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HC814E7160C3F40898AD8806DAD2B4579" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Eligibility</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A person is eligible to participate in the pilot program if such person—</text> 
<paragraph id="HE0C5CA26E093480E801F341DCA54FB96"><enum>(1)</enum><text>directly supports the design, manufacturing, assembly, packaging, or testing of semiconductors within the United States; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H32A70E1F180544048A39A6B8958257CF"><enum>(2)</enum><text>provides semiconductor components for the Department of Defense, any national security system (as such term is defined in section 3552(b) of title 44, United States Code), or the defense industrial base.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HCA66BB86A8004EA1AE453F3D245708D6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Briefings</header> 
<paragraph id="H18D96215BF574F00AD2DC83E4FCD5E3E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Initial briefing</header> 
<subparagraph id="H0093C73735684A53B92275CBF7740010" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall provide to the appropriate congressional committees an initial briefing on the pilot program.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H1E32B0C1B152498C8B64087282621DD0" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The briefing under subparagraph (A) shall include the following:</text> 
<clause id="H6CF2E8DCEE0742978878219984C9AF88" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of the status of the implementation of the pilot program.</text></clause> <clause id="H521219E4B52D496592DC82FB6E8AC602" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An identification of key priorities for the pilot program.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H00DC6BBD83C14100BFEC8C3CFBD33D18" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An identification of any challenges to implementing the pilot program or impediments to participation in the pilot program by eligible persons under subsection (c).</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE9D623BEBA23465F8F9BFB97A95DE8DF" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Annual briefings</header> <subparagraph id="H9B654C8CA8694F7BB889C941DF754598" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the initial briefing under paragraph (1), and annually thereafter until the date of termination under subsection (f), the Secretary of Defense shall provide to the appropriate congressional committees a briefing on the progress of the pilot program.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HCCFD0E49692E4D89AB980E5FBB71A11E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each briefing under subparagraph (A) shall include the following:</text> <clause id="HD7FA92E26C6C469984BD3DDA1EA06800" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Recommendations for addressing relevant policy, budgetary, security, and legislative gaps to increase the effectiveness of the pilot program, including, with respect to the first briefing under such subparagraph, an assessment of the resources necessary for successful implementation of the pilot program.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H61E0EE6AC848494CBA1C13F0E09E0A35" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Recommendations for increasing participation in the pilot program by eligible persons under subsection (c).</text></clause> <clause id="H9F98C36BBBE3426BB509288962F30D29" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of any challenges encountered in carrying out the pilot program, including any concerns expressed by manufacturers of semiconductors or suppliers of semiconductor components.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H191F62384B524ECCAFFDA0E57155D471" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iv)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The findings of the Secretary, in consultation with the Director of the National Security Agency, with respect to the feasibility and advisability of extending or expanding the pilot program.</text></clause> <clause id="HB00C8D02C0CD465DA0320C8DC41F510D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(v)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Such other matters as the Secretary considers appropriate.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H36495F2045BC438EABB304E557F80ED4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Termination</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The pilot program shall terminate on the date that is four years after the date of the enactment of this Act.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HD9773955C3D54E43B7D1CAE83DCE6390" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(f)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Appropriate congressional committees defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section, the term <term>appropriate congressional committees</term> means—</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HC09D3A9C53B44EA6AD943378AFB39784"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Committee on Armed Services and the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFE63A0E79E5346AE8032F2E2D30F21CE"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Committee on Armed Services and the Select Committee on Intelligence of the Senate.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HAB73EBE2C95D422E9F6E4E296FB2DAC7" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1514.</enum><header>Transfer of data and technology developed under MOSAICS program</header> 
<subsection id="H0CC081E8FC08435CBCAE2040185E95DB"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Transfers authorized</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense may transfer to eligible private sector entities data and technology developed under the MOSAICS program to enhance cyber threat detection and protection of critical industrial control system assets used for electricity distribution.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H0664693A272245359FD0390B8DD1A4B7"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Agreements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In carrying out subsection (a), the Secretary of Defense may—</text> 
<paragraph id="H24385F9F4FAB441483EB53DC968E25ED"><enum>(1)</enum><text>enter into cooperative research and development agreements under section 4026 of title 10, United States Code; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB64871C1CE8848BFB65EF250A935DCF1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>use such other mechanisms for the transfer of technology and data as are authorized by law.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7A232BB5C742422B97B85B15F537A247" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Notification</header><text>Not later than 15 days after any date on which the Secretary determines to transfer data or technology to an eligible private sector entity under subsection (a), the Secretary shall submit to the congressional defense committees a written notification of such determination. Such notification shall include the following:</text> <paragraph id="H98EFF477D03A434B93EEE2E4F3E4BB85" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text>An identification of the data or technology to be transferred.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H287C6D7677084CB18F0D254900170A8A" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An identification of the eligible private sector entity, including an identification of the specific individual employed by or otherwise associated with such entity responsible for the security and integrity of the data or technology to be received.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF05EA3E3C1444A7E8B181BC4193CD7FA" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><text>A detailed description of any special security handling instructions required pursuant to an agreement entered into between the Secretary and the eligible private sector entity for such transfer.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8CA7C86D7BE14D55BE300B47263F8E0F" commented="no"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Timelines associated with such transfer.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HDE9F58EE29134B35A10C398CFBCA4F79"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> 
<paragraph id="H88B4E87D70204361A1601E08CE63A45F"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <quote>eligible private sector entity</quote> means a private sector entity that—</text> <subparagraph id="HDCBDCCB3A66A48CA8D08CD5F03A8C34D"><enum>(A)</enum><text>has functions relevant to the civil electricity sector; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H92E35F7FF63E4DBF90C678F3F3CB67E7"><enum>(B)</enum><text>is determined by the Secretary of Defense to be eligible to receive data and technology transferred under subsection (a). </text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H64229882CA56439B9537EBFC45061B64"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <quote>MOSAICS program</quote> means the program of the Department of Defense known as the <quote>More Situational Awareness for Industrial Control Systems Joint Capabilities Technology Demonstration program</quote>, or successor program.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HFAB1F8AEC7FE4CE1AA68CF73E61E3E8A" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1515.</enum><header>Modernization program for network boundary and cross-domain defense</header> 
<subsection id="HDC67223F8EEE4E51973C934DA643FD9B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Modernization program required</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall carry out a modernization program for network boundary and cross-domain defense against cyber attacks. In carrying out such modernization program, the Secretary shall expand upon the fiscal year 2023 pilot program on modernized network boundary defense capabilities and the initial deployment of such capabilities to the primary Internet access points of the Department of Defense managed by the Director of the Defense Information Systems Agency.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H037E73BD3F8845FE8666E2FB8D9C563E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Program phases</header> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H16B5693D7D4A442483825E2EB04FBD6F"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall implement the modernization program under subsection (a) in phases, with the objective of completing such program by October 1, 2028.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE6D339947C4B4B598F69FDDC68F63D10"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Objectives</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The phases required by paragraph (1) shall include the following objectives:</text> <subparagraph id="H514810A38DA8441C9CF0C1F10D21689D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">By September 30, 2026, completion of—</text> 
<clause id="H15F60F32DFED4F4FBF1F20BC124C5822" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the pilot program specified in subsection (a) and the deployment of modernized network boundary defense capabilities to the Internet access points managed by the Director of the Defense Information Systems Agency; and</text></clause> <clause id="H70331CEE10A542AC89E6E58D1DB4FDE6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the extension of modernized network boundary defense capabilities to all additional Internet access points of the information network of the Department of Defense.</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H1905844CAC7F4E69B82A7B6ACB04054A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">By September 30, 2027, the conduct of a survey, completion of a pilot program, and deployment of modernized network boundary defense capabilities to the access points and cross-domain capabilities of the Secret Internet Protocol Router Network.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H7917238A18264426880F9686452193E6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">By September 30, 2028, the conduct of a survey, completion of a pilot program, and deployment of modernized network boundary defense capabilities to any remaining classified network or enclave of the information network of the Department.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H4D623FB302DB43F99B1E93C0B0588577" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Implementation plan</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall submit to the congressional defense committees a plan for the implementation of the modernization program under subsection (a). Such plan shall include—</text> <paragraph id="H1B48D7AB3CE043D397E155E17BB2A770" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a summary of findings from the pilot program specified in subsection (a); and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6FC0538FAE224FCAAC817D8E846E6B12" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">an identification of the resources necessary for such implementation, including for implementing the phase of the modernization program specified in subsection (b)(2)(C).</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HBDD78FCCABE342CAAA059FC97666A7F9" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1516.</enum><header>Establishment of certain identity, credential, and access management activities as program of record</header> <subsection id="H49D2F36E406149858A68ECF631A64189" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment of program of record</header> <paragraph id="HEDD709D7275748B3AB8B260365A3626E"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Program of record</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in subsection (b), not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall establish a program of record, governed by standard Department of Defense requirements and practices, and transition all covered activities to such program of record.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB12E96E975274B8BAA30DC58530B1AF6"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Objectives</header><text>The program of record under subsection (a) shall include, at a minimum, covered activities undertaken to achieve the following objectives:</text> <subparagraph id="HACF0DD9E2BEE4900AB5B5FF9E507B7F5"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Correcting weaknesses in authentication and credentialing security, including with respect to the program of the Department of Defense known as the <quote>Public Key Infrastructure</quote> program (or any successor program), identified by the Director of Operational Test and Evaluation in a report submitted to Congress in April, 2023, titled <quote>FY14–21 Observations of the Compromise of Cyber Credentials</quote>.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0888989948344DBEAD4673D5283B5CEE"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Implementing improved authentication technologies, such as biometric and behavioral authentication techniques and other non-password-based solutions.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H89FFF29A142B425F921B8C87F590D054"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Briefing</header><text>Not later than 150 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the covered activities to be included under the program of record under subsection (a).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H22112BC9F1814A30BD83CB977D642109" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Waiver authority</header> 
<paragraph id="HEECE06A67DE043B38D473042448AECA0"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Authority</header><text>The Secretary of Defense may waive the requirement under subsection (a) if the Secretary of Defense determines that the objectives listed in paragraph (2) of such subsection would be better achieved, and the level of rigor of the operational testing and oversight requirements applicable to such objectives would be improved, through a management approach other than the establishment of a program of record and transition of covered activities to such program of record.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7052ED48E90948C4BAC95B1C3228EFAA"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Justification</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 14 days after issuing a waiver under paragraph (1), the Secretary of Defense shall submit to the congressional defense committees a detailed justification for the waiver, including—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H5031C4726A6E409A9A92647FA5A9BE24" commented="no"><enum>(A)</enum><text>an explanation of why the establishment of a program of record is not the preferred approach to achieve the objectives listed in subsection (a)(2);</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HB971F198722A44FB93FF20C4CB288740" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>details relating to the management approach proposed to be implemented in lieu of the establishment of a program of record;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HFD10324CE1CE4B5397EBF8FCCF91A992" commented="no"><enum>(C)</enum><text>an implementation plan for such proposed alternative approach; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H0EEA3813D57A4480A670A198FE0123DD" commented="no"><enum>(D)</enum><text>such other information as the Secretary of Defense determines appropriate.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H76761D9B275A441384EEE51C3D5C2A0E" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Designation of data attributes</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense, in coordination with the Secretaries of the military departments, shall complete the designation of Tier 1 level data attributes to be used as a baseline set of standardized attributes for identity, credential, and access management, Defense-wide.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H34D58582AA0D440E8BBC4923AE53A654" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Briefing</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Upon completing the requirement under subsection (c), the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense and the Secretaries of the military departments shall provide to the Committees on Armed Services of the House of Representatives and the Senate a briefing on the activities carried out under this section.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBEFB759271154F72BCDC675564EC692E"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> <paragraph id="H61FA82920C764E5FBF657142F0C63F09"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <quote>covered activity</quote> means any activity of the Office of the Secretary of Defense or a Defense Agency relating to the identity, credential, and access management initiative of the Department of Defense.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA17870392FEC4728BE2AFE064BB10FC4"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The term <quote>Defense Agency</quote> has the meaning given that term in section 101 of title 10, United States Code.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HF504C0812DAA42969761E383497CD5BE" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1517.</enum><header>Pilot program on assuring critical infrastructure support for military contingencies</header> <subsection id="H1D0C392EC801460FB84606BB5A6DC6FF"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment of pilot program</header><text>Not later than 60 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall establish a pilot program to be known as the <quote>Assuring Critical Infrastructure Support for Military Contingencies Pilot Program</quote>.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7A9062254D61413897BE4571D0819B8E"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Selection of installations</header> 
<paragraph id="H40D39B8A4143461F97E2E5F9035314F8"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense, acting through the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Homeland Defense and Hemispheric Affairs, shall select not fewer than four geographically diverse military installations at which to carry out the pilot program under subsection (a).</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7D07B50C8B8C4446A2932699AF72F434"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Prioritization</header> <subparagraph id="H15B5DF6D93F74CD2BBDA9DF092741A9C"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>In selecting military installations under paragraph (1), the Secretary of Defense shall give priority to any military installation that the Secretary determines is a key component of not fewer than two contingency plans or operational plans, with further priority given to such plans in the area of responsibility of the United States Indo-Pacific Command or the United States European Command.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HB431C727AFC141AEBCE94B3049B84CB1"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Selection between equal priorities</header><text>If two or more military installations qualify for equal priority under subparagraph (A), the Secretary of Defense shall give further priority for selection under such paragraph to any such military installation that the Secretary of Defense determines is—</text> <clause id="HA4B9060BF99543B295AC1A16CFE62A04"><enum>(i)</enum><text>connected to national-level infrastructure;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HDE57F3E86707444A9E0AA7EB71F4DACB"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>located near a commercial port; or</text></clause> <clause id="H54BD662BCAFB483288D788649CEF7753"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>located near a national financial hub.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H307A3773EE804A228D98D3FDA3B33E2C"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Activities</header><text>In carrying out the pilot program under subsection (a), the Secretary of Defense, acting through the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Homeland Defense and Hemispheric Affairs, shall—</text> <paragraph id="H39C066EF047D4D919B34DF256500A986"><enum>(1)</enum><text>without duplicating or disrupting existing cyber exercise activities under the National Cyber Exercise Program under section 2220B of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/6/665h">6 U.S.C. 665h</external-xref>), conduct cyber resiliency and reconstitution stress test scenarios through tabletop exercises and, if possible, live exercises—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HD375F67F831D4CEAAFC1B0CB96FA8341"><enum>(A)</enum><text>to assess how to prioritize restoration of power, water, and telecommunications for a military installation in the event of a significant cyberattack on regional critical infrastructure that has similar impacts on State and local infrastructure; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H9ECE1DA586B04CACA57D67C82DE07701"><enum>(B)</enum><text>to determine the recovery process needed to ensure the military installation has the capability to function and support an overseas contingency operation or a homeland defense mission, as appropriate;</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB569539E0C924077AB8650BE5AB03CAA"><enum>(2)</enum><text>map dependencies on power, water, and telecommunications at the military installation and the connections to distribution and generation outside the military installation;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H66716F86855840F3A9209879ADD42B0C"><enum>(3)</enum><text>recommend priorities for the order of recovery for the military installation in the event of a significant cyberattack, considering both the requirements needed for operations of the military installation and the potential participation of personnel at the military installation in an overseas contingency operation or a homeland defense mission; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA7FD48405527427D8E7B2A1B1EAFEE1E"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">develop a lessons-learned database from the exercises conducted under paragraph (1) across all military installations participating in the pilot program, to be shared with the Committees on Armed Services of the House of Representatives and the Senate.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H6C077754B58C477D81AA499E3435D6EB"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Coordination with related programs</header><text>The Secretary of Defense, acting through the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Homeland Defense and Hemispheric Affairs, shall ensure that activities under subsection (c) are coordinated with—</text> 
<paragraph id="HCA83F945F3134F2DB82D55055D3A3059"><enum>(1)</enum><text>private entities that operate power, water, and telecommunications for a military installation participating in the pilot program under subsection (a);</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H03218CB9CEEE489986F746FB5091EFEA"><enum>(2)</enum><text>relevant military and civilian personnel; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H71581EF9E03A46E4BD414F12EF7E16A4"><enum>(3)</enum><text>any other entity that the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Homeland Defense and Hemispheric Affairs determines is relevant to the execution of activities under subsection (c).</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HCCDC7813A8DC414895ACBE6785649B81"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall submit to the Assistant to the President for Homeland Security, the National Cyber Director, the head of any other relevant Sector Risk Management Agency, the Committees on Armed Services of the House of Representatives and the Senate, and, if the Secretary of Defense determines it appropriate, relevant private sector owners and operators of critical infrastructure a report on the activities carried out under pilot program under subsection (a), including a description of any operational challenges identified.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE0BB64104CEC4BB9B243D7DD5610F4CD"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> <paragraph id="H0DFDBE06BD5A449588FAE496C9D778E8"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The term <quote>critical infrastructure</quote> has the meaning given that term in the Critical Infrastructures Protection Act of 2001 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/42/5195c">42 U.S.C. 5195c</external-xref>).</text></paragraph>
