<section id="HE95B7CF5E28149F884AFBD4C3E0F2442" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1519.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Guidance regarding securing laboratories of the Armed Forces</header> 
<subsection id="HE25CA406BD6C415B974EC6235DC948EE" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Guidance</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense, in coordination with the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer of the Department, the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering, and the Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security, shall issue Department-wide guidance regarding methods and processes to secure laboratories of the Armed Forces from—</text> <paragraph id="HDA27B02106374A14A6ABA6234ECFF098" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">unauthorized access and intrusion;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE654F58BB1B84D9E94AA6F2FE5A00F4D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">damage to, and destruction, manipulation, or theft of, physical and digital laboratory assets;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7DEC3497C3E84AA9ADBD83F466691F0F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">accidental or intentional release or disclosure of sensitive information; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H4065A865EDED4D3AA29F7AC6CE3DF14F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">cyber sabotage.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H769E43DD7C184CC29949DA991EF4040B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Methods and processes</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">At a minimum, the guidance under subsection (a) shall include, with respect to laboratories of the Armed Forces, methods and processes to—</text> 
<paragraph id="HAE17D613E5294E28B375A22F14CD38EA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">secure laboratory operations through zero trust principles;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD6219958F5D1494D8FF91BD16610541A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">control the access of devices to laboratory information networks;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD3E2E50B97AC41C4A53AA7C71291D58D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">secure inventory management processes of such laboratories;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HC53CD9C9E02541929DCD3899206AA62C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">control or limit access to such laboratories to authorized individuals;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCF616E8211214AE9975EBAD0164C4652" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">maintain the security and integrity of data libraries, repositories, and other digital assets of such laboratories;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE75E76B710774D5E8519FDFBACF8BCB4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">report and remediate cyber incidents or other unauthorized intrusions affecting such laboratories;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8768488396A34CCA876F088673A0E147" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">train and educate personnel of the Department on laboratory security;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB90219BF47974781B00499810051145D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(8)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">develop an operations security plan to secure laboratory operations that may be used by applicable units of the Armed Forces to implement countermeasures appropriate with respect to the mission, assessed risk, and resources available to the unit (including guidelines for implementation of routine procedures and measures to be employed during daily operations or activities of the unit); and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H2766845E851540EB8E80E2B701EAA42F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(9)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">develop and train applicable units of the Armed Forces on individualized secure laboratory critical information and indicator lists to aid in protecting critical information regarding any activity, intention, capability, or limitation of the Department over which an adversary seeks to gain a military, political, diplomatic, economic, or technological advantage.</text></paragraph></subsection></section></subtitle> <subtitle id="H76129C4EAB7A4730A851C36D6D9BA06B"><enum>C</enum><header>Information Technology and Data Management</header> <section id="HBC1D590EA5444FF38F765156135DEF47" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1521.</enum><header>Control and management of Department of Defense data; establishment of Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council</header> <subsection id="H633D2C5A8DBC4D0EA1D084AE118BC11D"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Control and management of Department of Defense data</header><text>The Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer of the Department of Defense may access and control, on behalf of the Secretary of Defense, any data collected, acquired, accessed, or used by a component (as such term is defined in section 1513 of the James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/117/263">Public Law 117–263</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/4001">10 U.S.C. 4001</external-xref> note)), consistent with such section.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H96AE0868A3AC496ABE453B43E28A2181"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council</header><text>Section 238(d)(3) of the John S. McCain National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2019 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/115/232">Public Law 115–232</external-xref>; 10 U.S.C. note prec. 4061) is amended to read as follows: </text> <quoted-block id="H95872BD31830445FB81EE3215B23AEAA" style="OLC"> <paragraph id="H94A379D3A3EE4165BF9EAD8A1DA5120B"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council</header> <subparagraph id="HB1307261A62E41BFB2AD1D6EEA767C52"><enum>(A)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary shall establish a council to provide policy oversight to ensure the responsible, coordinated, and ethical employment of data and artificial intelligence capabilities across Department of Defense missions and operations. Such council shall be known as the <quote>Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council</quote> (in this paragraph referred to as the <quote>Council</quote>). </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC85C2E442F5D43F481CC40C66AA6BE4C"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Membership</header><text>The Council shall be composed of the following:</text> <clause id="H8BB6094447DF47DA88860E29EC138B32"><enum>(i)</enum><text>Joint Staff J–6.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H79E97CFA5D1247479C61C9D0B1FF6090"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>The Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment.</text></clause> <clause id="HB273FF5429DC43268846E50837FE9BFF"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>The Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Evaluation.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H5DCFC9D4112B412DA3021396D1123B5A"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>The Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security.</text></clause> <clause id="H1ED69F141B6C4A65B49BA03CD002948A"><enum>(v)</enum><text>The Under Secretary of Defense for Policy.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H080934C0C31149BD90526359D16A7D01"><enum>(vi)</enum><text>The Director of Cost Analysis and Program Evaluation.</text></clause> <clause id="H88D758DD6B85491B886D5044B6A47DFF"><enum>(vii)</enum><text>The Chief Information Officer of the Department.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H289FA2FB59A84BDCA2E608A6B35BCD07"><enum>(viii)</enum><text>The Director of Administration and Management.</text></clause> <clause id="HB22D4AF3C3484F088D783FC5CA20879C"><enum>(ix)</enum><text>The service acquisition executives of each of the military departments.</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H9C6B6D8672E6478481DF291E1960A780"><enum>(C)</enum><header>Head of council</header><text>The Council shall be headed by the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer of the Department.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H28A09DAA3B7747F2801A13CE83A630EB"><enum>(D)</enum><header>Meetings</header><text>The Council shall meet not less frequently than twice each fiscal year.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H86BE6E0647444BB79CD40F7FF9D9022C"><enum>(E)</enum><header>Duties of council</header><text>The duties of the Council are as follows:</text> <clause id="HABFAD9C800744A198001858A794A84CF"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">To streamline the organizational structure of the Department as such structure relates to the development, implementation, and oversight of artificial intelligence.</text></clause> 
<clause id="HA0D0A89243BC4B55A11BE40342821E37"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>To improve coordination on artificial intelligence governance with the defense industry sector.</text></clause> <clause id="H4095561A9806404992DFB22E303F94C6"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>To issue and oversee guidance on ethical requirements and protections for the use of artificial intelligence supported by Department funding and the reduction or mitigation of instances of unintended bias in artificial intelligence algorithms.</text></clause> 
<clause id="HE8AEC737833F439CAB87B351B4ECFFFE"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>To identify, monitor, and periodically update appropriate recommendations for the operational use of artificial intelligence.</text></clause> <clause id="H5869F39DC1414D18B1CA6369FE742EC6"><enum>(v)</enum><text>To review, to the extent the head of the Council considers necessary, artificial intelligence program funding, to ensure that any investment by the Department in an artificial intelligence tool, system, or algorithm adheres to each applicable policy of the Department relating to artificial intelligence.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H3CC11F268CCD4ABF90F3FB0720B3816E"><enum>(vi)</enum><text>To provide periodic status updates on the efforts of the Department to develop and implement artificial intelligence into existing Department programs and processes.</text></clause> <clause id="H0EDF5DE845C3428C8BC214916EC88049"><enum>(vii)</enum><text>To issue guidance on access and distribution restrictions relating to data, models, tool sets, or testing or validation infrastructure.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H4FEFE9CAFB6543C3913A16AC7B2CDEFC"><enum>(viii)</enum><text>To implement and oversee an educational program on data and artificial intelligence, for the purpose of familiarizing personnel Department-wide on the applications of artificial intelligence within the respective operations of such personnel.</text></clause> <clause id="H36ABD8E1C81A4FE7BFC7984AFCEE33E8"><enum>(ix)</enum><text>To implement and oversee a scorecard to assess data decrees of the Department.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H5120B280B09E4257A38A987367BD931B"><enum>(x)</enum><text>Such other duties as the Council determines appropriate.</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H4E94C100603C48F8A71B2BFADECB7768"><enum>(F)</enum><header>Periodic reports</header><text>Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, and not less frequently than once every 18 months thereafter, the Council shall submit to the Secretary and the congressional defense committees a report on the activities of the Council during the period covered by the report.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection></section> 
<section id="HC66EA120A875483185E937095BC10BCA" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1522.</enum><header>Modification to Department of Defense enterprise-wide procurement of cyber data products and services</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 1521(a) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/117/81">Public Law 117–81</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/2224">10 U.S.C. 2224</external-xref> note) is amended—</text> <paragraph id="H8F07DC98D2A645B2B19CA8ED2C68145E"><enum>(1)</enum><text>by redesignating paragraph (6) as paragraph (7);</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H559C6DF606D94674B23A2DE88D1680A4"><enum>(2)</enum><text>in paragraph (7), as so redesignated, by striking <quote>(1) through (5)</quote> and inserting <quote>(1) through (6)</quote>; and </text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE511DABB3DBE472393013820E5B810A6"><enum>(3)</enum><text>by inserting after paragraph (5) the following new paragraph:</text> 
<quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H2949CC441D64455EBEE390B5386ACBF1"> 
<paragraph id="HBE6048B325AF444B83E9F6A1342807A7"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Evaluating emerging cyber technologies, such as artificial intelligence-enabled security tools, for efficacy and applicability to the requirements of the Department of Defense.</text></paragraph><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></section> <section id="HA3439F9CFE7A4889AA1247896BFFD405" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1523.</enum><header>Management of data assets by Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer</header> <subsection id="H7643DE97B0BF446CAF949A1B696EE870"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense, subject to existing authorities and limitations and acting through the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer of the Department of Defense, shall provide the digital infrastructure and procurement vehicles necessary to manage data assets and data analytics capabilities at scale to enable an understanding of foreign key terrain and relational frameworks in cyberspace to support the planning of cyber operations, the generation of indications and warnings regarding military operations and capabilities, and the calibration of actions and reactions in strategic competition.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H59EFEAE91AFB41BB8BBD23E4E0DAF884"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Responsibilities of Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer</header><text>The Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer shall—</text> <paragraph id="HEBE207E88EE0472788F1E230C12913AF"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">develop a baseline of data assets exclusive to foreign key terrain and relational frameworks in cyberspace maintained by the intelligence agencies of the Department of Defense, the military departments, the combatant commands, and any other components of the Department of Defense;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H28C587B99F9446F48CBB73D52124ED4D"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">develop and oversee the implementation of plans to enhance such data assets that the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer determines are essential to support the purposes set forth in subsection (a); and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H98543BF3B89B48748D67656C6095DE83"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">ensure that such activities and plans are undertaken in cooperation and in coordination with the Assistant to the Secretary of Defense for Privacy, Civil Liberties, and Transparency, to ensure that any data collection, procurement, acquisition, use, or retention measure conducted pursuant to this section is in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including standards pertaining to data related to United States persons or any persons in the United States.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBF7E53F4AE764D6FBC64C5E78942FA8F"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Other matters</header><text>The Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer shall—</text> <paragraph id="H2FBD1E39F45243A1839426E50339CAAE"><enum>(1)</enum><text>designate or establish one or more Department of Defense executive agents for enhancing data assets and the acquisition of data analytic tools for users; </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H04F995EF3CED48BCAE9FAAF83B7001CD"><enum>(2)</enum><text>ensure that data assets referred to in subsection (b) that are in the possession of a component of the Department of Defense are accessible for the purposes described in subsection (a); and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H442A1EC2C3F3445391587D9FA965CF50"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">ensure that advanced analytics, including artificial intelligence technology, are developed and applied to the analysis of the data assets referred to in subsection (b) in support of the purposes described in subsection (a).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H01CB9F7E68024F5D8ACF19DBC121D70E"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Semiannual briefings</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, and not less frequently than semiannually thereafter, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer shall provide to the appropriate congressional committees a briefing on the implementation of this section.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H815085A15A544A63A1DF3A1B13E809ED" commented="no"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Rule of construction</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section shall be construed to authorize the Department of Defense to collect, procure, or otherwise acquire data, including commercially available data, in any manner that is not authorized by law, or to make use of data assets in any manner, or for any purpose, that is not otherwise authorized by law.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H157D47355C7F434C938974D79551982B"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Appropriate congressional committees defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section, the term <quote>appropriate congressional committees</quote> means—</text> <paragraph id="H8084FEB30FC6409AB3300F05B041DD56"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the congressional defense committees;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7D4A3C1C9EC749F1B3F801810BF980F4"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFE7BD58B91C547D7A8CB1D5AC57D1AEA"><enum>(3)</enum><text>the Select Committee on Intelligence of the Senate.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HE137E427086F40D69FF103920CFB4114" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1524.</enum><header>Course of education and pilot program on authentication of digital content provenance for certain Department of Defense media content</header> 
<subsection id="HE303C12E943B4AF8AC57B2A3E691C275" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Course of education</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H19FE575036684B238949C7AFF6B4729D"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense, acting through the Director of the Defense Media Activity, shall establish a course of education at the Defense Information School, the purpose of which shall be to provide instruction on the practical concepts and skills needed by public affairs, audiovisual, visual information, and records management specialists to understand the following: </text> <subparagraph id="HBB89DCD229B044D7B2CC243EE4E293F8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Digital content provenance for applicable Department media content.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H916306367E5E40B9B938EB94ABAC1B92" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The challenges posed to missions and operations of the Department by a digital content forgery.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HAA8626B0FFA94DB7BFD11DBC1EDCE1DD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">How industry open technical standards may be used to authenticate the digital content provenance of applicable Department media content.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6DABB68DD39748FB854F271E497A0AB7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Matters</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The course of education under paragraph (1) shall cover the following matters:</text> <subparagraph id="H685A5DED18444492BCC2CDFCECB68321" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The challenges to missions and operations of the Department posed by a digital content forgery.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HBA08815C02B24216B7361889E47C87A7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The development of industry open technical standards for authenticating the digital content provenance of applicable Department media content.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H84D09F09D36B4658809F8428E4F07995" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Hands-on training on techniques to record secure and authenticated digital content to document and communicate relevant themes and messages of the Department.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H706BCE938F0E4971BF9D3B5C2AA5F201" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Training on—</text> <clause id="H68C07AD8D6E54CD3A2FBA7466876615B"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the use of industry open technical standards for authenticating digital content provenance in the completion of post-production tasks; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="HE3620799A40F42F1B162F74D46D3FA0B"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>the transmission of applicable Department media content in both operational and nonoperational environments.</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H50D60F01B3534BC08F284CFEB05CB962" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Such other matters as the Director of the Defense Media Activity considers appropriate.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H158E5597C16E43D4B74873F2D6E073E9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the establishment of the course of education under paragraph (1), the Director of the Defense Media Activity shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the House of Representatives and the Senate a report on the following:</text> <subparagraph id="H8BEE303391A34895891F8987256E8F3C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The status of the development of a curriculum for such course of education.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H63A129004B664DFEB26266F2A2E8C9A6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The implementation plan of the Director for such course of education, including the following:</text> <clause id="HCDA243C59A9A4999A3F39C1CD94E4CF7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The expertise and qualifications of the personnel of the Department responsible for teaching such course of education.</text></clause> 
<clause id="H9BBE4FBC6ABB45F889B33134FA28D2C0" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The list of sources consulted or otherwise used to develop the curriculum for such course of education.</text></clause> <clause id="H24CD8F526A824A10873D2A4906A77635" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of the industry open technical standards referred to in paragraph (1)(C).</text></clause> 
<clause id="H177D00597B99470081ADCFC3F5481AB3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iv)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The status of the implementation of such course of education.</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HDDAC799C0578437694D0E05C41CB12E6"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The resources available to the Director to carry out this subsection and whether the Director requires any additional resources to carry out this subsection.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H31E6114449534E30B8ABDA90A99DD5EC" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Pilot program on implementing digital content provenance standards</header> 
<paragraph id="HC2622B0999024C7F89564797CA185DDA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Pilot program</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Director of the Defense Media Activity shall carry out a pilot program to assess the feasibility and advisability of implementing industry open technical standards for digital content provenance for official photographs and videos of the Department of Defense publicly released by the Defense Visual Information Distribution Service, or any successor operation, and other distribution platforms, systems, and services used by the Department of Defense (in this subsection referred to as the <quote>pilot program</quote>).</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HAECD1407E31641969D9011B836D60F1A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In carrying out the pilot program, the Director of the Defense Media Activity shall—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HD27FE9C390334192B431757CDB5F516F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">establish a process for using industry open technical standards to verify the digital content provenance of applicable Department media content;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA71F908E7E464A75A0A527C4A65C0F60" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">apply technology solutions that comport with industry open technical standard for digital content provenance to photographs and videos of the Department publicly released as described in paragraph (1) after the date of the enactment of this Act;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H3957CF700DD7420183F1F02A8CD6FBD3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">assess the feasibility and advisability of applying an industry open technical standard for digital content provenance to historical visual information records of the Department stored at the Defense Visual Information Records Center; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HEA9EE3A5072E45A4AF29734918B49317" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">develop and apply measure of effectiveness for the implementation of the pilot program.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7725FEC1464C4072B7EE7129AA3CA59C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Consultation</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In carrying out the pilot program, the Director of the Defense Media Activity may consult with federally funded research and development centers, entities within private industry, institutions of higher education, and such other entities as the Director considers appropriate.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD54A6FD5CBF94E5EA36911B7079E131E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Termination</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The pilot program shall terminate on January 1, 2027.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8CE05C7385674469A792ED38455D5C7C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report</header> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB3BF342D99F24FEDB75DDB1557B288FF"><enum>(A)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than January 1, 2026, the Director of the Defense Media Activity shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the House of Representatives and the Senate a report on the pilot program.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H5D19487C534E4ABA84D452613F462271"><enum>(B)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The report under subparagraph (A) shall include the following:</text> 
<clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H75A6991E5DAE4934A2353C3834C6374B"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The findings of the Director with respect to the pilot program.</text></clause> <clause id="HBEEF42221C464A2EB4F65D7CBE5B6289" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The name of each entity the Director consulted with pursuant to paragraph (3) in carrying out the pilot program.</text></clause> 
<clause id="HD8B5E3ACE00E4142AD9BB61FC2661681" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment by the Director of the effectiveness of the pilot program.</text></clause> <clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9CE478F5E99142CEBB78524D1522A62D"><enum>(iv)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A recommendation by the Director as to whether the pilot program should be made permanent.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H920D6044488A412B8AB5B17853218C62" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Definitions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section:</text> <paragraph id="H464E9CFA0AEF408E88147FEFC5F55A71" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>applicable Department media content</term> means any media holding generated, stored, or controlled by the Defense Media Activity. </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H996332FC849E4760A038A8634AD27A4E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>digital content forgery</term> means the use of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques, to fabricate or manipulate audio, visual, or text content with the intent to mislead.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H543A6210335D49008C9E568C9749BA32" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>digital content provenance</term> means the verifiable chronology of the origin and history of an image, video, audio recording, electronic document, or other form of digital content.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H8733E7A0935947C2AA0F3463AB0DC7B2" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1525.</enum><header>Prize competitions for business systems modernization</header> 
<subsection id="H5F1C44D01C2A4319B7514B71BEBA6F1F"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, under the authority of section 4025 of title 10, United States Code, the Secretary of Defense shall establish one or more prize competitions to support the business systems modernization goals of the Department of Defense.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HEEC992E5CA194FDFB31E41CFD1611290"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Scope</header> <paragraph id="H04A065F748634515B3F3668D11A5014F"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The Secretary of Defense shall structure any prize competition established under subsection (a) to complement, and to the extent practicable, accelerate the delivery or expand the functionality of business systems capabilities sought by the Secretaries of the military departments that are in operation, in development, or belong to any broad class of systems covered by the defense business enterprise architecture specified in section 2222(e) of title 10, United States Code.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8314C382BA824A5985C58EBC4F5A6A2B"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Areas for consideration</header><text>In carrying out subsection (a), the Secretary of Defense and the Secretaries of the military departments shall consider the following:</text> <subparagraph id="HE8B8D8E707974336B54DE1AE2EF019FD"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Integration of artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H8DA9A59559C44F4CA4CB50BBBBC9F4D0"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Data analytics, business intelligence, or related visualization capabilities.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HCA353786293243EFBF2BE3263D56A495"><enum>(C)</enum><text>Automated updating of business architectures, business systems integration, or documentation relating to existing systems or manuals.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HDD88F8708FBF4BD1B6C0675221F0C82B"><enum>(D)</enum><text>Improvements to interfaces or processes for interacting with other non-Department of Defense business systems.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H9D7CD7E77978401084DF6490E702DA94"><enum>(E)</enum><text>Updates or replacements for legacy defense business systems to improve operational effectiveness and efficiency, such as the system of the Defense Logistics Agency known as the <quote>Mechanization of Contract Administration Services</quote> system, or any successor system.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H3259B9437618487C9DED62664FB6C075"><enum>(F)</enum><text>Contract writing systems, or expanded capabilities relating to such systems, that may be integrated into existing systems of the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H611D80A9481449E5BA99CC41DD8D96FB"><enum>(G)</enum><text>Pay and personnel systems, or expanded capabilities relating to such systems, that may be integrated into existing systems of the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HD7C60245E6014002A7AC9D32E5FEEE14"><enum>(H)</enum><text>Other finance and accounting systems, or expanded capabilities relating to such systems, that may be integrated into existing systems of the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H599BA37F101B4BE4B0434E6BB5FC52F5"><enum>(I)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Systems supporting the defense industrial base and related supply chain visibility, analytics, and management.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HB66E4BD1002542A7A6846541E577070A" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Framework</header><text>Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the framework to be used in carrying out the prize competition under subsection (a).</text></subsection> <subsection id="HE15D5DB423DB4E04A8ED8ABF6E4EF6A3" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Annual briefings</header><text>Not later than October 1 of each year until the date of termination under subsection (e), the Secretary of Defense shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the results of the prize competition under subsection (a).</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H98A56B5FCD4D49DCBA53F0322666E243"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Termination</header><text>The authority to carry out the prize competition under subsection (a) shall terminate on September 30, 2028.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H1330A02D3E0E432CA093901372FA759B" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1526.</enum><header>Requirements for deployment of fifth generation information and communications capabilities to military installations and other Department facilities</header> <subsection id="HF250BEEA7254458C981461BD8D21AC74" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Requirements</header> <paragraph id="H38B922BF5C46432F94721F212D0FE17F"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Strategy for private wireless networks</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall develop and implement a strategy for deploying to military installations and other facilities of the Department of Defense private wireless networks that are—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H5B00B01A1E4741568CE1E69CFE418B4E"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">based on fifth generation information and communications capabilities and Open Radio Access Network architecture; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H6BB0908675B94CE494CB97B146A2D674"><enum>(B)</enum><text>tailored to the mission, security, and performance requirements of the respective military installation or other facility.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H19A315A7B2A541CEA795A53E3577B30F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Process for public wireless network service providers</header> 
<subparagraph id="HE8391D687A5A4AF28A86E40571B355C7"><enum>(A)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text>The Secretary shall establish a Department-wide process under which a public wireless network service provider of fifth generation information and communications capabilities may gain access to a military installation or other facility of the Department to provide commercial subscriber services to military and civilian personnel of the Department (including contractor personnel) located at, and organizational elements of the Department maintained at, such installation or facility.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HCE2B1956E6824C19AE9E44579BBBFEB3"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Design requirements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In establishing the process under subparagraph (A), the Secretary shall ensure relevant system architectures and supporting infrastructure are designed to support modular upgrades to future generation technologies.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD08A7BDC48494BD4920998BAAF9318BA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Determination relating to contract authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary shall determine, on a contract-by-contract basis or as a determination with uniform applicability to contracts across military installations and other facilities of the Department, whether to enter into a contract for—</text> <subparagraph id="HD3D68149700943B7AC608C30A686429C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">neutral hosting, under which infrastructure and services would be provided to companies deploying private wireless networks and public wireless network services to such installation or other facility through multi-operator core network architectures; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H667ABD8D26194B35852A08E5780F1CF8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">separate private wireless network and public wireless network infrastructure at such installation or other facility (which shall include a determination by the Secretary on how to establish roaming agreements and policies between such networks).</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HED0695C3AC3C4DA58087953FC4A55659"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Briefing</header><text>Not later than 150 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the strategy developed under paragraph (1) and any other activity carried out pursuant to this subsection.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HCC212B15FA9441F89E79B64DCF67D8F4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">International cooperation activities</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary, using existing authorities available to the Secretary, may engage in cooperation activities with foreign allies and partners of the United States to—</text> <paragraph id="H52EA85CC3025464F8D4CABA18CFECF4E"><enum>(1)</enum><text>improve the implementation of the strategy under subsection (a)(1); and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H79C9AC32C0B14B369AB075C4FEA57189"><enum>(2)</enum><text>inform the deployment of private wireless networks to military installations and other facilities of the Department pursuant to such strategy. </text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H33FB0E90688A443B9E6F43786AF53A6E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Open Radio Access Network architecture defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section, the term <term>Open Radio Access Network architecture</term> means a network architecture that is modular, uses open interfaces, and virtualizes functionality on commodity hardware through software.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H97112EF9FC324A4F8A27F3BE55AAE778" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1527.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Required policies to establish datalink strategy of Department of Defense</header> 
<subsection id="H58D67087C335404481A8AA5FFDB2D7E5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Policies required</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HBC8D63679013438B927BB5D38261DC49"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall develop and implement policies to establish a unified datalink strategy of the Department of Defense (in this section referred to as the <quote>strategy</quote>). </text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H4CBAD9686C99461391071AF0949631D9"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The policies under paragraph (1) shall provide for, at a minimum, the following: </text> 
<subparagraph id="HA8FF6F39AD724B88858DC9818A5257F9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The designation of an organization to serve as the lead coordinator of datalink activities throughout the Department of Defense. </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H4E50AC01A81A4ACC8582CA5547EDB3C4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The prioritization and coordination across the military departments with respect to the strategy within the requirements generation process of the Department.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HD5BC2718B7324139996561B007A631F9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The use throughout the Department of a common standardized datalink network or transport protocol that ensures interoperability between independently developed datalinks, regardless of physical medium used, and ensures mesh routing. In developing such policy, the Secretary of Defense shall consider the use of a subset of Internet Protocol.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H11DFEDF693ED4616A511FFB5BDB25A58" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A programmatic decoupling of the physical method used to transmit data, the network or transport protocols used in the transmission and reception of data, and the applications used to process and use data. </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H761CAFD4FA7A40D680DF6B44A03C6773" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Coordination of the strategy with respect to weapon systems executing the same mission types across the military departments, including through the use of a common set of datalink waveforms. In developing such policy, the Secretary shall evaluate the use of redundant datalinks for line-of-sight and beyond-line-of-sight information exchange for each weapon systems platform.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H9E6437708E254731AA4DD133993193DC" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(F)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Coordination between the Department and the intelligence community (as such term is defined in section 3 of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3003">50 U.S.C. 3003</external-xref>)) to leverage any efficiencies and overlap with existing datalink waveforms of the intelligence community. </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HF121EA2721614C38B70256BED0719DC9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(G)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Methods to support the rapid integration of common datalinks across the military departments. </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HAD168768B3F34705919442A599A5716C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(H)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Support for modularity of specific datalink waveforms to enable rapid integration of future datalinks, including the use of software defined radios compliant with modular open system architecture and sensor open system architecture.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H110E30C1421E4BEBA8FB7BB8F9C3A8FD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Information to Congress</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than June 1, 2024, the Secretary of Defense shall—</text> <paragraph id="HA07D55C6198C4EF9B0EBF155E093404D"><enum>(1)</enum><text>provide to the appropriate congressional committees a briefing on the proposed policies under subsection (a)(1), including timelines for the implementation of such policies; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H1E9F0907E190431FB06E81CA01C95818"><enum>(2)</enum><text>submit to the appropriate congressional committees—</text> <subparagraph id="HC5770249E34F4C369DC90D4C0B69453A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">an estimated timeline for the implementations of datalinks; </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HBEF63CBF7E744E99841329F580C2888B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a list of any additional resources and authorities necessary to implement the strategy; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H43B09A03E3744CA282E9C474411427F2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a determination of whether a common set of datalinks can and should be implemented across all major weapon systems (as such term is defined in section 3455 of title 10, United States Code) of the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA2EDEC6135874D49AF09EE54A50772DC"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Appropriate congressional committees defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section, the term <quote>appropriate congressional committees</quote> means the congressional defense committees and the congressional intelligence committees, as such term is defined in section 3 of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3003">50 U.S.C. 3003</external-xref>).</text></subsection></section></subtitle> <subtitle id="H1D5A879D2B4D4B39995E3ACAB7A55EF1"><enum>D</enum><header>Personnel</header> <section id="H103EADC8D71D49E1A46F41F113619871" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1531.</enum><header>Office for academic engagement relating to cyber activities</header> <subsection id="H280EE644F8E944E4B2BE95512A3AD980"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text><external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/10/111">Chapter 111</external-xref> of title 10, United States Code, is amended by inserting after <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/2192b">section 2192b</external-xref> the following new section:</text> 
<quoted-block style="USC" id="H53EA2B4CE45E42B6A3762E8AC0A2DADF" display-inline="no-display-inline"> 
<section id="H262B68B5C8DF411FA7244A1F658A160B"><enum>2192c.</enum><header>Office for academic engagement relating to cyber activities</header> 
<subsection id="H07D56E7E52B54D15A402A8FED53AD536"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Establishment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense, acting through the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense, shall establish an office to establish, maintain, and oversee the activities of the Department of Defense that pertain to the relationship between the Department and academia, including with entities involved in primary, secondary, or postsecondary education, with respect to cyber-related matters (in this section referred to as the <quote>Office</quote>).</text></subsection> <subsection id="H5056FCB2AEEB416A9BC422D8FEC9ABA0"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Director</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Office shall have a Director who shall report directly to the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense. An individual serving as Director, while so serving, shall be a member of the Senior Executive Service.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2C92433A46EB4179A1BE2013C7730842"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Responsibilities</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="HEB02B4F8B8D845CF88AFFBC39408D1D8"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The Office shall be responsible for the following:</text> <subparagraph id="H3BD58430E3C34D878619E91F50C8142C" indent="up1"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Serving as the consolidated focal point for engagements carried out between the Department of Defense and academia with respect to cyber-related matters.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H5D41B688605E4ABEB3AA77B09944A13B" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Coordinating covered academic engagement programs for the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HBAB935E5CCA44D0987F17763697C721A" indent="up1"><enum>(C)</enum><text>Conducting ongoing analysis, as determined necessary by the Director, of the performance of cyber-related educational scholarships, camps, support efforts, and volunteer partnerships of the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H349B067E3B6A463E9783EF204DFEEDE0" indent="up1"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Identifying actions the Secretary of Defense may take to improve the cyber skills of personnel within the Department of Defense through participation by such personnel in covered academic engagement programs, for the purposes of assisting the Secretary in cyber-related matters and meeting the long-term national defense needs of the United States for personnel proficient in such skills.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H82FF3D4C72754BC0B45C0E0BCFA9F158" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Managing funds and resources for the National Centers for Academic Excellence in Cybersecurity program, the Department of Defense Cyber Scholarship Program, the National Defense University College of Information and Cyberspace, the University Consortium for Cybersecurity, the senior military colleges, and other educational partnerships between academic institutions and active components of the Armed Forces.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0D9C2CCDD7D74DEFB1FB10C89A616A56" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(F)</enum><text>Establishing requirements, policies, and procedures to collect data on, and to monitor and evaluate, the performance of covered academic engagement programs with respect to the involvement in such programs by the Department of Defense.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H0D073CF93EE84483904BBDE5605D0FE7" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(G)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Monitoring and evaluating through applicable performance measurements (including those established pursuant to subparagraph (F)) the performance of covered academic engagement programs with respect to the involvement in such programs by the Department of Defense, and advising the Secretary of Defense on whether to continue, modify, or terminate such involvement.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HF9FA5F5FCCF14383A2E91EF561644A9D" indent="up1" commented="no"><enum>(H)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Conducting budgetary oversight and supervision, taking into consideration the findings of performance evaluations under subparagraph (G), with respect to—</text> <clause id="H729754E8EFC545EFA6161AB6D4BDFF40" commented="no"><enum>(i)</enum><text>the involvement in covered academic engagement programs by the Department of Defense; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="H33DC08F0EE3F41F89A81D05B8CA95153" commented="no"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>other matters relating to the responsibilities under this subsection.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFA53103530264CE78EF771FCF7209E59" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The Office shall be the office of primary responsibility for carrying out the following:</text> 
<subparagraph id="H6AFE1B2EA8044F55961A9E4F082DB3DE"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 2200c of title 10, United States Code.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H31831B5A50D445BFAA0E123E447038FD"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 1640 of the John S. McCain National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2019 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/115/232">Public Law 115–232</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/2200">10 U.S.C. 2200</external-xref> note).</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H8B4FD2867EFC42DA8FAEA408ECF1E370"><enum>(C)</enum><text>Section 1649 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/116/92">Public Law 116–92</external-xref>; 133 Stat. 1758).</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H9FC35551A6C84577A9A7AF8F193C9142"><enum>(D)</enum><text>The duties of the Secretary of Defense under section 1659 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/116/92">Public Law 116–92</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/391">10 U.S.C. 391</external-xref> note). </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HAC9FAEBB1E524A70B3476B06EA08B86F"><enum>(E)</enum><text>The duties of the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense under section 1726 of the William M.
