<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HCCD043DE87D2448EB9B2788C22FF41F6" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>500.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Executive Committee</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9204A120466147DA8AD15AF3FDB9F62A"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">There is within the Department of Defense an Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Executive Committee (in this section referred to as the <quote>Executive Committee</quote>).</text></subsection> <subsection id="HAB2A7FC6C1404E7AB69D45743F2AAE46" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Purposes</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee shall—</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H5A23612A27CD4321972413E0CB2BA0D9"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">serve as the principal forum within the Department of Defense to inform, coordinate, and evaluate matters relating to electromagnetic warfare;</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA52F2684CCDE4BD794B0D19CC299009F"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide senior oversight, coordination, and budget and capability harmonization with respect to such matters; and </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HC43B21F1AA0F48AE945EC7559F781FF1"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">act as an advisory body to the Secretary of Defense, the Deputy Secretary of Defense, and the Management Action Group of the Deputy Secretary with respect to such matters.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HC3A6DA7BC60D46719FB33AD106D7E2E8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Responsibilities</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee shall—</text> 
<paragraph id="H0157112E6059481FACFAC09EAD403B97" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">advise key senior level decision-making bodies of the Department of Defense with respect to the development and implementation of acquisition investments relating to electromagnetic warfare and electromagnetic spectrum operations of the Department, including relevant acquisition policies, projects, programs, modeling, and test and evaluation infrastructure;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HC5BE0ED0501F468A92D40D40AD20ABAA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide a forum to enable synchronization and integration support with respect to the development and acquisition of electromagnetic warfare capabilities by—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF64BAD179EFD4A3793C815B72A2F3EB7"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">aligning the processes of the Department for requirements, research, development, acquisition, testing, and sustainment; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H5FFD87EBF0CC43C088950E17BC6C4DA4"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">carrying out other related duties; and</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H994B8C4AA91C403EBC553FBF41F01163" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">act as the senior level review forum for the portfolio of capability investments of the Department relating to electromagnetic warfare and electromagnetic spectrum operations and other related matters.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H5CBE886052D148B6816A1751AEE4FF2A"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Coordination with intelligence community</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee, acting through the Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security, shall coordinate with the intelligence community (as defined in section 3 of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3003">50 U.S.C. 3003</external-xref>)) to generate requirements, facilitate collaboration, establish interfaces, and align efforts of the Department of Defense with respect to capabilities and acquisition activities related to electromagnetic spectrum operations in areas of dependency or mutual interest.</text></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA645DB353FC74F8FBBAF38CAB4BB0010"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Meetings</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="HC70F989B315C4DF0966D31E9C4F5AFFA"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee shall hold meetings not less frequently than quarterly and as necessary to address particular issues.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H79B84C424C3D4D509105868D6ABB016C" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee may hold meetings by video conference.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H8C157A369A094E00AA7AA022C6147ACA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(f)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Membership</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee shall be composed of the following principal members:</text> <paragraph id="H56870D9986D04D72B9612BEC31874C36" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment. </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8234DDCA9D804468B0C87507B72C70E2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4E01CF2161A7407A87691553202E970D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H273070F47A5D43958106B659CC1CE32B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Under Secretary of Defense for Policy.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H3BDBAB7DE8AE47AE9510018935048201" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Commander of the United States Strategic Command.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H57169864093E4A5795C33A3292A36665" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H1091B261491546A1AEF4D595C732C555" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Such other Federal officers or employees as the Secretary of Defense considers appropriate, consistent with other authorities of the Department of Defense and publications of the Joint Staff, including the Charter for the Electronic Warfare Executive Committee, dated March 17, 2015. </text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H276D22FF17034A1995A3092CDD65610A"><enum>(g)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Co-chairs of Executive Committee</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="H6D18286BEF514A8F99E5EE3022E1EDAD"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment and the Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, or their designees, shall serve as co-chairs of the Executive Committee. </text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HACD37A0B22874CFDB99387EDD9471DF5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The co-chairs of the Executive Committee shall—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HA9DCAB88A35D4F679BC1F20899A5A2EE" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">preside at all Executive Committee meetings or have their designees preside at such meetings;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H5803241BC5B8432994E8049870427E80" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide administrative control of the Executive Committee;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HB3B81B5DCDB84EDCADC0FCAD07BD3E12" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">jointly guide the activities and actions of the Executive Committee;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H5A8E4C1286B44AAB89B6C79C03A70250" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">approve all agendas for and summaries of meetings of the Executive Committee;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H889FDE6A4C614ADEB4558F26E4FC1A38" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">charter tailored working groups to conduct mission area analysis, as required, under subsection (i); and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HF873D443809A4DAEB2FE5C89E9A8038B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(F)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">perform such other duties as may be necessary to ensure the good order and functioning of the Executive Committee.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H9A301405A29442BFB098C40D80CC1E41" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(h)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Electromagnetic spectrum operations capability team</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="H6668B7A385D241B681AD1DC2C0986AB7"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">There is within the Executive Committee an electromagnetic spectrum operations capability team, which shall—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE49137F6230F45008FFE91D59C19AFC5" indent="up1"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">serve as a flag officer level focus group and executive secretariat subordinate to the Executive Committee; and </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF17C410AF78D4F1F84CDDFD03530F38B" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in that capacity—</text> <clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H8C9A8EEC1B824077834A27B67795AC97"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide initial senior level coordination on key electromagnetic spectrum operations issues; </text></clause> 
<clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3B1714A31C294E6A94A98E1493AB9D88"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">prepare recommended courses of action to present to the Executive Committee; and </text></clause> <clause commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1A76380E03C749F98BE9C673EC6C565E"><enum>(iii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">perform other related duties.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H80B6C821C69A4112A53B0EA7A2FA3F6E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The electromagnetic spectrum operations capability team shall be co-chaired by one representative from the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment and one representative from the Force Structure, Resources, and Assessment Directorate of the Joint Staff (J–8).</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB2BAF68FF998404F9AF5946A108FE157" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The principal members of the Executive Committee shall designate representatives from their respective staffs to the electromagnetic spectrum operations capability team.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HC2BE8B578A564452991A777C4368CC57" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Mission area working groups</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="HAE9B6BDE4E904C96819B0FD1CE63EF51"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee shall establish mission area working groups on a temporary basis—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H4B77DAED39AE4283B38E61BE9E3C1ABA" indent="up1"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to address specific issues and mission areas relating to electromagnetic spectrum operations; </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1FBE51B8005746D68EE730F0D56B664D" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to involve subject matter experts and components of the Department of Defense with expertise in electromagnetic spectrum operations; and </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H31269201DB5745C1B2DE2C637A091D85" indent="up1"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to perform other related duties.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB1E702BE7551456698D90F3795AB3DBF" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Executive Committee shall dissolve a mission area working group established under paragraph (1) once the issue the working group was established to address is satisfactorily resolved.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H9A0F0C0F11764A309BD18826ACEC9AC8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(j)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Administration</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment shall administratively support the Executive Committee, including by designating not fewer than two officials of the Department of Defense to support the day-to-day operations of the Executive Committee.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HE6A06B8B1FF84F899A72177E086A4DD4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(k)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report to Congress</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than February 28, 2024, and annually thereafter through 2030, the Executive Committee shall submit to the congressional defense committees a summary of activities of the Executive Committee during the preceding fiscal year. </text></subsection></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H6CED2E0110C547C180BCC7B948249583"><enum>501.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Guidance on electromagnetic spectrum operations mission area and joint electromagnetic spectrum operations</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall—</text> 
<paragraph id="HBB4F7A072DDF4A2D9B41BBB3DAC45D86" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">establish processes and procedures to develop, integrate, and enhance the electromagnetic spectrum operations mission area and the conduct of joint electromagnetic spectrum operations in all domains across the Department of Defense; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H268147BB6981437C8FFA240F19DD1FF6" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">ensure that such processes and procedures provide for integrated defense-wide strategy, planning, and budgeting with respect to the conduct of such operations by the Department, including activities conducted to counter and deter such operations by malign actors.</text></paragraph></section> 
<section id="H6013E62C40A9454EB721DAD6C27916DB" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>502.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Annual report on electromagnetic spectrum operations strategy of the Department of Defense</header> 
<subsection id="H4F6F4DB1A2E14E71B5E91F7A7279F002" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">At the same time as the President submits to Congress the budget of the President under section 1105(a) of title 31 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029, the Secretary of Defense, in coordination with the Chief Information Officer of the Department of Defense, the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, and the Secretary of each of the military departments, shall submit to the congressional defense committees an annual report on the Electromagnetic Spectrum Superiority Strategy of the Department of Defense.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H303D47F1F4FB420FAFB57D69C4F0E580" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Contents of report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each report required under subsection (a) shall include each of the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="H97FB0B1D0109478199F5C94AD95305A7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description and overview of—</text> <subparagraph id="HA96F1FA10845416B82CD22D7FFAF2623" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the electromagnetic spectrum strategy of the Department of Defense;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H86BEBC5F54CA48A7A39394224E993691" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">how such strategy supports the national defense strategy under section 113(g) of this title; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HAB95FA3945ED4D5E8E338684AF208068" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the organizational structure assigned to oversee the development of the Department's electromagnetic spectrum strategy, requirements, capabilities, programs, and projects.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H355A7342BB52461FBBFA1A0962FB04DD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A list of all the electromagnetic spectrum operations acquisition programs and research and development projects of the Department of Defense and a description of how each program or project supports the Department's electromagnetic spectrum strategy.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H21D4CC341807473EB17F68678F2A2307" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">For each unclassified program or project on the list required by paragraph (2)—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HF5B19BC8AEFD42479E383CE3B7245A24" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the senior acquisition executive and organization responsible for oversight of the program or project;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HD9F709F8F6E6498199C4FDA266733D0D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">whether or not validated requirements exist for the program or project and, if such requirements do exist, the date on which the requirements were validated and the organizational authority that validated such requirements;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC2811992E0BB483DBA72C4FAE20D5576" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the total amount of funding appropriated, obligated, and forecasted by fiscal year for the program or project, including the program element or procurement line number from which the program or project receives funding;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HEE6B100F25C04934ADFD65B27213CB94" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the development or procurement schedule for the program or project;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HA1EFCE2CDD1B4E5F8F43B826A084A37A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(E)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">an assessment of the cost, schedule, and performance of the program or project as it relates to the program baseline for the program or project, as of the date of the submission of the report, and the original program baseline for such program or project, if such baselines are not the same;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HACD443C736A142BF9A93F1679E87CBA1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(F)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the technology readiness level of each critical technology that is part of the program or project;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0D1ABFFF6769459F853D5FBD5D3E5E4F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(G)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">whether or not the program or project is redundant or overlaps with the efforts of another military department; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA1221589FCB9467786231A817A49E97A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(H)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the capability gap that the program or project is being developed or procured to fulfill.</text></subparagraph></paragraph>

<subparagraph id="H1E42FB1888B64FB7A40FD5AB95DCEA81"><enum>(A)</enum><header>Initial briefing</header><text>Not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the co-chairs of the working group shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on—</text> <clause id="HF1DA10775014431D9A6D6F9F5EBFF49B"><enum>(i)</enum><text>any capabilities development documents developed by the working group that are either approved by, or in development for, the Joint Requirements Oversight Council; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="HA6622C0B09A545508E2492A382DB1A33"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>any progress of the working group towards developing processes and procedures for tasking, collection, processing, exploitation, and dissemination of data collected by future moving target indication systems.</text></clause></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H10BA680FC5124BFA984E22D5EA71BD11"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Biannual briefings</header><text>Not less frequently than biannually following the initial briefing under subparagraph (A), the working group shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the status of any moving target indication programs under development by the Department of Defense as of the date of the briefing.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H1A7B87E0EAF64A9A802429F2F2BCB4B0"><enum>(C)</enum><header>Sunset</header><text>The requirement to provide briefings under this paragraph shall terminate on the date that is five years after the date of the enactment of this Act.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HEF74973BF8D245FCAA39EB0F478DD0F6"><enum>1685.</enum><header>Positioning, navigation, and timing</header> <subsection id="H3F244D21A8024545BD94092353FD3C69"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Quarterly briefings on implementation of military-code compliant GPS receivers</header> <paragraph id="HFE03DB4B785A4C06A11172E3E70FC63F"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Not later than February 1, 2024, and quarterly thereafter until the date specified in paragraph (2), the Co-Chairs of the Council on Oversight of the Department of Defense Positioning, Navigation, and Timing Enterprise, shall provide to the congressional defense committees a briefing on the status of the implementation of M-Code compliant GPS receivers through the Military GPS User Equipment program, including the status of increments 1 and 2 of such program and details regarding expected dates of M-Code compliance for all sea-, air, and land-based terminals across the platforms of each of the Armed Forces.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCED7D791B4A1422CAC819237DD5FB4C0"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Termination date</header><text>The date specified in this paragraph is the date on which the Secretary of Defense submits to the congressional defense committees certification that the increments 1 and 2 of the Military GPS User Equipment program have reached full operational capacity.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H53450EE01A964CDEAC3992179B880075"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Treatment of positioning, navigation, and timing resiliency, modifications, and improvements program</header><text>The Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment shall treat the Positioning, Navigation, and Timing Resiliency, Modifications, and Improvements program of the Air Force (Program Element 0604201F) as an acquisition category 1D program, and the authority to manage such program may not be delegated.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="HC20C4209AAA745D4BD2A4F03F406F5E5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1686.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Actions to address serious deficiencies in electronic protection of systems that operate in the radio frequency spectrum</header> 
<subsection id="HB5CEC22BE5444442B78A9DC8D89905FF" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall—</text> <paragraph id="HFBCB8927B9D0438AA8F9D3FEC0C4207D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">establish requirements for and assign sufficient priority to ensuring electronic protection of military sensor, navigation, and communications systems and subsystems against jamming, spoofing, and unintended interference from military systems of the United States and foreign adversaries; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H83CD2D34DCB94D339AD4EB34AB0C79E5" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">provide management oversight and supervision of the military departments to ensure military systems that emit and receive radio frequencies are protected against threats and interference from United States and foreign adversary military systems operating in the same or adjacent radio frequencies.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H5AC7FFC69AF1446AAC04055715E717AF" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Specific required actions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense shall require the military departments and combat support agencies to carry out the following activities:</text> 
<paragraph id="H8BA803D0CC264D8FAC82715BA4AD8B12" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, develop and approve requirements, through the Joint Requirements Oversight Council as appropriate, for every radar, signals intelligence, navigation, and communications system and subsystem subject to the Global Force Management process to ensure such systems and subsystems are able to withstand threat-realistic levels of jamming, spoofing, and unintended interference, including self-generated interference.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4B96710EA3AA469DB85BAF107C637E61" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not less frequently than once every 4 years, test each system and subsystem described in paragraph (1) at a test range that permits threat-realistic electronic warfare attacks against the system or subsystem by a red team or simulated opposition force, with the first set of highest priority systems to be initially tested by not later than the end of fiscal year 2025.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF79A44943CA943F3974953FCE7BB2667" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">With respect to each system and subsystem described in paragraph (1) that fails to meet electronic protection requirements during testing conducted under paragraph (2)—</text> <subparagraph id="H81B4A1218278442B90A5A621C83BCCF6"><enum>(A)</enum><text>not later than 3 years after the initial failed test, retrofit the system or subsystem with electronic protection measures that can withstand threat-realistic jamming, spoofing, and unintended interference; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H5EA911BE18F04DDAA1038807D9235DF7"><enum>(B)</enum><text>not later than 4 years after the initial failed test, retest such systems and subsystems.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFE9CD3ADFE3B4E3DABDA8B88667330D1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Survey, identify, and test available technology that can be practically and affordably retrofitted on the systems and subsystems described in paragraph (1) and which provides robust protection against threat-realistic jamming, spoofing, and unintended interference.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H33E64FE99AE7494CB05E1EB21DB96E87" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Design and build electronic protection into ongoing and future development programs to withstand expected jamming and spoofing threats and unintended interference.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HD2D7AB21709E41B89E83D168B1CB1121" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Waiver</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of Defense may establish a process for issuing waivers, on a case-by-case basis, for the testing requirement under paragraph (2) of subsection (b) and for the retrofit requirement under paragraph (3) of such subsection. </text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H722AEA6BB86C48A1B1B73DF5E7960694" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Annual reports</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Concurrent with the submission of the budget of the President to Congress pursuant to section 1105(a) of title 31, United States Code, for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2030, the Director of Operational Test and Evaluation shall submit to the Electronic Warfare Executive Committee of the Department of Defense and the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives a comprehensive annual report that—</text> <paragraph id="HFA9F726B6AF2447FB4214DF4E76C1B8C"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">aggregates and summarizes information received from the military departments and combat support agencies for purposes of the preparation of the report; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD9EA52D6175246EE9A33401D4515AB2B"><enum>(2)</enum><text>includes a description of—</text> <subparagraph id="H0D9A67ADDD884063BA1CCC8A7570FDFD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the activities carried out to implement the requirements of this section;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H1BE97EDE579746109C70675EA6022252" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the systems and subsystems subject to testing in the previous year and the results of such tests, including a description of the requirements for electronic protection established for the tested systems and subsystems; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HC1F678CC8D884921A3F8CA5CAF8AB0BB" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">each waiver issued in the previous year with respect to such requirements, together with a detailed rationale for the waiver and a plan for addressing any issues that formed the basis of the waiver request.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H9997C16807E245F3B8051AD79F28ACB5"><enum>1687.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation on use of funds for certain unreported programs</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFD4E11E79DAB48D4B0A9DCE9F4B42825"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation on availability of funds</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">None of the funds authorized to be appropriated or otherwise made available by this Act may be obligated or expended in support of any activities involving unidentified anomalous phenomena protected under any form of special access or restricted access limitations unless the Secretary of Defense has provided the details of the activity to the appropriate congressional committees and congressional leadership, including for any activities described in a report released by the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office in fiscal year 2024.</text></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF567E92806A54F98AEED664764749C2D"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Limitation regarding independent research and development</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Consistent with Department of Defense Instruction Number 3204.01 (dated August 20, 2014, incorporating change 2, dated July 9, 2020; relating to Department policy for oversight of independent research and development), independent research and development funding relating to unidentified anomalous phenomena shall not be allowable as indirect expenses for purposes of contracts covered by such instruction, unless such material and information is made available the appropriate congressional committees and congressional leadership.</text></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H134342899C984D39BB8B640F6167C035"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Definitions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In this section:</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H812A90498B914A32988F46968B6E75A4"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>appropriate congressional committees</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF62D890A3F9A4863B9E5C9F032BAA937"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the congressional defense committees; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H6E0DF2B5F5B34F91BF48DFCD3A16BDD7"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives and the Select Committee on Intelligence of the Senate.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFC63A62A9934457DA35B52FDD19CFB3E"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>congressional leadership</term> means—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H41256E12025B402E95EE8528868FABBF"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the majority leader of the Senate;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H13060B06F0714F7F849403F812EBB02C"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the minority leader of the Senate;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HD9826E659DD74278B82100AAE6546B24"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Speaker of the House of Representatives; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFA6FB10B5F1D45C59DCBB85020F3E0D8"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the minority leader of the House of Representatives. </text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H09EBEC259CEA489A9FA89E5B48F2C12C"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>unidentified anomalous phenomena</term> has the meaning given such term in section 1683(n)of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3373">50 U.S.C. 3373(n)</external-xref>), as amended by section 6802(a) of the Intelligence Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 (<external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/117/263">Public Law 117–263</external-xref>). </text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HC780403595EC4E2CBD1D81748C3B89B2"><enum>1688.</enum><header>Indo-Pacific missile strategy</header> 
<subsection id="H45FAC0A47C5C49FDA7326721BEC11EF2"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Strategy</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall submit to the congressional defense committees a strategy for ground-based theater-range conventional missiles in the Indo-Pacific region.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H4DB15A5012614EA9AC59AE32607CB4AC"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Elements</header><text>The strategy required by subsection (a) shall include the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="H7E795CDDD41D467AB94C05CC6273F5BD"><enum>(1)</enum><text>An assessment of gaps in ground-based theater-range conventional missile capabilities in the area of responsibility of the United States Indo-Pacific Command.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HAA3C808253384515BC6EEDAEBBDC2AF9"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An identification of military requirements for ground-based theater-range conventional missile systems, including range, propulsion, payload, launch platform, weapon effects, and other operationally relevant factors.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0BC392270F07459AB8546686DFEE48B8"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An identification of prospective basing locations for ground-based theater-range conventional missiles in the area of responsibility of the United States Indo-Pacific Command and an assessment of steps required to receive host-nation permission for forward-basing of such weapon systems.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7A5ADC7695D4489580BB5DF5C8E11A94"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A description of operational concepts for employment of such ground-based theater-range conventional missiles, including integration with other capabilities in the Western Pacific region.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8A3E077C09704945B0AD83EBEB3ED993"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An identification of prospective allies, partners, and institutional mechanisms for co-production of new ground-based theater-range conventional missiles.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5B97C96F7A54434980B0B11446C2974E"><enum>(6)</enum><text>An assessment of the cost, schedule, and feasibility of ground-based theater-range conventional missile programs, including any potential cost-sharing structures through existing institutional mechanisms.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H07BF2F28CC6C486697DE244FE0A71D87"><enum>(7)</enum><text>Any other matter the Secretary considers relevant.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HE323E05882524190912972AB6E70411A"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Form</header><text>The strategy required by subsection (a) may be submitted in classified form, but shall include an unclassified summary.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H531A6D57956F46FA875FB0B6C2E6492E"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Ground-based theater-range conventional missile</header><text>The term <term>ground-based theater-range conventional missile</term> means a short-range, medium-range, or intermediate-range conventional mobile ground-launched cruise or hypersonic missile system with a range between 500 and 5,500 kilometers. </text></subsection></section> <section id="H3E08406A2C01448EAF0D450F75D3BD6B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1689.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Study on the future of the Integrated Tactical Warning Attack Assessment System</header> <subsection id="H05FC2CB1290B41DD9375CA2986671B27" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff shall enter into an agreement with a federally funded research and development center under which the center shall—</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H434F6985A09F4C77B784D3B4942E9F5A"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">conduct a study on the future of the Integrated Tactical Warning Attack Assessment System; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE5FD5F7661424C5CB87677A5DEFA6907"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">submit to the Chairman a report on the findings of the center with respect to the study conducted under paragraph (1).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H8953715294CB434A9B14A5982C0C34B2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The study conducted pursuant to an agreement under subsection (a) shall cover the following:</text> <paragraph id="HC1B04B1167D94C4197AEC81DF8A73A77" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Future air and missile threats to the United States.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H5EFA51E2721045A6B9ECCEC6A7845036" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The integration of multi-domain sensor data and their ground systems with the existing architecture of the Integrated Tactical Warning Attack Assessment System.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA85A516E10034CD09A74A0E4EB9F2F1C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The effect of the integration described in paragraph (2) on the data reliability standards of the Integrated Tactical Warning Attack Assessment System.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD48469285B274A4CBC43244CA3826825" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Future data visualization, conferencing, and decisionmaking capabilities of such system.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA60BEED5435F4155B2A642C171BCC838" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Such other matters as the Chairman considers relevant to the study.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H78B7AF32AE0748D2A0294831D3971AC6"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Chairman shall submit to the congressional defense committees—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAA236CB3EF5C4932AA7CB35211B2D375"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the report submitted to the Chairman under subsection (a)(2); and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE9506C0679614DF29CC78573156128E8"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the assessment of the Chairman with respect to the findings in such report and the recommendations of the Chairman with respect to modernizing the Integrated Tactical Warning Attack Assessment System.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H312172C05DF14930963980017A97DC88" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1690.</enum><header>Research and analysis on multipolar deterrence and escalation dynamics</header> <subsection id="HD6BFD9CAEB874A9DA7BC6E4C6EA08842"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall seek to enter into an agreement with a university affiliated research center with expertise in strategic deterrence to conduct research and analysis on multipolar deterrence and escalation dynamics.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA1F4160B55104D5388D6B70368891682"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Elements</header><text>The research and analysis conducted under subsection (a) shall include assessment of the following:</text> <paragraph id="H04B01CDA0EF04BCEA5329A55586574C4"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Implications for strategic deterrence and allied assurance given the emergence of a second near-peer nuclear power.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H1D6411D589BB4D67A476307015E32F68"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Potential alternative conventional, strategic, and nuclear force structures to optimize deterrence of two near-peer nuclear powers.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H17E740EBD0514DF4A0994A6F4768BA36"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The contribution made by countervailing nonstrategic capabilities to strategic deterrence.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H3CA6C70A457941EF8CF17CCDA1F45DDE"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Escalation patterns arising from Russia’s Strategic Operations to Destroy Critically Important Targets operational concept and response options for the United States.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H09E55AE7857B4C48981E727F95500093"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Multilateral efforts that could contribute to multipolar strategic deterrence and escalation dynamics.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC3C154D923964F3383C2ACEFA1620D9B"><enum>(6)</enum><text>Capabilities and operations sufficient to assure European and Pacific allies.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HC7B74ABF3F7C4E1399A41C31D29A2DCC"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Report required</header> <paragraph id="HA94CF4F2464045318FD46BDB9B96E402"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Not later than March 1, 2025, the Secretary of Defense shall submit to the congressional defense committees a report that includes the results of the research and analysis conducted under subsection (a).</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H052A555F5D4B41F78277108FF4CD8FA3"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Form</header><text>The report under paragraph (1) shall be submitted in unclassified form, but may include a classified annex.</text></paragraph></subsection></section></subtitle></title> <title id="H3347C138A77440DE89C119ADE04CA662"><enum>XVII</enum><header>Space Force Personnel Management</header> <toc container-level="title-container" quoted-block="no-quoted-block" lowest-level="section" idref="H3347C138A77440DE89C119ADE04CA662" regeneration="yes-regeneration" lowest-bolded-level="division-lowest-bolded"> <toc-entry idref="H6C4BEB4F87D442EA9CFB705C9599FDDC" level="section">Sec. 1701. <section id="HDB3F29C4274F46648D07DC03DEC0F8E8"><enum>1712.</enum><header>Composition of the Space Force without component</header> 
<subsection id="H1B5797E2CADB414FBB4CB40678A1124C"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Composition of the Space Force</header><text>Section 9081(b) of title 10, United States Code, is amended—</text> <paragraph id="H4F2C07465BEC4C46B2EF479200E73C86"><enum>(1)</enum><text>by striking paragraph (1);</text></paragraph>

<subsection id="H7067C303AC494B758D30636F51BF3760"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Effective date</header><text>The amendments made by subsection (a) shall take effect on the date of the certification by the Secretary of the Air Force under section 1745.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H508B69E663B540758320369A0F80E628"><enum>1713.</enum><header>Definitions for single personnel management system for the Space Force</header> <subsection id="HB19477043D15435389FFCA72461A7384"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Space Force definitions</header><text>Section 101 of title 10, United States Code, is amended—</text> 
<paragraph id="HE8FF53A6AECD47BAAF3673A9E84BC9A5"><enum>(1)</enum><text>by redesignating subsections (e), (f), and (g) as subsections (f), (g), and (h), respectively; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H22BDE7FEB2694C27AD31B50F1C803A47"><enum>(2)</enum><text>by inserting after subsection (d) the following new subsection (e):</text> 
<quoted-block id="HC2B0620FB92244388819F88EF4FB1339" style="OLC"> 
<subsection id="H70A2579C00BD43B996E01064CF4C771C"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Space force</header><text>The following definitions relating to members of the Space Force apply in this title:</text> <paragraph id="HB91C206D96EF491A9D86CFF37DCA6253"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The term <quote>space force active status</quote> means the status of a member of the Space Force who is not in a space force inactive status and is not retired.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HBE5DBD499726467C943098901C48A12D"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The term <quote>space force inactive status</quote> means the status of a member of the Space Force who is designated by the Secretary of the Air Force, under regulations prescribed by the Secretary, as being in a space force inactive status.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB73D0456BD094602B29F1601E92FC462"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The term <quote>space force retired status</quote> means the status of a member of the Space Force who—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H36EA7E139CB045DDB0455EADCF50236A"><enum>(A)</enum><text>is receiving retired pay ; or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HE7D145661FBC496AA14863A0CFE9B839"><enum>(B)</enum><text>but for being under the eligibility age applicable under section 12731 of this title, would be eligible for retired pay under chapter 1223 of this title.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6AA31917B2F143A2B52AB4CD660B49B2"><enum>(4)</enum><text>The term <quote>sustained duty</quote> means full-time duty by a member of the Space Force ordered to such duty by an authority designated by the Secretary of the Air Force—</text> <subparagraph id="H6B32B6E9C38846768002DB73F129E81C"><enum>(A)</enum><text>in the case of an officer—</text> 
<clause id="H4198B14AD2A8414D83B1A2578C411047"><enum>(i)</enum><text>to fulfill the terms of an active-duty service commitment incurred by the officer under any provision of law; or</text></clause> <clause id="HB2ADD5724706480EA28E3EDA349548D9"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>with the consent of the officer; and</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE4802CF5882149CD82ED7CA75EF6F796"><enum>(B)</enum><text>in the case of an enlisted member, with the consent of the enlisted member as specified in the terms of the member’s enlistment or reenlistment agreement.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HB74ABE7618E84CD5AA92D21321E2FB78"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Amendments to existing duty status definitions</header><text>Subsection (d) of such section is amended—</text>

<section id="H3A834CE1AE05489F83DBF2DF65118284" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1714.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Basic policies relating to service in the Space Force</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline"><external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/10/2001">Chapter 2001</external-xref> of title 10, United States Code, as added by section 1711, is amended by adding at the end the following new sections:</text> <quoted-block style="USC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA2B2298F51864711BCF2FA2D9C7D2C22"> <section id="H32F5FE679BC84CEF9415C6228BA7750B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>20002.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Members: duty status</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, each member of the Space Force shall be placed in one of the following duty statuses:</text> 
<paragraph id="H9BF386D78E2140ADA26D917B4F2B342B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Space Force active status.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H42851F02E0514545AEB68EE75EBB17E7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Space Force inactive status.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA88E2B66CE9A484185DE85406CED1F2D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Space Force retired status.</text></paragraph></section> <section id="HE41C5C0B74FF46309BA5332D416FDB82" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>20003.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Members: minimum service requirement as applied to Space Force</header> <subsection id="H34223A461D0B460E827069078B402B77" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Inapplicability of active/reserve service distinction</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In applying section 651 of this title to a person who becomes a member of the Space Force, the provisions of the second sentence of subsection (a) and of subsection (b) of that section (relating to service in a reserve component) are inapplicable.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HED374F50E4F0479DA697EFE4D7849FCF" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Treatment upon transfer out of space force</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A member of the Space Force who transfers to one of the other armed forces before completing the service required by subsection (a) of section 651 of this title shall upon such transfer be subject to section 651 of this title in the same manner as if such member had initially entered the armed force to which the member transfers.</text></subsection></section><after-quoted-block display="yes">.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></section> <section id="HEFEAC2E56B85486D96CB9A09A7688D26"><enum>1715.</enum><header>Status and participation</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Subtitle F of title 10, United States Code, as added by section 1711, is amended by adding at the end the following new chapter:</text>

<section id="HA3FCAD6F775446B0B97ADAA9D4E59548"><enum>20101.</enum><header>Members in Space Force active status: amount of annual training or active duty service required</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Except as specifically provided in regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, a member of the Space Force in a space force active status who is not serving on sustained duty shall be required to—</text> <paragraph id="H113270ED7ACF411F9FB8DF83104985E3"><enum>(1)</enum><text>participate in at least 48 scheduled drills or training periods during each year and serve on active duty for not less than 14 days (exclusive of travel time) during each year; or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H461B63FEF28B4D37B36C7D42C16E1681"><enum>(2)</enum><text>serve on active duty for training for not more than 30 days during each year.</text></paragraph></section> <section id="H93897A8D990549E18BDFAE86AD1C9724"><enum>20102.</enum><header>Individual ready guardians: designation; mobilization category</header> <subsection id="HFA9A29F4813742D2AAF9FC8C0651702D"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Air Force may designate a member of the Space Force in a space force active status as an Individual Ready Guardian.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H4ACF0899330B4FAF96CD95DBD74DB02D"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Mobilization category</header> 
<paragraph id="HBD0B38A8E0B74588BC13B43CE659FD83"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Among members of the Space Force designated as Individual Ready Guardians, there is a category of members (referred to as a <quote>mobilization category</quote>) who, as designated by the Secretary of the Air Force, are subject to being ordered to active duty without their consent in accordance with section 20106(a) of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA71021F24409496A92642FAA72C0FC2B"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Limitations on placement in mobilization category</header><text>A member designated as an Individual Ready Guardian may not be placed in the mobilization category referred to in paragraph (1) unless—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HB06EF7E0602F4C628169DBC6FC403F07"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the member volunteers to be placed in that mobilization category; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA6361F53768E4A13B7325F906FBDACDA"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the member is selected by the Secretary of the Air Force, based upon the needs of the Space Force and the grade and military skills of that member.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0559F6044F2F43098BA703A8AB98175C"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Limitation on time in mobilization category</header><text>A member of the Space Force in a space force active status may not remain designated an Individual Ready Guardian in such mobilization category after the end of the 24-month period beginning on the date of the separation of the member from active service.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H0EC61CBFB23A46C5A9FFC58ED6E3CF22"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Designation of grades and military skills or specialties</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall designate the grades and military skills or specialties of members to be eligible for placement in such mobilization category.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H485535C6B55447A699459BACEF395A8A"><enum>(5)</enum><header>Benefits</header><text>A member in such mobilization category shall be eligible for benefits (other than pay and training) on the same basis as are available to members of the Individual Ready Reserve who are in the special mobilization category under section 10144(b) of this title, as determined by the Secretary of Defense.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HDDFCCB09B1AE4991B416E5EF7A1731EA"><enum>20103.</enum><header>Members not on sustained duty: agreements concerning conditions of service</header> <subsection id="H5E5BA0EA5458455D8EB1138CE5A5BB2C"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Agreements</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may enter into a written agreement with a member of the Space Force not on sustained duty—</text> 
<paragraph id="H2483D71DD75B4377BB84EF59B230D847"><enum>(1)</enum><text>requiring the member to serve on active duty for a definite period of time;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H0FB4F08A47EE4756800D46C49B746AC2"><enum>(2)</enum><text>specifying the conditions of the member’s service on active duty; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8EB3866142EC4329BDA4444B85639AEA"><enum>(3)</enum><text>for a member serving in a space force inactive status, specifying the conditions for the member’s continued service as well as order to active duty with and without the consent of the member.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H0C1A6C76DFEC463C9DBE9470D0520E74"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Conditions of service</header><text>An agreement under subsection (a) shall specify the conditions of service. The Secretary of the Air Force shall prescribe regulations establishing—</text> 
<paragraph id="HB8A05EE58A0D4695A69013EDA1BE0527"><enum>(1)</enum><text>what conditions of service may be specified in the agreement;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H32DFBC7FD71745BE90682877BF017892"><enum>(2)</enum><text>the obligations of the parties; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H731744A4590C48B0B9438CE31F863F12"><enum>(3)</enum><text>the consequences of failure to comply with the terms of the agreement.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H0475A5E8156748B0815F8ED567C0F981"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Authority for retention on active duty during war or national emergency</header><text>If the period of service on active duty of a member under an agreement under subsection (a) expires during a war or during a national emergency declared by Congress or the President, the member concerned may be kept on active duty, without the consent of the member, as otherwise prescribed by law.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H173D85A8C20B458AAD6780399BBEFE6F"><enum>20104.</enum><header>Orders to active duty: with consent of member</header> 
<subsection id="H50C4B68E597247119E7374FBE2986875"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Authority</header><text>A member of the Space Force who is serving in a space force active status and is not on sustained duty, or who is serving in a space force inactive status, may, with the consent of the member, be ordered to active duty, or retained on active duty, under the following sections of chapter 1209 of this title in the same manner as applies to a member of a reserve component ordered to active duty, or retained on active duty, under that section with the consent of the member:</text> <paragraph id="H294F815A939848C4B86371031946E62C"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Section 12301(d), relating to orders to active duty at any time with the consent of the member.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H82F38C527587433A8895AB62FBEA4130"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Section 12301(h), relating to orders to active duty in connection with medical or health care matters.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6F4DEEB65C174425927C732657974330"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Section 12322, relating to active duty for health care.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H12FEBC0A9E4A4708B93E4C5389457B1A"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Section 12323, relating to active duty pending line of duty determination required for response to sexual assault.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H49B1ADA5D852407BA3BDCFCB0327DCF4"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Applicable provisions of law</header><text>The following sections of chapter 1209 of this title pertaining to a member of a reserve component ordered to active duty with the consent of the member apply to a member of the Space Force who is ordered to active duty under this section in the same manner as to such a reserve component member:</text> 
<paragraph id="H153CBBAC193D44EF9A1699504D366916"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Section 12308, relating to retention after becoming qualified for retired pay.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H9F0603FE00284C24A928E9112ED38308"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Section 12309, relating to use of Reserve officers in expansion of armed forces.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H096103A3A67E4D588F8562CCC7A211DD"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Section 12313, relating to release of reserve members from active duty.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H585006D55D0246DEB13C94FD575EA8DF"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Section 12314, relating to kinds of duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7D40EE6038F143B6BA3521E378394C33"><enum>(5)</enum><text>Section 12315, relating to duty with or without pay.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H0ADB7430B34F4285A67C6065FD65F372"><enum>(6)</enum><text>Section 12316, relating to payment of certain Reserves while on duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H12AAD7E600CE402192B5FB83854F5BEE"><enum>(7)</enum><text>Section 12318, relating to duties and funding of reserve members on active duty.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H1593AA8E58FD4929B0C7160543BF9D50"><enum>(8)</enum><text>Section 12320, relating to grade in which ordered to active duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD477BE9535164D66A121966C35467B36"><enum>(9)</enum><text>Section 12321, relating to a limitation on number of reserve members assigned to Reserve Officer Training Corps units.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HADE16B189623450D988C0F209EF894B7"><enum>20105.</enum><header>Sustained duty</header> <subsection id="H91FBB394E9DE41AEB38BA0E0EFBBCA95"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Enlisted members</header><text>An authority designated by the Secretary of the Air Force may order an enlisted member of the Space Force in a space force active status to sustained duty, or retain an enlisted member on sustained duty, with the consent of that member, as specified in the terms of the member’s enlistment or reenlistment agreement.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H326AF3259C9F4F6DBA917E3D2B375DEA"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Officers</header> 
<paragraph id="HB597A836F79F4F7C86ACED77F2CB60B2"><enum>(1)</enum><text>An authority designated by the Secretary of the Air Force may order a Space Force officer in a space force active status to sustained duty—</text> <subparagraph id="HAF7AB77A18DC48B7B6AD4D6DC7E9CA29"><enum>(A)</enum><text>with the consent of the officer; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE0BE6C2F41FD423F84559FD402561FDD"><enum>(B)</enum><text>to fulfill the terms of an active-duty service commitment incurred by the officer under any provision of law.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD44B346A97234E4783E7B6AE71BB11C4"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An officer ordered to sustained duty under paragraph (1) may not be released from sustained duty without the officer’s consent except as provided in chapter 2009 or 2011 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H42FDE98C04734135B81CEA1ACAE83CD5"><enum>20106.</enum><header>Orders to active duty: without consent of member</header> 
<subsection id="H0AD849E0DF434A149F391830E8280678"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Members in a space force active status</header> 
<paragraph id="H2335D1C26C2749B592EDEE7DFB4438CE"><enum>(1)</enum><text>A member of the Space Force in a space force active status who is not on sustained duty, may, without the consent of the member, be ordered to active duty or inactive duty in the same manner as a member of a reserve component ordered to active duty or inactive duty under the provisions of chapter 1209 of this title and any other provision of law authorizing the order to active duty of a member of a reserve component in an active status without the consent of the member.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H87876E6BFC4F49779822E47C29DD0607"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The provisions of chapter 1209 of this title, or other applicable provisions of law, pertaining to a member of the Ready Reserve when ordered to active duty shall apply to a member of the Space Force who is in a space force active status when ordered to active duty under paragraph (1).</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H65B3B6C347CB421E95C051D1DFE7BE83"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The provisions of section 12304 of this title pertaining to members in the Individual Ready Reserve mobilization category shall apply to a member of the Space Force who is designated an Individual Ready Guardian when ordered to active duty who meets the provisions of section 20102(b) of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HE6A777DE09AB47D5925D4E66B0132100"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Members in a space force inactive status</header> <paragraph id="HA8438276DAF64FCFB6F1270CCC6B9629"><enum>(1)</enum><text>A member of the Space Force in a space force inactive status may be ordered to active duty under—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HC8831461BEBF4E1C838775C1B16045C6"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the provisions of chapter 1209 of this title;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HC135A169C32C4BC0B4EE0E2174627A26"><enum>(B)</enum><text>any other provision of law authorizing the order to active duty of a member of a reserve component in an inactive status; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H2A1C2E1CE8844DBAA8B50A14E399D019"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the terms of any agreement entered into by the member under section 20103 of this title.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H572E754E6218412491C8895BE5B11001"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The provisions of chapter 1209 of this title, or other applicable provisions of law, pertaining to the Standby Reserve shall apply to a member of the Space Force who is in a space force inactive service when ordered to active duty.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HC94DA5C4E5A24F51B7FC4F0E962B7087"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Members in a space force retired status</header> 
<paragraph id="HCC52216C583D496AAE8EBD3A29B8EC61"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Chapters 39 and 1209 of this title include provisions authorizing the order to active duty of a member of the Space Force in a space force retired status.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HC1E219B85EEA42EB8A035898C6857817"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The provisions of sections 688, 688a, and 12407 of this title pertaining to a retired member or a member of the Retired Reserve shall apply to a member of the Space Force in a space force retired status when ordered to active duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H229BC6B771994DC0885C00150D68475A"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The provisions of section 689 of this title pertaining to a retired member ordered to active duty shall apply to a member of the Space Force in a space force retired status who is ordered to active duty.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HFF4616784AC64E21BAF258581C67BF8D"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Other applicable provisions</header><text>The following provisions of chapter 1209 of this title pertaining shall apply to a member of the Space Force ordered to active duty in the same manner as to a Reserve or member of the Retired Reserve ordered to active duty:</text> 
<paragraph id="H39ECEA8AD6304C88A6F38E6924EBBF5B"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Section 12305, relating to the authority of the President to suspend certain laws relating to promotion, retirement, and separation.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H8DE15F33B6B342D4A27BB7C275DCF7C3"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Section 12308, relating to retention after becoming qualified for retired pay.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB127D2065866442C96C974A3BEB85465"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Section 12313, relating to release from active duty.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF1A24DA9290D46B181937B17FE807142"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Section 12314, relating to kinds of duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H496CD500FF084947BBDAE7A9F7F4150E"><enum>(5)</enum><text>Section 12315, relating to duty with or without pay.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H308E37E11A494EACBF3664BD68495CD9"><enum>(6)</enum><text>Section 12316, relating to payment of certain Reserves while on duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H06B5F5E5E2B3429ABD6135FC3B1DE5C7"><enum>(7)</enum><text>Section 12317, relating to theological students; limitations.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H353F82FFA57E4FAF93A312E7137C59B8"><enum>(8)</enum><text>Section 12320, relating to grade in which ordered to active duty.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HE125222BD9954FAEABBC754304155D9C"><enum>20107.</enum><header>Transfer to inactive status: initial service obligation not complete</header> 
<subsection id="HA6CE833546824DAEB1C23A54F1F14EF9"><enum>(a)</enum><header>General rule</header><text>A member of the Space Force who has not completed the required minimum service obligation referred to in section 20003 of this title shall, if terminating space force active status, be transferred to a space force inactive status and, unless otherwise designated an Individual Ready Guardian under section 20102 of this title, shall remain subject to order to active duty without the member’s consent under section 20106 of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HEB8A3F48C2F543049BCD5C30B0050504"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Exception</header><text>Subsection (a) does not apply to a member who is separated from the Space Force by the Secretary of the Air Force under section 20503 of this title.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H75287E1E64EA420EBC513F20A63F9626"><enum>20108.</enum><header>Members of Space Force: credit for service for purposes of laws providing pay and benefits for members, dependents, and survivors</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">For the purposes of laws providing pay and benefits for members of the armed forces and their dependents and beneficiaries:</text> <paragraph id="H875F0DC318154A658B5DA91C9BCA1F86"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Military training, duty, or other service performed by a member of the Space Force in a space force active status not on sustained duty shall be considered military training, duty, or other service, as the case may be, as a member of a reserve component.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H852BA4538006477283713A9A8307B692"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Sustained duty performed by a member of the Space Force under section 20105 of this title shall be considered active duty as a member of a regular component.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H10A2073863E044359E23E2CD74AAB90E"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Active duty performed by a member of the Space Force in a space force active status not on sustained duty shall be considered active duty as a member of a reserve component.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8B104D04F00F441B840CDE28AA8FCF77"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Inactive-duty training performed by a member of the Space Force shall be considered inactive-duty training as a member of a reserve component.</text></paragraph></section> <section id="H3A49713A0AE34A39BD8B0FFE981AAFC0"><enum>20109.</enum><header>Policy for order to active duty based upon determination by Congress</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Whenever Congress determines that more units and organizations capable of conducting space operations are needed for the national security than are available among those units comprised of members of the Space Force serving on active duty, members of the Space Force not serving on active duty shall be ordered to active duty and retained as long as so needed.</text></section></chapter><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></section> 
<section id="H4ADF71278C8F41C08BD4D6DBD027C17E"><enum>1716.</enum><header>Officers</header> 
<subsection id="HA794C796C1BC4C7692C4AB754B746AEB"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Original appointments</header><text>Subtitle F of title 10, United States Code, as amended by section 1715, is further amended by adding at the end the following new chapter:</text> <quoted-block style="USC" id="H5585F2C70FAB4D3CAC0B141A12ED64C4" display-inline="no-display-inline"> <chapter id="H5629954EC881421B8FB70B481DFF8A78"><enum>2005</enum><header>OFFICERS</header> <subchapter id="H5417A738AA984DE88683E9405F6CA63D"><enum>I</enum><header>ORIGINAL APPOINTMENTS</header> <section id="H88B1510E05394534BE4703A5958D3483"><enum>20201.</enum><header>Original appointments: how made</header> <subsection id="H3B1C9C13FC884A0987CE5FD42B8CC8E7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text>The provisions of section 531 of this title shall apply to original appointments of commissioned officers in the Space Force.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H9A46A394535947DFA84F842DCB278FC4"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Grade upon appointment</header> 
<paragraph id="HA06DE04A9D114BB09632571A72A6FC85" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The grade of a person receiving an appointment under this section who at the time of appointment is credited with service under section 20203 of this title shall be determined under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Defense based upon the amount of service credited.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA0997D86D5FB4C41848B2D043FEAC91B" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The grade of a person receiving an appointment under this section who at the time of the appointment is a commissioned officer of a reserve component shall be determined under section 20203(e) of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H7F8224DDB4B64F58A0189013CF6E01E8"><enum>20202.</enum><header>Original appointments: qualifications</header> 
<subsection id="H78A62A06B3EE4B019D9D9F2CCBC963FA"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>An original appointment as a commissioned officer in the Space Force may be given only to a person who—</text> <paragraph id="H13D39C11B28E4ACD9EEC217862AC7009"><enum>(1)</enum><text>is a citizen of the United States;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H40D416CD94D94B63A9501BCAD89C1E00"><enum>(2)</enum><text>is at least 18 years of age; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7F4ECFD47D014197B054B2118AD35EEF"><enum>(3)</enum><text>has such other physical, mental, moral, professional, and age qualifications as the Secretary of the Air Force may prescribe by regulation.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HEA3520132EA644ED8014F5BBEA4171D9"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Exception</header><text>A person who is otherwise qualified, but who has a physical condition that the Secretary of the Air Force determines will not interfere with the performance of the duties to which that person may be assigned, may be appointed as an officer in the Space Force.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HCB3C5F8E2A134952806C979D00D9552D" commented="no"><enum>20203.</enum><header>Original appointments: service credit</header> <subsection id="H57F27A65D0CB49AE9780E9CD521BA0A5" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The provisions of section 533 of this title shall apply to the crediting of prior active commissioned service for original appointments of commissioned officers.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HDC956643EB9C483299E0791904852328" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Credit for prior service</header>
