<paragraph id="H9D204F5B024142C4980DD40407101FDA" commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>For the purpose of determining the grade and rank within grade of a person receiving an original appointment in a commissioned grade in the Space Force, such person shall be credited at the time of such appointment with any commissioned service (other than service as a commissioned warrant officer) that the person performed before such appointment—</text> <subparagraph id="HFC360EDA59D84EF4BDDDEDAC1DE12195" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(A)</enum><text>as a Space Force officer on active duty or in a space force active status; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H59CFEA1FAE0744A19FB1DB96682138F0" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text>as a regular officer, or as a reserve officer in an active status, in any uniformed service.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB209A7814CBD4B6EB83E501EB8B5B726" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense under section 533 of this title shall apply to the Space Force to authorize the Secretary of the Air Force to limit the amount of prior active commissioned service with which a person receiving an original appointment may be credited under paragraph (1).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H3D9F3AA605374156A70087BDEAE52809" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Credit for education, training, and experience</header> 
<paragraph id="H0E04018F75884B45BDE24B1D46922910" commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, the Secretary shall credit a person who is receiving an original appointment in a commissioned grade in the Space Force and who has advanced education, training, or special experience with constructive service for such education, training, or experience in a particular officer career field as designated by the Secretary of the Air Force, if such education, training, or experience is directly related to the operational needs of the Space Force.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H8437F57D4E074103BCEAD6BC8D4F8CFE" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum> <subparagraph id="H9A7433E11FB14AB7B4981F271DC56DD3" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text>The Secretary may credit a person with constructive service under this subsection for each instance of relevant advanced education or training or special experience regardless of whether two or more such instances are concurrent.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H64A579D28D584358B5FFA59E22D5BA74" indent="up1" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>The Secretary may not credit more than 20 persons with an amount of constructive credit under this paragraph in any year.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7EAE6465E68D4C03825D2C627B80E061" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The amount of constructive service credited an officer under this subsection may not exceed the amount required in order for the officer to be eligible for an original appointment in the grade of colonel.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9608F61B69934A00910196A9CD9B4718" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Constructive service credited an officer under this subsection is in addition to any service credited that officer under subsection (a) and shall be credited at the time of the original appointment of the officer.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFB9455DBE41D4B519C8B227DE62535CA" indent="up1" commented="no"><enum>(5)</enum><text>Not later than December 1 of each year, the Secretary of the Air Force shall submit a report to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and House of Representatives regarding the amount of constructive service credited under this subsection during the preceding calendar year.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H827978CA329B493E9ED2FC543C7E7059" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Authorized use of constructive credit</header><text>Constructive service credited an officer under subsection (b) shall be used only for determining the officer’s—</text> <paragraph id="HC32CC60C4A2D46B0861004BEE100C6BF" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text>initial grade;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HFEF270BD1E2C43D89CDECF7D72BCEDB4" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>rank in grade; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H3B36E1B050A54351878B17AA2FE3645D" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><text>service in grade for promotion eligibility.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H96631794AEB54B92B099BBBF6C5FDCDA" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Exclusion for graduates of the Service Academies</header><text>A graduate of a Service Academy (as such term is defined in section 347 of this title) is not entitled to service credit under this section for service performed, or education, training, or experience obtained, before graduation from such Service Academy.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H7B9FF3CC36A841FB86314CA8C1717A6D" commented="no"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Reserve officers</header><text>A reserve officer (other than a warrant officer) who receives an original appointment as an officer in the Space Force shall—</text> 
<paragraph id="HE9DB3838081543488462290FE31B0629" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in the case of an officer on the active-duty list of an armed force immediately before that appointment, be appointed in the same grade and with the same date of rank as the grade and date of rank held by the officer on the active-duty list immediately before the appointment; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFE1E6B4C18E144F4B7AD52145CF6BE4D" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>in the case of an officer not on the active-duty list immediately before that appointment, be appointed in the same grade and with the same date of rank as the grade and date of rank which the officer would have held had the officer been serving on the active-duty list on the date of the appointment.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HB4F1DAF6B9F347C08FB1189A81FB69C2" commented="no"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Continuity of existing delegation of presidential appointment functions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as otherwise provided by the President by Executive order, the provisions of Executive Order 13384 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/10/531">10 U.S.C. 531</external-xref> note) relating to the functions of the President under section 531(a) of this title shall apply in the same manner to functions of the President under section 20201 of this title.</text></subsection></section></subchapter></chapter><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection> <subsection id="H0C9D7AD9534846ACB7A8283A304A1923"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Conforming amendments relating to original appointments</header> <paragraph id="HA52BA2ADD7D3407B9C60B9F0BE6D97FA"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>Section 101 of title 10, United States Code, is amended in subsection (b)(10) by inserting before the period at the end the following: <quote>and, with respect to the appointment of a member of the armed forces in the Space Force, refers to that member’s most recent appointment in the Space Force that is neither a promotion nor a demotion</quote>.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HFF8B2FB7E18844819C63B9843763C618" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Original appointments of commissioned officers</header><text>Section 531 of such title is amended by striking <quote>Regular</quote> before <quote>Space Force</quote> each place it appears.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5BA98204C5314605B10E5B0EF279D2E5"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Qualifications for original appointment as a commissioned officer</header><text>Section 532(a) of such title is amended by striking <quote>Regular Marine Corps, or Regular Space Force</quote> and inserting <quote>or Regular Marine Corps</quote>.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF71CF6EED919466DA80B097402183FE0" commented="no"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Service credit upon original appointment as a commissioned officer</header><text>Section 533 of such title is amended by striking <quote>Regular</quote> before <quote>Space Force</quote> each place it appears.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HB11BA486EE6A40739E22B3D2B6F98323"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Selection boards and promotions</header><text><external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/10/205">Chapter 205</external-xref> of title 10, United States Code, as added by subsection (a), is amended by adding at the end the following new subchapters:</text> 
<quoted-block style="USC" id="H6CC1F0B1B8524000BBA8DAE3298FA080" display-inline="no-display-inline"> 
<subchapter id="HBF6AB9F6391441BD98BCB564AB231265"><enum>II</enum><header>Selection Boards</header> 
<section id="H9B9D8E0B6E1C4040A3AC93DE87A4322D"><enum>20211.</enum><header>Convening of selection boards</header> 
<subsection id="HF0FAB828B82D4602AF2C1BFE99526640"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Whenever the needs of the service require, the Secretary of the Air Force shall convene selection boards to recommend for promotion to the next higher permanent grade officers of the Space Force in each permanent grade from first lieutenant through brigadier general.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H0F36732719794227ABF877B4ED091E6F"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Exception for officers in grade of first lieutenant</header><text>Subsection (a) does not require the convening of a selection board in the case of Space Force officers in the permanent grade of first lieutenant when the Secretary of the Air Force recommends for promotion to the grade of captain under section 20238(a)(4)(A) of this title all such officers whom the Secretary finds to be fully qualified for promotion.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HF0041FEC7FE84463943788797759F42F"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Selection boards for early retirement or discharge</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may convene selection boards to recommend officers for early retirement under section 20404(a) of this title or for discharge under section 20404(b) of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H46BBFBEF66D14D6B89E6949E940F4BE2"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Regulations</header><text>The convening of selection boards under subsection (a) shall be under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Defense.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H78BAAAF02B374B5CAA220B9192211F3C"><enum>20212.</enum><header>Composition of selection boards</header> 
<subsection id="H3999033C91C541C1B94FF16697A7A251"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Appointment and composition of boards</header> 
<paragraph id="HEBCAC63B1B69487B9EC3063854C7196C"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Members of a selection board shall be appointed by the Secretary of Air Force in accordance with this section. A selection board shall consist of five or more officers of the Space Force. Each member of a selection board must be serving in a grade higher than the grade of the officers under consideration by the board, except that no member of a board may be serving in a grade below major. The members of a selection board shall include at least one member serving on sustained duty and at least one member in a space force active status who is not serving on sustained duty. The ratio of the members of a selection board serving on sustained duty to members serving in a space force active status not on sustained duty shall, to the extent practicable, reflect the ratio of officers serving in each of those statuses who are being considered for promotion by the board. The members of a selection board shall represent the diverse population of the Space Force to the extent practicable.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF4EB7BB869C84C2E892D10E57F0AD002"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Representation from competitive categories</header> <subparagraph id="HC46971E95D4A4FCFB4178E5395EDB873" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Except as provided in subparagraph (B), a selection board shall include at least one officer from each competitive category of officers to be considered by the board.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC56FDA08FDB14C0E9DB45D34850E0D7F" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text>A selection board need not include an officer from a competitive category when there are no officers of that competitive category on the Space Force officer list in a grade higher than the grade of the officers to be considered by the board and eligible to serve on the board.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD1666F04EFC64918A338F3CE16DDDC2D"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Retired officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">If qualified officers on the Space Force officer list are not available in sufficient number to comprise a selection board, the Secretary of the Air Force shall complete the membership of the board by appointing as members of the board—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H4C3E21AD7E154EEFBFB2BE1DEEE3AE75"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Space Force officers who hold a grade higher than the grade of the officers under consideration by the board and who are retired officers; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H772869D58C0F4580B854E11CE0BBDDD6"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">if sufficient Space Force officers are not available pursuant to subparagraph (A), Air Force officers who hold a grade higher than the grade of the officers under consideration by the board and who are retired officers, but only if the Air Force officer to be appointed to the board has served in the Space Force or in a space-related career field of the Air Force for sufficient time such that the Secretary of the Air Force determines that the retired Air Force officer has adequate knowledge concerning the standards of performance and conduct required of an officer of the Space Force.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HEA0346D2A98F495B8FB3B8CF38E89C58"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Exclusion of retired general officers on active duty to serve on a board from numeric general officer active-duty limitations</header><text>A retired general officer who is on active duty for the purpose of serving on a selection board shall not, while so serving, be counted against any limitation on the number of general and flag officers who may be on active duty.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HFBE954E1D84641A3A3C45FE6825C100C"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Limitation on membership on consecutive boards</header> <paragraph id="HC09BE1A11518484E982301F300BCF10A"><enum>(1)</enum><header>General rule</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in paragraph (2), no officer may be a member of two successive selection boards convened under section 20211 of this title for the consideration of officers of the same competitive category and grade.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HBD1DBF4DB1DE41EA802226B35755A77D"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Exception for general officer boards</header><text>Paragraph (1) does not apply with respect to selection boards convened under section 20211 of this title for the consideration of officers in the grade of colonel or brigadier general.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H52513398546C46BABF6B293D88F61952"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Joint qualified officers</header> <paragraph id="H3F7F131DD41D40C8AD90A497DAE581F0" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Each selection board convened under section 20211 of this title that will consider an officer described in paragraph (2) shall include at least one officer designated by the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff who is a joint qualified officer.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H774EFC48C45F4B82AFBF8C6FF2F35000" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Paragraph (1) applies with respect to an officer who—</text> <subparagraph id="H216C1D0532B44D74A9632885F17B3946"><enum>(A)</enum><text>is serving on, or has served on, the Joint Staff; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H40D75FB21775409CB8CB3CB04F0D801A"><enum>(B)</enum><text>is a joint qualified officer.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H38CBCD18CD404939A1DC016A3D398D8E" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The Secretary of Defense may waive the requirement in paragraph (1) for any selection board of the Space Force.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HF37C2F0C472643FA971B5748E4E498BD" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>20213.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notice of convening of selection boards</header> 
<subsection id="HCAB6E4E27DB44747BDC3766FBB4B4CAA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notice to eligible officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">At least 30 days before a selection board is convened under section 20211 of this title to recommend officers in a grade for promotion to the next higher grade, the Secretary of the Air Force shall—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HEB7341D97FAE4CD0B5FA96552D35E37D"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">notify in writing the officers eligible for consideration for promotion of the date on which the board is to convene and the name and date of rank of the junior officer, and of the senior officer, in the promotion zone as of the date of the notification; or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HDDD52D56EB724059B94C03BFA80155BD"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">issue a general written notice to the Space Force regarding the convening of the board which shall include the convening date of the board and the name and date of rank of the junior officer, and of the senior officer, in the promotion zone as of the date of the notification.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H3D4C53632AEC4396B9C0F83E2CD85B59" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Communication from officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer eligible for consideration by a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title (other than an officer who has been excluded under section 20231(d) of this title from consideration by the board) may send a written communication to the board, to arrive not later than 10 calendar days before the date on which the board convenes, calling attention to any matter concerning the officer that the officer considers important to the officer’s case. The selection board shall give consideration to any timely communication under this subsection.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HFA63C0D06EA043C394858B81E6009026" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Notice of intent of certain officers To serve on or off active duty</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer on the Space Force officer list in the grade of colonel or brigadier general who receives a notice under subsection (a) shall inform the Secretary of the officer’s preference to serve either on or off sustained duty if promoted to the grade of brigadier general or major general, respectively.</text></subsection></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H31BCAAD8885345778B8B2760314ABB08" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>20214.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Information furnished to selection boards</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The provisions of section 615 of this title shall apply to information furnished to selection boards.</text></section> 
<section id="H50CB377525D646B9B312015211DE66C4"><enum>20215.</enum><header>Recommendations for promotion by selection boards</header> 
<subsection id="HB1C2A1362AED46EDA0D583BE5476619F"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Board to recommend officers best qualified for promotion</header><text>A selection board convened under section 20211 of this title shall recommend for promotion to the next higher grade those officers considered by the board whom the board, giving due consideration to the needs of the Space Force for officers with particular skills (as noted in the guidelines or information furnished the board under section 615(b) of this title), considers best qualified for promotion within each competitive category considered by the board.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H8E6CD2AE165244FBA0DBD86A25D0CD24"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Number to be recommended</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall establish the number of officers such a selection board may recommend for promotion from among officers being considered.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HB925C00285B64702860A7E04BC8222C9"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Board procedures for recommendations; limitations</header><text>A selection board convened under section 20211 of this title may not recommend an officer for promotion unless—</text> <paragraph id="H6EBF1964D0484F339CDD8A174B48EB28"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the officer receives the recommendation of a majority of the members of the board;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HD87ACE9E65834708B9E2D429313CD52A"><enum>(2)</enum><text>a majority of the members of the board finds that the officer is fully qualified for promotion; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H11F9EA2898B34549BA4813B387353788"><enum>(3)</enum><text>a majority of the members of the board, after consideration by all members of the board of any adverse information about the officer that is provided to the board under section 615 of this title, finds that the officer is among the officers best qualified for promotion to meet the needs of the Space Force consistent with the requirement of exemplary conduct set forth in section 9233 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H837A88464AFB4160A82B0B5C1C4FDAB6"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Limitation on promotions under other authority</header><text>Except as otherwise provided by law, a Space Force officer may not be promoted to a higher grade under this chapter unless the officer is considered and recommended for promotion to that grade by a selection board convened under this chapter or, in the case of an officer transferring into the Space Force from another armed force, chapter 36 or chapter 1403 of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H1E65B35B057743C4B61B86F3B05C92A8"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Disclosure of board recommendations</header><text>The recommendations of a selection board may be disclosed only in accordance with regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense. Those recommendations may not be disclosed to a person not a member of the board (or a member of the administrative staff designated by the Secretary of the Air Force to assist the board) until the written report of the recommendations of the board, required by section 617 of this title, is signed by each member of the board.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H65C5AACF29354839BAA836E553F10150"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Prohibition on attempting to influence members of a board</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force, and an officer or other official exercising authority over any member of a selection board, may not—</text> <paragraph id="H7E2D34034670412D821B56A409FE69D9"><enum>(1)</enum><text>censure, reprimand, or admonish the selection board or any member of the board with respect to the recommendations of the board or the exercise of any lawful function within the authorized discretion of the board; or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HECAD6016BAEF4F6F879BA376CCDC8CF5"><enum>(2)</enum><text>attempt to coerce or, by any unauthorized means, influence any action of a selection board or any member of a selection board in the formulation of the board’s recommendations.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H7AF085DCCE334675A083E76B458F61FA"><enum>(g)</enum><header>Higher placement on promotion list of officer of particular merit</header> <paragraph id="H21897850849B4839A90EA260E87264E2" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>In selecting the officers to be recommended for promotion, a selection board shall, when authorized by the Secretary of the Air Force, recommend officers of particular merit, pursuant to guidelines and procedures prescribed by the Secretary, from among those officers selected for promotion, to be placed higher on the promotion list established by the Secretary under section 624(a)(1) of this title.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HFF23D34ABF894100B2D5C5851BF09939" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An officer may be recommended to be placed higher on a promotion list under paragraph (1) only if the officer receives the recommendation of at least a majority of the members of the board, unless the Secretary of the Air Force establishes an alternative requirement. Any such alternative requirement shall be furnished to the board as part of the guidelines furnished to the board under section 615 of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA7C2AE31FA1C49B6AF8DD8651915A38E" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text>For the officers recommended to be placed higher on a promotion list under paragraph (1), the board shall recommend, pursuant to guidelines and procedures prescribed by the Secretary, the order in which those officers should be placed on the list.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H6074AD2B407849CB959921D9D040A557"><enum>20216.</enum><header>Reports of selection boards</header> 
<subsection id="HACD5E69763434CD98D46E859503C0820"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Each selection board convened under section 20211 of this title shall submit to the Secretary of the Air Force a written report, signed by each member of the board, containing a list of the names of the officers it recommends for promotion and certifying—</text> <paragraph id="HC9F324913A8F4B71A9C4B8A74227A5C9"><enum>(1)</enum><text>that the board has carefully considered the record of each officer whose name was furnished to it under section 615 of this title; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H3E1A37DA2924465D9A3C9FC236710785"><enum>(2)</enum><text>that, in the opinion of a majority of the members of the board, the officers recommended for promotion by the board are best qualified for promotion to meet the needs of the Space Force (as noted in the guidelines or information furnished the board under section 615(b) of this title) among those officers whose names were furnished to the selection board.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H5F7EE9FE275A463399C5EDDE9515480A"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Officers who should be required to show cause for retention</header><text>A selection board convened under section 20211 of this title shall include in its report the name of any officer before it for consideration for promotion whose record, in the opinion of a majority of the members of the board, indicates that the officer should be required under section 20503 of this title to show cause for the officer’s retention in a space force active status.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H959E7B913BB545608A5E89AD8E9D8E66"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Officers recommended to be placed higher on the promotion list</header><text>A selection board convened under section 20211 of this title shall, when authorized under section 20214(g) of this title, include in its report the names of those officers recommended by the board to be placed higher on the promotion list and the order in which the board recommends that those officers should be placed on the list.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HD658306527004862BA5668327288D8D4" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Recommendation for officers to be excluded from future consideration for promotion</header><text>A selection board convened under section 20211 of this title may include in its report a recommendation that an officer considered by the board be excluded from future consideration for promotion under this chapter.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H5201F221054E4B5DB7EAAFD667EF6BA9"><enum>20217.</enum><header>Action on reports of selection boards for promotion to brigadier general or major general<editorial></editorial></header> 
<subsection id="H14659297DDF24468BAB210A914A28015"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">After reviewing a report received under section 20215 of this title recommending officers on the Space Force officer list for promotion to the grade of brigadier general or major general, but before submitting the report to the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Air Force may, under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, adjust the placement of officers as recommended in the report in order to ensure that sufficient number of officers on both sustained and non-sustained duty are promoted to meet the requirements of the Space Force to fill general officer vacancies.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HC72966E0B31242668679A13CFD7BFDED" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Report</header><text>Whenever the Secretary of the Air Force uses the authority under subsection (a), the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and House of Representatives a report informing the committees that the authority has been used and the reason for the use of the authority.</text></subsection></section></subchapter> 
<subchapter id="H66243DF48F51451F839ED8F06C456EBE"><enum>III</enum><header>Promotions</header> 
<section id="H37BB70629F9D4AA5B14A8066BEB31ABB" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>20231.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Eligibility for consideration for promotion: general rules</header> 
<subsection id="HC24CAF3CFBC04FFA83E55F5B60229158"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header> 
<paragraph id="H9DE65D6A4ADF4DDDAFECD1FB137ACBDD"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Requirement to be on Space Force officer list</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer is eligible under this chapter for consideration for promotion by a selection board convened under section 14101(a) of this title only if the officer is on the Space Force officer list.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H211F258D81F341DDB82FFF65447BFC23"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Authority to preclude from consideration certain officers based on time of entry on or departure from sustained duty</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H7F7C88C0B8F44C41A223A2332BA99C89"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">may, by regulation, prescribe a period of time, not to exceed one year, from the time an officer on the Space Force officer list transfers on or off of sustained duty during which the officer shall be ineligible for consideration for promotion; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H78D0079F38714AE38A8EF7B4C2891855"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">may, by regulation, provide for the exclusion from consideration for promotion by a selection board of an officer otherwise eligible to be considered by the board who has an established date for removal from the Space Force officer list that is not more than 90 days after the date on which the board is to be convened.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7B06F5EF2D534213B57E497AF13F73DA"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Certain officers not to be considered</header><text>A selection board convened under section 20211 of this title may not consider for promotion to the next higher grade any of the following officers:</text> <paragraph id="H42A6234BD7AF4D958A05DA6DF12DD178"><enum>(1)</enum><text>An officer whose name is on a promotion list for that grade as a result of recommendation for promotion to that grade by an earlier selection board convened under that section or section 20151 of this title, under section 14101 or 14502 of this title, or under chapter 36 of this title.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H57E5ED9D84C1458F95D706DBB159E78C"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An officer who is recommended for promotion to that grade in the report of an earlier selection board convened under a provision referred to in paragraph (1), in the case of such a report that has not yet been approved by the President.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H9C157FE230EE4A129B84B3E941466321"><enum>(3)</enum><text>An officer who has been nominated by the President for promotion to that grade under any other provision of law, if that nomination is pending before the Senate.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H93778EC4791945CC93A8B21FD9CE469A"><enum>(4)</enum><text>An officer in the grade of first lieutenant who is on an approved all-fully-qualified-officers list under section 20238(a)(4) of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB3DA36B8E1684F58811E6285AE77FCD5"><enum>(5)</enum><text>An officer excluded under 20232 of this title.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8439E41C66BD49178AA20D6EEAD665F2"><enum>(6)</enum><text>An officer who has failed of promotion to a higher grade the maximum number of times specified for opportunities for promotion for such grade within the competitive category concerned pursuant to section 20234 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HFFB8A9E163854FAF91E9DC54801F3D9B"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Certain colonels</header> <paragraph id="HDBA36C0416D643B1BC72961292F35895"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Authority to preclude from consideration</header><text>The Secretary of Defense may authorize the Secretary of the Air Force to preclude from consideration by selection boards for promotion to the grade of brigadier general, officers in the grade of colonel who—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H9EB1DBF41DFC473BB318BDC8BF6CDD21"><enum>(A)</enum><text>have been considered and not selected for promotion to the grade of brigadier general or by at least two selection boards; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H5BE15820B40742E696967B68728C15E7"><enum>(B)</enum><text>are determined, in accordance with standards and procedures prescribed pursuant to paragraph (2), as not being exceptionally well qualified for promotion.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCA4664812CCB48858DCD8234B1166978"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Regulations</header><text>If the Secretary of Defense authorizes the Secretary of the Air Force to have the authority described in subparagraph (A), the Secretary shall prescribe by regulation the standards and procedures for the exercise of such authority. Those regulations shall apply uniformly among the military departments and shall include the following provisions:</text> <subparagraph id="HCB94B970927A42E39428267928F80571"><enum>(A)</enum><text>A requirement that the Secretary of the Air Force may exercise such authority in the case of a particular selection board only if the Secretary of Defense approves the exercise of that authority for that board.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H1681D16EA0344E7B940708AF7BFC1487"><enum>(B)</enum><text>A requirement that an officer may be precluded from consideration by a selection board under this paragraph only upon the recommendation of a preselection board of officers convened by the Secretary of the military department concerned and composed of at least three officers all of whom are serving in a grade higher than the grade of such officer.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HF29A9DA7A6D84F80BF8F3DBAD5782469"><enum>(C)</enum><text>A requirement that such a preselection board may not recommend that an officer be precluded from such consideration unless the Secretary of the Air Force has given the officer advance written notice of the convening of such board and of the military records that will be considered by the board and has given the officer a reasonable period before the convening of the board in which to submit comments to the board.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H09127E5B33FA43BC9E58BFF05D2751BF"><enum>(D)</enum><text>A requirement that the Secretary of the Air Force shall provide general guidance to the board in accordance with standards and procedures prescribed by the Secretary of Defense in those regulations.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H3A89A9B468BC4427B2B62F1A368E7B6C"><enum>(E)</enum><text>A requirement that the preselection board may recommend that an officer be precluded from consideration by a selection board only on the basis of the general guidance provided by the Secretary Air Force, information in the officer’s official military personnel records that has been described in the notice provided the officer as required pursuant to subparagraph (C), and any communication to the board received from that officer before the board convenes.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H072B999867404B3FB56AF67420900A3F"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Brigadier generals</header> 
<paragraph id="H7D38D7DD91BD49A8BC9598C42B601EF6"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Officers not on Space Force officer list</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">A brigadier general who is not eligible for consideration for promotion because the officer is not on the Space Force officer list (as required by paragraph (1) of subsection (a) for such eligibility) is nevertheless eligible for consideration for promotion to the grade of major general by a selection board convened under section 20211(a) of this title if—</text> <subparagraph id="HD4A6D53426594656A2F853C1ED0A94E5"><enum>(A)</enum><text>as of the date of the convening of the promotion board, the officer has been in an inactive status for less than the minimum threshold established in paragraph (2) of subsection (a); and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC104F84853F6436B9F1B6314982D14AC"><enum>(B)</enum><text>immediately before the date of the officer’s most recent transfer to an inactive status, the officer had continuously served on the Space Force officer list for at least one year.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H3E9DAB1F225A47378EEE6E33C6C9F5EE"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Officers not meeting minimum participation threshold</header><text>A brigadier general who is on the Space Force officer list but who is not eligible for consideration for promotion because the officer’s service does not meet the minimum participation threshold established under subsection (a)(2) is nevertheless eligible for consideration for promotion to the grade of major general by a promotion board convened under section 20211(a) of this title if—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H02339408F736439281DD7C3DE4CFCC21"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the officer was transferred from an inactive status to the reserve active-status list during the one-year period preceding the date of the convening of the promotion board;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H41D8B3EA151842BF9B8229687D5A8A6B"><enum>(B)</enum><text>immediately before the date of the officer’s most recent transfer to an active status, the officer had been in an inactive status for less than one year; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HE63046704DD34B6DB5FC93DFA1563158"><enum>(C)</enum><text>immediately before the date of the officer’s most recent transfer to an inactive status, the officer had continuously served for at least one year on the reserve active-status list or the active-duty list (or a combination of the reserve active-status list and the active-duty list).</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HB311C23691044D09A0C6017F71E50615"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Officers on educational delay</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer on the Space Force officer list is ineligible for consideration for promotion, but shall remain on the Space Force officer list, while the officer—</text> 
<paragraph id="HC143D61E87DB489EAF0196A654D08174"><enum>(1)</enum><text>is pursuing a program of graduate level education in an educational delay status approved by the Secretary concerned; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD9D3CB6E2F5E4332B9A8844D01AA4CA5"><enum>(2)</enum><text>is receiving from the Secretary financial assistance in connection with the pursuit of that program of education while in that status.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HDFBC1387CFA94AA6AED4D6DF66A48D02"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Certain officers not to be considered for selection for promotion</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the Air Force may provide that an officer who is in a space force active status, but is in a duty status in which the only points the officer accrues under section 12732(a)(2) of this title are pursuant to subparagraph (C)(i) of that section, shall not be considered for selection for promotion until completion of two years of service in such duty status. Any such officer may remain on the Space Force officer list.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HEA0A5EABF9F8448C9E0068D7BCA3BBFC"><enum>20232.</enum><header>Authority to allow officers to opt out of selection board consideration</header> <subsection id="H3CD4E11E934E44599304DF78639B78DF"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the Air Force may provide that an officer on the Space Force officer list may, upon the officer’s request and with the approval of the Secretary, be excluded from consideration by a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title to consider officers for promotion to the next higher grade.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HD0054636EF9B4FBC8667D6D37270A925"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Criteria</header><text>The Secretary may only approve a request under subsection (a) as follows:</text> <paragraph id="H25E04DD035F1438EA32E84C192233EA6"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Completion of certain assignments</header><text>If—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H2E71ED188FC34D2FAEFE62E73686AA5F"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the basis for the request is to allow an officer to complete a broadening assignment, an advanced education assignment, another assignment of significant value to the Department, or a career progression requirement delayed by such an assignment;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H432CDB304DB04A1C9B0F8F42473E7FAE"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Secretary determines the exclusion from consideration is in the best interest of the Space Force; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H6D0E34E52E274D5791F2C43184B55F73"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the officer has not previously failed of selection for promotion to the grade for which the officer requests the exclusion from consideration.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6B0D99015E5543329E78F43CF4165061"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Completion of certain education</header><text>If—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H725B50808DA141DC8B1AE3AD0744212F"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the basis for the request is to allow an officer to complete advanced education or professional military education;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H7FB73AF5180646918658F3BC8CE4D87D"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Secretary determines that it is in the best interests of the Space Force for the officer to continue to serve in current position and grade; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H4C77661AEC8A4FAAA33350EAC2596134"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the officer has not previously opted out of a promotion board under this section.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HA7CEA48EF94E41A19715CC470D8575EE"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Service in critical skill position</header><text>If—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H6C34F2BE2A184E6096A5C602C7BB6D37"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the officer is serving in a critical skill position that cannot be filled by another Space Force officer serving in the same grade;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H6BD0DB02DEDD491C99D51916A48B8198"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Secretary determines that it is in the best interests of the Space Force for the officer to continue to serve in their current position and grade; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H62376535BBA54BD2A16D0D0314FEB658"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the officer has not previously opted out of a promotion board under this section.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H55E04A353F274E9DBEBE89FAB9D92AE4"><enum>20233.</enum><header>Eligibility for consideration for promotion: designation as joint qualified officer required before promotion to brigadier general; exceptions</header> <subsection id="H60C80B27D8424B45A16DA3F14B1BFC70"><enum>(a)</enum><header>General rule</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer on the Space Force officer list may not be appointed to the grade of brigadier general unless the officer has been designated as a joint qualified officer in accordance with section 661 of this title.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HC52A5D9ACD5745799ECF1364DFB369CF"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Exceptions</header><text>Subject to subsection (c), the Secretary of Defense may waive subsection (a) in the following circumstances:</text> <paragraph id="HB0570E8D83AF4FC99968DE7C48888431"><enum>(1)</enum><text>When necessary for the good of the service.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB7C692BED7514BFFBF88D4140B9AFB06"><enum>(2)</enum><text>In the case of an officer whose proposed selection for promotion is based primarily upon scientific and technical qualifications for which joint requirements do not exist.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H57506B15159C4E5C998C97AFD1574327"><enum>(3)</enum><text>In the case of an officer selected by a promotion board for appointment to the grade of brigadier general while serving in a joint duty assignment if—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HCE66EC2A01BF404A8A340C94F14794FF"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the officer’s total consecutive service in joint duty assignments is not less than two years; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HAE7415A12FC14ADFAB62D9A1F47E23B3"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the officer has successfully completed a program of education described in subsections (b) and (c) of section 2155 of this title.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF9EA31CCEFA54F02B76DF026882D8EEB"><enum>(4)</enum><text>In the case of an officer who—</text> <subparagraph id="H1F6EE1C93271482A86D066E2A99FF8C3"><enum>(A)</enum><text>is selected by a promotion board for appointment to the grade of brigadier general;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HAD22220DF3C34D849FD09C71D12B37B9"><enum>(B)</enum><text>is not exempted under subsection (g); and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H42991CD24E804A658914EC6B566E9C58"><enum>(C)</enum><text>has successfully completed the education requirements prescribed in subparagraph (A) of section 661(c)(1) of this title but has not been afforded the opportunity to complete the experience requirements described in subparagraph (B) of that section.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HEE59A94DF21A4B829A3ADA3200F12173"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Waiver to be individual</header><text>A waiver may be granted under subsection (b) only on a case-by-case basis in the case of an individual officer.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H3BBBF96DFA194DBD87ADE2F09530F681"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Special rule for good-of-the-service waiver</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In the case of a waiver under subsection (b)(1), the Secretary of Defense shall provide that the first duty assignment as a general officer of the officer for whom the waiver is granted shall be in a joint duty assignment.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HA0F6992FB0824C2AA457A329EBE5D4DC"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Limitation on delegation of waiver authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The authority of the Secretary of Defense to grant a waiver under subsection (b)(4) may only be delegated as provided in section 619a(e) of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HDAABC473EC6843E0AD2DD463EF50A41F"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Regulations</header><text>The Secretary of Defense shall prescribe regulations to carry out this section. The regulations shall specifically identify for purposes of subsection (b)(2) those categories of officers for which selection for promotion to brigadier general is based primarily upon scientific and technical qualifications for which joint requirements do not exist.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2CDFF7F1280E446187D32CBE490C7378"><enum>(g)</enum><header>Exemption</header><text>Subsection (a) shall not apply to an officer who transfers to the Space Force from a reserve component before the first day of the sixth fiscal year beginning after the date of the enactment of this section, and who, as of the date of the transfer, is serving in the grade of major, lieutenant colonel, or colonel or, in the case of the Navy or Coast Guard, lieutenant commander, commander, or captain.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HA33117636B004DBFB115564385FE9E97"><enum>20234.</enum><header>Opportunities for consideration for promotion</header> <subsection id="HFFEBEBCBE4FA451489568DED53044AB9"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Specification of number of opportunities for consideration for promotion</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall specify the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded to Space Force officers for promotion to each grade above the grade of captain .</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HF1AE89644F68428C9D59B9FB3BF4E959"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Limited authority of Secretary of the Air Force to modify number of opportunities</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may modify the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers within a competitive category for promotion to a particular grade, as previously specified by the Secretary pursuant subsection (a), not more frequently than once every five years.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HC1800CBDE68046B0A5112908014DBB64"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Authority of Secretary of Defense to modify number of opportunities</header><text>The Secretary of Defense may modify the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers of the Space Force within a competitive category for promotion to a particular grade, as previously specified or modified pursuant to any provision of this section, at the discretion of the Secretary.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H663B69B73FD04B5BB5C277B2E3FEDA54"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Limitation on number of opportunities specified</header><text>The number of opportunities for consideration for promotion to be afforded officers of the Space Force within a competitive category for promotion to a particular grade, as specified or modified pursuant to any provision of this section, may not exceed five opportunities.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H69C3F5BE5D7149718B88ACDE5FE9778B"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Effect of certain reduction in number of opportunities specified</header><text>If, by reason of a reduction in the number of opportunities for consideration for promotion under this section, an officer would no longer have one or more opportunities for consideration for promotion that were available to the officer before the reduction, the officer shall be afforded one additional opportunity for consideration for promotion after the reduction.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H14D1EAE0CB4441EEB368E359C0F9E64A"><enum>20235.</enum><header>Space Force officer list</header> 
<subsection id="H44EC564337274DED8DC62308D3CD3011"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Single list</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall maintain a single list of all Space Force officers serving in a space force active status. The list shall be known as the <quote>Space Force officer list</quote>.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H4E5D4A43CCD9400386EEFC95E0BEF90D"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Order of officers on list</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers shall be carried on the Space Force officer list in the order of seniority of the grade in which they are serving. Officers serving in the same grade shall be carried in the order of their rank in that grade.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HB39E2FA996524C51A25299E7DB8C6F22"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Effect of service in a temporary appointment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer whose position on the Space Force officer list results from service under a temporary appointment or in a grade held by reason of assignment to a position has, when that appointment or assignment ends, the grade and position on the Space Force officer list that the officer would have held if the officer had not received that appointment or assignment.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HAB800BD71D694454B149590A5B36335A"><enum>20236.</enum><header>Competitive categories</header> <subsection id="HC2659EADA7074005ACD429E519B014E9"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Requirement to establish competitive categories for promotion</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Air Force shall establish at least one competitive category for promotion for officers on the Space Force officer list. Each officer whose name appears on the Space Force officer list shall be carried in a competitive category of officers. Officers in the same competitive category shall compete among themselves for promotion.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H8F4F884A569344F2BA4B8FC5BB10AD4F"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Single competitive category for promotion to general officer grades</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the Air Force shall establish a single competitive category for all officers on the Space Force officer list who will be considered by a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title for promotion to the grade of brigadier general or major general.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H528F58C335174D419B5769152F28757F"><enum>20237.</enum><header>Numbers to be recommended for promotion</header> <subsection id="HA0A45238562B4F45AA9F762018007467"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Promotion to grades below brigadier general</header> <paragraph id="HD01525CF266A4F66A1CD8E2B1BD93805"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Determination of maximum number</header><text>Before convening a selection board under section 20211 of this title to consider officers for recommendation for promotion to a grade below brigadier general and in any competitive category, the Secretary of the Air Force shall determine the maximum number of officers in that competitive category that the board may recommend for promotion.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HAFF1B64745DB4DE09EAA6BDFF3809844"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Determinations</header><text>In order to make the determination under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall determine—</text> <subparagraph id="H6E1B2797942B4D88AF3935E56B0C8F12"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the number of positions needed to accomplish mission objectives which require officers of that competitive category in the grade to which the board will recommend officers for promotion;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H5A3BB26A94B64C169A287A416558832A"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the estimated number of officers needed to fill vacancies in those positions during the period in which it is anticipated that officers selected for promotion will be promoted; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H2CE2261DC39145379B9B43E8C60011E8"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the number of officers in a space force active status authorized by the Secretary of the Air Force to serve both on sustained duty and not on sustained duty in the grade and competitive category under consideration.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HDE2F2D364F834A08A5E044EA38C330FE"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Promotion to brigadier general and major general</header> 
<paragraph id="H0D6EB8F57C914DE8B665E0DE6D16DCD4"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Determination of maximum numbers</header><text>Before convening a selection board under section 20211 of this title to consider officers for recommendation for promotion to the grade of brigadier general or major general, the Secretary of the Air Force shall determine the maximum number of officers serving in a space force active status on sustained duty, and the maximum number of officers serving in a space force active status not on sustained duty, that the board may recommend for promotion.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HACE2BBA8F1B747CFBDB2EEBFA357FCD1"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Determinations</header><text>In order to make the determinations under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall determine—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H58BFDE298EB546338DF8F9A1A9138156"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the number of positions needed to accomplish mission objectives which require officers serving in a space force active status on sustained duty, and in a space force active status not on sustained duty, in the grade to which the board will recommend officers for promotion; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HF04BDA72B92144B98020CE4A7125657A"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the estimated number of officers on sustained duty and not on sustained duty needed to fill vacancies in those positions over the 24-month period beginning on the date on which the selection board convenes.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H116D5647EA844606B4A7E38AC71047FB" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>20238.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Establishment of promotion zones</header> 
<subsection id="HE6FE988F5D8C441EBF747C8C1F92F871" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Before convening a selection board under section 20211 of this title to consider officers for promotion to any grade above first lieutenant or lieutenant (junior grade), the Secretary of the Air Force shall establish a promotion zone for officers serving in each grade and competitive category to be considered by the board.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HFC63304BB5FC497EA49E979D2092655D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Determination of number</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Secretary of the Air Force shall determine the number of officers in the promotion zone for officers serving in any grade and competitive category from among officers who are eligible for promotion in that grade and competitive category. Such determination shall be made on the basis of an estimate of—</text> 
<paragraph id="HB0ADB86DE67E46F6A8F5AEFC7D9075B4" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the number of officers needed in that competitive category in the next higher grade in each of the next five years;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6C13283832C24B90A324D3867B6076B7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the number of officers to be serving in that competitive category in the next higher grade in each of the next five years;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9C571806163343998C480A79A8DB509F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in the case of a promotion zone for officers to be promoted to a grade to which section 523 of this title is applicable, the number of officers authorized for such grade under such section to be on sustained duty on the last day of each of the next five fiscal years; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H86C638E3E9024CF6BF0DA9ECEB264197" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the number of officers that should be placed in that promotion zone in each of the next five years to provide to officers in those years relatively similar opportunity for promotion. </text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H44BE9BBBE9AE4FF88892207CB6A40A48"><enum>20239.</enum><header>Promotions: how made</header> 
<subsection id="H66690969A37D47CCBFC88502EA04F747"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Promotion lists</header> 
<paragraph id="HBFD8640A9B684ADB9F18398B8FF0B2F8"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Placement of names on promotion list</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">When the report of a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title is approved by the President, the Secretary of the Air Force shall place the names of all officers approved for promotion within a competitive category on a single list for that competitive category, to be known as a promotion list, in the order of the seniority of such officers on the Space Force officer list or based on particular merit, as determined by the promotion board, or as modified by the Secretary of the Air Force under section 20217 of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7274517D75B8404E8AAECBCC7D299600"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Time of establishment of promotion list</header><text>A promotion list is considered to be established under this section as of the date of the approval of the report of the selection board under paragraph (1).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H41E7997D46A1473A89616DE867E07E05"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Promotions; how made; order</header> 
<paragraph id="HD1D47A984AE8465C8BB2187AAD5C0D64"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Appointment authority</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers on a promotion list shall be promoted by appointment in the manner specified in section 20201 of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HDC0C43F519EC4FA49D2D58CFA63BD430"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Timing</header><text>Officers on a promotion list for a competitive category shall be promoted to the next higher grade in accordance with regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H013E9494D5AA42DCB550D12A126F84C2"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Order</header><text>Except as provided in subsections (e) and (f), promotions shall be made in the order in which the names of officers appear on the promotion list and after officers previously selected for promotion in that competitive category have been promoted.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H12D7FD5D650A448690232F7B502722B4"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Promotions to grade of first lieutenant</header><text>Officers to be promoted to the grade of first lieutenant shall be promoted in accordance with regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H166EC90A554F4787B8E650068B21E79A"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Promotion of first lieutenants on an all-fully-qualified officers list</header> 
<paragraph id="HE6B14461A2FC4FDD804360381A5FFD73" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in subsection (f), officers on the Space Force officer list in the grade of first lieutenant who are on an approved all-fully-qualified-officers list shall be promoted to the grade of captain in accordance with regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HC6EEEDB920404ADCA9450BB5E8B8D70A" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An all-fully-qualified-officers list shall be considered to be approved for purposes of subparagraph (A) when the list is approved by the President. When so approved, such a list shall be treated in the same manner as a promotion list under this chapter.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H347DBFEAABC34CE98CC7D7232D0EB320" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may make a recommendation to the President for approval of an all-fully-qualified-officers list only when the Secretary determines that all officers on the list are needed in the next higher grade to accomplish mission objectives.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7B8E37BE5872427BA981EEB4A590B226" indent="up1"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">For purposes of this paragraph, an all-fully-qualified-officers list is a list of all officers on the Space Force officer list in a grade who the Secretary of the Air Force determines—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HEC8526F4FF824868AF6150DDCAA2E4B6"><enum>(A)</enum><text>are fully qualified for promotion to the next higher grade; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HE95F4AFEA2A34193BF3B61C963C41A4A"><enum>(B)</enum><text>would be eligible for consideration for promotion to the next higher grade by a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title upon the convening of such a board.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HDB3431E091344068B0C4EA2FD3E3DAB0" indent="up1"><enum>(5)</enum><text>If the Secretary of the Air Force determines that one or more officers or former officers were not placed on an all-fully-qualified-list under this subsection because of administrative error, the Secretary may prepare a supplemental all-fully-qualified-officers list containing the names of any such officers for approval in accordance with this subsection.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H0A7C8022A22544A99209338B851AD992"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Date of rank</header> <paragraph id="H4F74FC8A57D8493B8B2032C98C610741"><enum>(1)</enum><header>General rule</header><text>The date of rank of an officer appointed to a higher grade under this section is determined under section 741(d) of this title.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H369E65E4D8244AD385F822367B7C91EC"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Adjustments</header><text>The date of rank of an officer appointed to a higher grade under this section may be adjusted in the same manner as an adjustment may be made under section 741(d)(4) of this title in the date of rank of an officer appointed to a higher grade under section 624(a) of this title. In any use of the authority under the preceding sentence, subparagraph (C)(ii) of such section shall be applied by substituting <quote>Space Force officer list</quote> for <quote>active-duty list</quote>.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5611F25E9489444E9F0934C5B5F5FF45"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Additional pay and allowances precluded</header><text>Except as provided in paragraph (2) or as otherwise specifically authorized by law, an officer is not entitled to additional pay or allowances if the effective date of the officer’s promotion is adjusted to reflect a date earlier than the actual date of the officer’s promotion.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H475F2D5EA5B84D1EA738668241F12C68"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Delay of promotions to general officer grades to comply with strength limitations</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, the promotion of an officer on the Space Force officer list to the grade of brigadier general or major general shall be delayed if that promotion would cause any strength limitation of section 526 of this title to be exceeded. The delay shall expire when the Secretary of the Air Force determines that the delay is no longer required to ensure compliance with the strength limitation.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HF03F303B79614EFEB209040F03DFD1A4"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Authority to delay appointments for specified reasons</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The provisions of section 14311 of this title shall apply to the appointment of an officer under this section in the same manner as they apply to an appointment of an officer under that section, and any reference in that section to an reserve active-status list shall be treated for purposes of applicability to an officer of the Space Force as referring to the Space Force officer list.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H3C94FD00AE6647E29E62F0B858245369" commented="no"><enum>20240.</enum><header>Acceptance of promotions; oath of office</header> 
<subsection id="HB3156ABFDB5140BC8F375ACC799A3D5E" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Acceptance</header><text>An officer who is appointed to a higher grade under section 20239 of this title is considered to have accepted the appointment on the date on which the appointment is made unless the officer expressly declines the appointment.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HEEC173C790D0482993110A267A5852BB" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Oath</header><text>An officer who has served continuously since taking the oath of office prescribed in section 3331 of title 5 is not required to take a new oath upon appointment to a higher grade under section 20239 of this title.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H4335E73C38CB4464A236EC517A7090CC" commented="no"><enum>20241.</enum><header>Removal of officers from a list of officers recommended for promotion</header> 
<subsection id="HC19DCD9373DE4D85B2576FEBBF0027C2" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Removal by President</header><text>The President may remove the name of any officer from a promotion list at any time before the date on which the officer is promoted.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HAEA32DD0587F484A8F4C2FFE832CA353" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Removal for withholding of Senate advice and consent</header><text>If the Senate does not give its advice and consent to the appointment to the next higher grade of an officer whose name is on a list of officers approved by the President for promotion (except in the case of promotions to a grade to which appointments may be made by the President alone), the name of that officer shall be removed from the list.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H067519D7C5A84C1A9D32CC9DEB40B7AA" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Removal after 18 months</header> 
<paragraph id="HC1E2D3FD4B724E38BAD6F0B5DB2BF517" commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>If an officer whose name is on a list of officers approved for promotion under section 20238(a) of this title to a grade for which appointment is required by section 20201(a) of this title to be made by and with the advice and consent of the Senate is not appointed to that grade under such section during the officer’s promotion eligibility period, the officer’s name shall be removed from the list unless as of the end of such period the Senate has given its advice and consent to the appointment.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H92A881EA4CE940B492F7CE4509EB9251" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Before the end of the promotion eligibility period with respect to an officer under paragraph (1), the President may extend that period for purposes of paragraph (1) by an additional 12 months.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC2F3D3DA1A274B5F9B2687EE44B395D1" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(3)</enum><text>In this subsection, the term <quote>promotion eligibility period</quote> means, with respect to an officer whose name is on a list of officers approved for promotion under section 20238(a) of this title to a grade for which appointment is required by section 20201(a) of this title to be made by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, the period beginning on the date on which the list is so approved and ending on the first day of the eighteenth month following the month during which the list is so approved.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HBDE5AD0D10D94594B903848A7A685B5E" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Administrative removal</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, if an officer on the Space Force officer list is discharged or dropped from the rolls or transferred to a retired status after having been recommended for promotion to a higher grade under this chapter, but before being promoted, the officer’s name shall be administratively removed from the list of officers recommended for promotion by a selection board.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H51BAFB7CE0D34928AAA73331FAE276F3" commented="no"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Continued eligibility for promotion</header> 
<paragraph id="H2BA6567E83E64BA4B3ECE4E48D084CEE" commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer whose name is removed from a list under subsection (a), (b), or (c) continues to be eligible for consideration for promotion. If that officer is recommended for promotion by the next selection board convened for that officer’s grade and competitive category and the officer is promoted, the Secretary of the Air Force may, upon the promotion, grant the officer the same date of rank, the same effective date for the pay and allowances of the grade to which promoted, and the same position on the Space Force officer list, as the officer would have had if the officer’s name had not been removed from the list.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HE6A7E02E480B46D482D4C12157A35C0C" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>If such an officer who is in a grade below the grade of colonel is not recommended for promotion by the next selection board convened for the officer’s grade and competitive category, or if the officer’s name is again removed from the list of officers recommended for promotion, or if the Senate again does not give its advice and consent to his promotion, the officer shall be considered for all purposes to have failed of selection for promotion to the next higher grade.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HFA1F9CBE3D634AD79753D81723A61F6A" commented="no"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Applicability of previous Executive order</header><text>Except as otherwise provided by the President by Executive order, any Executive order issued before the date of the enactment of this section relating to functions of the President under section 14310 of this title shall apply in the same manner to functions of the President under this section.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HB369FCE086C3474EBD992BDA67EB557F" commented="no"><enum>20242.</enum><header>Authority to vacate promotions to grade of brigadier general</header> <subsection id="H2203BB836211452184DEE7D18B526A2E" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Authority</header><text>The President may vacate the appointment of a Space Force officer to the grade of brigadier general if the period of time during which the officer has served in that grade after promotion to that grade is less than 18 months.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HADF9675D8AA34667B3BE814D032C316E" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Effect of promotion being vacated</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer whose promotion to the grade of brigadier general is vacated under this section holds the grade of colonel. Upon assuming the grade of colonel under this section, the officer shall have the same position on the Space Force officer list as the officer would have had if the officer had not served in the higher grade.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HCD69778F57724A1BA06C715F8BAC88B9" commented="no"><enum>20243.</enum><header>General officers ceasing to occupy positions commensurate with grade</header> <subsection id="H441CCAB4940B453FA9ABB27DF96FA52C" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>General officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Within 60 days after an officer of the Space Force on the Space Force officer list in a general officer grade ceases to occupy a position commensurate with that grade (or commensurate with a higher grade), the Secretary of the Air Force shall transfer or discharge the officer in accordance with whichever of the following the officer elects:</text> 
<paragraph id="H7F75F8007547490BA95F881CA4A78876" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Transfer the officer in grade to the Space Force retired list, if the officer is qualified and applies for the transfer.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H2FA03E1B53134FB5A82D2E3CAE9A3159" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Transfer the officer in grade to a Space Force inactive status, if the officer is qualified.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC4E6D8ACD3EB415D834CD882A69D7C53" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Discharge the officer from the officer’s appointment and, if the officer is qualified and applies therefor, appoint the officer in the grade held by the officer as a before the officer’s appointment in a general officer grade.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H474B284F82304F638661A9F29897EC9E" commented="no"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Discharge the officer from the officer’s appointment.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H24ABFBB002CD4A51A1D351E462F91AD8" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Credit for service in grade</header><text>An officer who is appointed under subsection (a)(3) shall be credited with an amount of service in the grade in which appointed that is equal to the amount of prior service in an active status in that grade and in any higher grade.</text></subsection></section></subchapter> <subchapter id="H5A01BD3EEB6F4ED0BC3F2D84634B9527" commented="no"><enum>IV</enum><header>Failure of Selection for Promotion and Involuntary Separation</header> <section id="H1B6BC0FE461B427D946678FDA7323A49" commented="no"><enum>20251.</enum><header>Failure of selection for promotion</header> <subsection id="H5F1EA10A0D9F462DB725F5CDA07C0F07" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Except as provided in this section, sections 14501, 14503, and 14504 and section 631 and 632 of this title shall apply to promotions of officers on the Space Force officer list. For the purpose of such applicability—</text> 
<paragraph id="H6E996A0121CF40FEBF958FC34D34E713" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any reference in those sections to the reserve active-status list or the active-duty list shall apply to the Space Force officer list; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H86454DF84A5542B08586218BBC0E8A18" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>any reference in those sections to a board convened under section 14201 or 611 of this title shall apply to a board convened under section 20211 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection>
