<subsection id="H5988C114433E4A39B04F97D0D72D0BB8" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Inapplicability of failure of selection for promotion to officers above promotion zone</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The reference in section 14501 of this title to an officer above the promotion zone shall not apply in the promotion of officers on the Space Force officer list.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H2DF58B7309344F18852D9D0A9C466994" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Retirement authorities</header><text>In applying section 631 or 632 of this title to such an officer, the reference in subsection (a)(3) of that section to qualifying for retirement under certain sections of this title shall be deemed to refer to qualifying for retirement under any provision of law other than chapter 61 of this title.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H2F5A4DA2682F417EBACE5B9EDAA27607" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Effect of failure of selection</header><text>In the administration of this chapter pursuant to subsection (a)—</text> <paragraph id="H95B44962538B4904B0A4EB79085824F6" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">an officer on the Space Force officer list shall not be deemed to have failed twice of selection for promotion for purposes of section 629(e)(2) or 14502(b) of this title until the officer has failed selection of promotion to the next higher grade the maximum number of times specified for opportunities for promotion to such grade within the competitive category concerned under section 20234 of this title; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HBE98190EF4E34A3C9AAEA4489293543A" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any reference in section 631(a) or 632(a) of this title, or in sections 14504 through 14506 of this title, to an officer who has failed of selection for promotion to the next higher grade for the second time shall be deemed to refer instead to an officer on the Space Force officer list who has failed of selection for promotion to the next higher grade for the maximum number of times specified for opportunities for promotion to such grade within the competitive category concerned under section 20234 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H23BB1386375E45D8816CA9A240F0C2D8" commented="no"><enum>20251.</enum><header>Special selection boards; correction of errors</header> <subsection id="H305C508928F24EC59B642E985662DB21" commented="no"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Persons not considered by promotion board because of administrative error</header> <paragraph id="H961E27B306ED4CC2BA7258D144B98519" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Convening of board</header><text>In the case of an officer or former officer who the Secretary of the Air Force determines was not considered for selection for promotion by a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title because of administrative error, the Secretary shall convene a special selection board under this subsection to determine whether that officer or former officer should be recommended for promotion.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HEA0A4F52084449B6B964F4091EBD0636" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Board composition; oath</header><text>Any such board shall be convened under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense and shall be appointed and composed in accordance with section 20212 of this title and shall include the representation of competitive categories required by that section. The members of a board convened under this subsection shall be required to take an oath in the same manner as prescribed in section 14103 of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HEF8D4B6E59E74C8CAA9130181D9D085B" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Record considered by board</header><text>A special selection board convened under paragraph (1) shall consider the record of the officer or former officer as that record would have appeared to the selection board that should have considered the officer or former officer. That record shall be compared with a sampling of the records of those officers of the same grade and competitive category who were recommended for promotion, and those officers of the same grade and competitive category who were not recommended for promotion, by that board.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0540F3F7CB0C4F8FA37308BCE17EF2EA" commented="no"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Effect</header><text>If a special selection board convened under paragraph (1) does not recommend for promotion an officer or former officer in a grade below the grade of colonel whose name was referred to it for consideration, the officer or former officer shall be considered to have failed of selection for promotion.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HF9DFF6FB9D544AA2A941BD68EE90EDE8" commented="no"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Officers considered but not selected; material error</header> <paragraph id="H4BF8A7F9F38E4902BC01172786408C00" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Convening of board</header><text>In the case of an officer or former officer who was eligible for promotion and was considered for selection for promotion by a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title but was not selected, the Secretary of the Air Force may, under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, convene a special selection board under this subsection to determine whether the officer or former officer should be recommended for promotion, if the Secretary must determine that—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H9E199504C2F14501851C1149C9C3CC61" commented="no"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the action of the selection board that considered the officer or former officer was contrary to law in a matter material to the decision of the board or involved material error of fact or material administrative error; or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H23EB091937B641FDB2684A738A50B77E" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the board did not have before it for its consideration material information.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8FCAE73E081049A5A91F47E850361186" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Board composition; oath</header><text>A special selection board convened under paragraph ((1) shall be appointed and composed in accordance with section 20212 of this title (including the representation of competitive categories required by that section), and the members of sch a board shall take an oath in the same manner as prescribed in section 14103 of this title.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H564F418F09544BA891D02AF561D53F19" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Record considered by board</header><text>The special selection board shall consider the record of the officer or former officer as that record, if corrected, would have appeared to the board that considered the officer or former officer. That record shall be compared with the records of a sampling of those officers of the same grade and competitive category who were recommended for promotion, and those officers of the same grade and competitive category who were not recommended for promotion, by that board.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H00221402C7C0480FBD91A87A61474C34" commented="no"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Effect</header><text>If a special selection board convened under paragraph (1) does not recommend for promotion a officer or former officer whose name was referred to it for consideration, the officer or former officer incurs no additional failure of selection for promotion.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H3F783848454C44EC9B75232496F9C79E" commented="no"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Report of board</header><text>Each special selection board convened under this section shall submit to the Secretary of the Air Force a written report, signed by each member of the board, containing the name of each officer or former officer it recommends for promotion and certifying that the board has carefully considered the record of each officer or former officer whose name was referred to it.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBB2B7A13BA61450FBB8D0673E0471A90" commented="no"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Applicable provisions</header><text>The provisions of sections 20215 and 20216 of this title apply to the report and proceedings of a special selection board convened under this section in the same manner as they apply to the report and proceedings of a selection board convened under section 20211 of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="HFCAB564E19B047D5BD51ABFC8C1ED06D" commented="no"><enum>(e)</enum><header>Appointment of officers recommended for promotion</header> <paragraph id="H2FDD19C88BF94798944D26C0503B18CE" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Promotion</header><text>An officer or former officer whose name is placed on a promotion list as a result of a recommendation for promotion by a special selection board convened under this section shall, as soon as practicable, be appointed to the next higher grade in accordance with the law and policies which would have been applicable had the officer or former officer been recommended for promotion by the board which should have considered or which did consider the officer of former officer.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HAB97A591D4CB45BBA374A9DA882AB598" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Status of promoted officer</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An officer who is promoted to the next higher grade as the result of the recommendation of a special selection board convened under this section shall, upon such promotion, have the same date of rank, the same effective date for the pay and allowances of that grade, and the same position on the Space Force officer list as the officer would have had if the officer had been recommended for promotion to that grade by the selection board which should have considered, or which did consider, the officer.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H96A4ED57D6224046BAE306F165CA936C" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Correction of military record</header><text>If the report of a special selection board convened under this section, as approved by the President, recommends for promotion to the next higher grade an officer not currently eligible for promotion or a former officer whose name was referred to it for consideration, the Secretary of the Air Force may act under section 1552 of this title to correct the military record of the officer or former officer to correct an error or remove an injustice resulting from not being selected for promotion by the board which should have considered, or which did consider, the officer.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H3304EF546395409D91696479600ABDCA" commented="no"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Prescribing of circumstances for consideration by board</header><text>The Secretary of Defense may prescribe by regulation—</text> <paragraph id="HCFD888459DA34655BE170B03273827BD" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text>the circumstances under which consideration by a special selection board is contingent upon application for consideration by an officer or former officer; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE8204C5CC15C4254A9DE11338384E7E5" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>time limits within which of officer or former officer must make such application in order to be considered by a special selection board under this section.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HF7C0D2AD81B4406199A9DEAD6E793B2F" commented="no"><enum>(g)</enum><header>Convening of boards</header><text>A board convened under this section—</text> 
<paragraph id="H631289AF2DDA43F8A0B6DFA3478299C1" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text>shall be convened under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HC36D9723454542AF905334D32E9968C8" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>shall be composed in accordance with section 20212 of this title and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7E79F355179745F99FB4E92E7ED479A3" commented="no"><enum>(3)</enum><text>shall be subject to the provisions of section 613 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H6F61AA510FC14D07A27AD8F346F59229" commented="no"><enum>(h)</enum><header>Limitation of other jurisdiction</header><text>No official or court of the United States shall have power or jurisdiction—</text> 
<paragraph id="HD725F1A970434C1087789C306A7537F4" commented="no"><enum>(1)</enum><text>over any claim based in any way on the failure of an officer or former officer of the armed forces to be selected for promotion by a selection board convened under this chapter until—</text> <subparagraph id="HBEEC08BE4A8244938FC1CF8061266D44" commented="no"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the claim has been referred to a special selection board by the Secretary of the Air Force and acted upon by that board; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0DFDF41F59CD4B4AB92F5E93EB0C509C" commented="no"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the claim has been rejected by the Secretary without consideration by a special selection board; or</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H02C5BCFA0B3744768466D6CA399D49FB" commented="no"><enum>(2)</enum><text>to grant any relief on such a claim unless the officer or former officer has been selected for promotion by a special selection board convened under this section to consider the officer or former officer’s claim.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H6896C570A157474FB7AB55F277380C76" commented="no"><enum>(i)</enum><header>Judicial review</header> 
<paragraph id="H3677550FF0B9412E9B76E11EA20F9A9E" commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text>A court of the United States may review a determination by the Secretary of the Air Force under subsection (a)(1), (b)(1), or (e)(3) not to convene a special selection board. If a court finds the determination to be arbitrary or capricious, not based on substantial evidence, or otherwise contrary to law, it shall remand the case to the Secretary, who shall provide for consideration of the officer or former officer by a special selection board under this section.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF6EBDF4A9088429FB7D3A26695B644BC" commented="no" indent="up1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>If a court finds that the action of a special selection board which considers an officer or former officer was contrary to law or involved material error of fact or material administrative error, it shall remand the case to the Secretary, who shall provide the officer or former officer reconsideration by a new special selection board.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H270C313D11A348ABB16ED9156C38B3A5" commented="no"><enum>(j)</enum><header>Designation of boards</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may designate a promotion board convened under section 20201(a) of this title as a special selection board convened under this section.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H0AEE2285361D477CB12A5D6A0EBE8229" commented="no"><enum>20252a.</enum><header>Special selection review boards: reference</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 628a of this title, relating to the convening of a special selection review board when credible information of an adverse nature was not furnished to a promotion board, applies with respect to persons recommended by a selection board for promotion to a grade at or below the grade of major general in the Space Force.</text></section> 
<section id="H90E6BA909AC548CBBEAAAF10FB05E4BA" commented="no"><enum>20253.</enum><header>Retirement: retirement for years of service</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Sections 633 through 636 of this title shall apply to the retirement of officers on the Space Force officer list in the same manner as to officers of the Regular Air Force.</text></section></subchapter> <subchapter id="HF4D0D9DB352E4AED8645F9B3A3AE3062"><enum>V</enum><header>Continuation on Active Duty and Selective Early Retirement; Other Provisions</header> <section id="H6ACBFF9DEE8C45628C9498522DC48A91"><enum>20261</enum><header>Selection of officers for continuation on the Space Force officer list</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 14701 of this title shall apply in continuation or retention on the Space Force officer in the same manner as to continuation on the reserve active-status list.</text></section>

<subsection id="H0A43F017A18E4996BF30AC6B7342E8CC"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Retired pay</header><text>An officer who is retired under this chapter is entitled to retired pay computed under chapter 71 or 1223 of this title, as applicable.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HD689A730A0144EF5AF9A6AA66D163C72" commented="no"><enum>20264.</enum><header>Other administrative authorities</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The following provisions of this title shall apply to officers on the Space Force officer list in the same manner as to officers subject to those provisions:</text>

<section id="HAD2BC44C3F85485BB1D1647D94208A94"><enum>1717.</enum><header>Enlisted members</header> 
<subsection id="HF64D4BDA008F4E1BBF6222B23B4A433E"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Subtitle F of title 10, United States Code, as amended by section 1716, is further amended by adding at the end the following new chapter:</text> <quoted-block style="USC" id="HA7673C18CF5D41D78D0C670A7DD13F67" display-inline="no-display-inline"> <chapter id="H0BA0DE05FF19499BBAE1E14CFC1C0E2E"><enum>2007</enum><header>Enlisted members</header> <toc container-level="chapter-container" quoted-block="no-quoted-block" lowest-level="section" idref="H0BA0DE05FF19499BBAE1E14CFC1C0E2E" regeneration="yes-regeneration" lowest-bolded-level="division-lowest-bolded"> <toc-entry idref="H3C7DE1F68F164C6CBD6E50433B63C8B5" level="section">Sec.</toc-entry> <toc-entry idref="H23891D33E1DA4FE2A3F3F0C1CA3019D1" level="section">20301. <section id="H0F3D6332635B4BC7B36885E69101B611"><enum>20302.</enum><header>Enlisted members: term of enlistment</header>

<section id="H1F2A95180BFA492EB819110ABBC1DFA3"><enum>20401.</enum><header>Applicability of certain provisions of law related to separation</header> 
<subsection id="H742D098DB90549E48DB8C5032680AAA6"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Officer separation</header><text>Except as specified in this section or otherwise modified in this chapter, the provisions of chapter 59 of this title applicable to officers of a regular component shall apply to officers of the Space Force.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H5479A9E6BC0245488714DA8287B4C9EC"><enum>(b)</enum><text>Except as specified in this section or otherwise modified in this chapter, the provisions of sections 1169, 1170, 1171, 1173, 1174(b) 1176(a) of chapter 59 of this title applicable to enlisted members of a regular component shall apply to enlisted members of the Space Force.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H29A25D35B1AC4208A235120C6B91B2B2"><enum>(c)</enum><text>The provisions of section 1172 of this title pertaining to a person enlisted under section 518 of this title shall apply to an enlisted member of the Space Force.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H83E982FC6CC947F0A42CA45685817F55"><enum>(d)</enum><text>The provisions of section 1174 of this title—</text> 
<paragraph id="H699BE3DEB65643C1A714B6A05A4FC22D"><enum>(1)</enum><text>pertaining to a regular officer shall apply to a Space Force officer serving on sustained duty;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H717AABCA335E41B59A33AEA7BAB6C83C"><enum>(2)</enum><text>pertaining to a regular enlisted member shall apply to an enlisted member of the Space Force serving on sustained duty; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H43796E2A04A6423D8E084228BF79D9BE"><enum>(3)</enum><text>pertaining to other members shall apply to members of the Space Force not serving on sustained duty.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H8F4DA7A9C83E4511813CFCBFCAA9D015"><enum>(e)</enum><text>The provisions of section 1175 of this title pertaining to a voluntary appointment, enlistment, or transfer to a reserve component shall apply to the voluntary release from active duty of a member of the Space Force on sustained duty.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7738FFFB957C4F0A8427F932BEB373D3"><enum>(f)</enum><text>The provisions of section 1176 of this title—</text> <paragraph id="HE25F463013944696A722689D8D1B6BD0"><enum>(1)</enum><text>pertaining to a regular enlisted member shall apply to an enlisted member of the Space Force serving on sustained duty; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6B0D0AD42B684A5CB984AB9B5717E85A"><enum>(2)</enum><text>pertaining to a reserve enlisted member serving in an active status shall apply to an enlisted member of the Space Force serving in a space force active status or on sustained duty.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HA221BF641F8142568C7259EB7CB3166A"><enum>20402.</enum><header>Enlisted members: standards and qualifications for retention</header> <subsection id="H3FD19A8CE14547908B9714AEA901846D"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Standards and qualifications for retention</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall, by regulation, prescribe—</text> 
<paragraph id="HD48619635DCE423ABA24EBB7380B3DE1"><enum>(1)</enum><text>standards and qualifications for the retention of enlisted members of the Space Force; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD60AA50491F541D6A48A737637BE5BFE"><enum>(2)</enum><text>equitable procedures for the periodic determination of the compliance of each such member with those standards and qualifications.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H784ABD2B1694446580BFDB12019EF290"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Effect of failure to comply with standards and qualifications</header><text>If an enlisted member serving in Space Force active status fails to comply with the standards and qualifications prescribed under subsection (a), the member shall—</text> <paragraph id="H555E348BF4AD468BA0088D6112F291E8"><enum>(1)</enum><text>if qualified, be transferred to Space Force inactive status;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H76AC18F7CFE347488B7EFB3D4D6D36B1"><enum>(2)</enum><text>if qualified, be retired in accordance with section 20603 of this title; or</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HAEFFDE44129546B38D0E8FA8219632DA"><enum>(3)</enum><text>have the member’s enlistment terminated.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HDE377A53F2514D99BD3B55B4A68306FC"><enum>20403.</enum><header>Officers: standards and qualifications for retention</header> 
<subsection id="HDCFDC019E7AC4121A31137B02B626667"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Standards and qualifications</header><text>To be retained in an active status, a Space Force officer must—</text> <paragraph id="H46F4A6E4B32C43269B9B95C7C1E68BDA"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in any applicable yearly period, attain the number of points under section 12732(a)(2) of this title that are prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0DDFBF66CEDF4068B32899EAF73E0AD0"><enum>(2)</enum><text>conform to such other standards and qualifications as the Secretary may prescribe for officers of the Space Force.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HE5ED6310D473421CAE709E03547A53AB"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Limitation on minimum number of points</header><text>The Secretary may not prescribe a minimum of more than 50 points under subsection (a).</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H52A8DEECDB0B417685009ED4D5515A69"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Result of failure to comply</header><text>A Space Force officer who fails to attain the number of points prescribed under subsection (a)(1), or to conform to the standards and qualifications prescribed under subsection (a)(2), may be referred to a board convened under section 20501(a) of this title.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HB184CB738B514785A97B9ED1C10604B4"><enum>20404.</enum><header>Selection of officers for early retirement or discharge</header> <subsection id="H063BB1D3234F4305ADEB80935CA15A64"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Consideration for early retirement</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may convene selection boards under section 20211(b) of this title to consider for early retirement officers on the space force officer list as follows:</text> 
<paragraph id="H8DD83CB2842641B09E2F2D8BEC5C10A7"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Officers in the grade of lieutenant colonel who have failed of selection for promotion at least one time and whose names are not on a list of officers recommended for promotion.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBC78780A2C1F4968BDDADDCDB61DD717"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Officers in the grade of colonel who have served in that grade for at least two years and whose names are not on a list of officers recommended for promotion.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9A0593E7DAA6472AA66BB6E3E395B75B"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Officers, other than those described in paragraphs (1) and (2), holding a grade below the grade of colonel—</text> <subparagraph id="H36D9619B56C041FDAFBB11CBF1DEAD6F"><enum>(A)</enum><text>who are eligible for retirement under section 20601 of this title or who after two additional years or less of active service would be eligible for retirement under that section; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H8BEEF2DB9C3B4A84BDAB592090C14639"><enum>(B)</enum><text>whose names are not on a list of officers recommended for promotion.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HCDC817574D0544DE8FD1E5D28D690E71"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Consideration for discharge</header> <paragraph id="H081FD33974BC4BE997129F4489FF47DC"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may convene selection boards under section 20211 of this title to consider for discharge officers on the space force officer list—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HC124A1AE81B14301868DC2E0872FC6C4"><enum>(A)</enum><text>who have served at least one year of active status in the grade currently held;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H49E5E98CDB3F431F88A522F54327F313"><enum>(B)</enum><text>whose names are not on a list of officers recommended for promotion; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H621B7755284F4167AE9CC5E4B3E61AA1"><enum>(C)</enum><text>who are not eligible to be retired under any provision of law (other than by reason of eligibility pursuant to section 4403 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 1993) and are not within two years of becoming so eligible.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5A045823EF414D9689A34CA7E37713EB"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An officer who is recommended for discharge by a selection board convened pursuant to the authority of paragraph (1) and whose discharge is approved by the Secretary of the Air Force shall be discharged on a date specified by the Secretary.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF4590F14E83B4328805B4752A2927456"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Selection of officers for discharge under paragraph (1) shall be based on the needs of the service.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HF86E2869834F45A4A114B23681C8F4A7"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Discharges and retirements considered to be involuntary</header><text>The discharge or retirement of an officer pursuant to this section shall be considered to be involuntary for purposes of any other provision of law.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="HAA0AC3083DC14D1B81E551F478C21DAC"><enum>20405.</enum><header>Force shaping authority</header> 
<subsection id="H32D2BC89AEA6463AACB0A31BA4D67E6F"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Authority</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may, solely for the purpose of restructuring the Space Force—</text> <paragraph id="HCBD9970725A4411FACFA64F4AE2CA4DE"><enum>(1)</enum><text>discharge an officer described in subsection (b); or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H32E8EFB78AD74EE4949FB1A5E38E206F"><enum>(2)</enum><text>involuntarily release such an officer from sustained duty.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H11E305D034874B378FF650DF87261AC4"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Covered officers</header> <paragraph id="H319EC9266BD941A993D0ABBD9429E32C"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The authority under this section may be exercised in the case of an officer of the Space Force serving on sustained duty who—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HA83964C1DDC94084A17D4A45B2A8147E"><enum>(A)</enum><text>has completed not more than six years of service as a commissioned officer in the armed forces; or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H0B9969EDAA044E6BB16BFE2EBFC23285"><enum>(B)</enum><text>has completed more than six years of service as a commissioned officer in the armed forces, but has not completed the minimum service obligation applicable to that officer.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HFBF3B269D3044CA3AF25518A153933C3"><enum>(2)</enum><text>In this subsection, the term <quote>minimum service obligation</quote>, with respect to a member of the Space Force, means the initial period of required active duty service applicable to the member, together with any additional period of required active duty service incurred by that member during the member’s initial period of required active duty service.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HEDC809E0B2364BDD89894E041CA81C92"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Regulations</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall prescribe regulations for the exercise of the Secretary’s authority under this section.</text></subsection></section></chapter><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection> 
<subsection id="H1009EB19DFB4430DBD4EA14342E9216D"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Conforming amendments</header><text>Section 647 of title 10, United States Code, is amended—</text> <paragraph id="HFE4262F47B5649FD85922249D44CF56F"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in subsection (b), by inserting <quote>(other than an officer of the Space Force)</quote> after <quote>in the case of an officer</quote>;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8A760D27C8824127BB9761A85EB22297"><enum>(2)</enum><text>in subsection (c), by striking <quote>Regular Marine Corps, of Regular Space Force</quote> and inserting <quote>or Regular Marine Corps</quote>; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7540C021C49B41F9B584DFABD1B47BA4"><enum>(3)</enum><text>by adding at the end the following new subsection:</text>

<chapter id="HAD20081DAF7748F0A2A3506164A7EE34"><enum>2011</enum><header>SEPARATION OF OFFICERS FOR SUBSTANDARD PERFORMANCE OF DUTY OR FOR CERTAIN OTHER REASONS</header> 
<toc container-level="chapter-container" quoted-block="no-quoted-block" lowest-level="section" idref="HAD20081DAF7748F0A2A3506164A7EE34" regeneration="yes-regeneration" lowest-bolded-level="division-lowest-bolded">

<section id="H65CC0FC96D46477CB0AB92A7BAA186DC"><enum>20501.</enum><header>Authority to establish procedures to consider the separation of officers for substandard performance of duty and for certain other reasons</header> 
<subsection id="H2C21F8ADDE3242FFA2F7F0070CAE6AC1"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Procedures for review of record of officers relating to standards of performance of duty</header> 
<paragraph id="HC9B900EE7C0B4548B1D4F167611D8C4B"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall prescribe, by regulation, procedures for the review at any time of the record of any commissioned officer (other than a retired officer) of the Space Force in a space force active status to determine whether the officer shall be required, because of a reason stated in paragraph (2), to show cause for the officer’s retention in a space force active status.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H364485BCAE8F4B98BCE1A69F82955CEA"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The reasons referred to in paragraph (1) are the following:</text> 
<subparagraph id="HD09E605F07D54124882DF9DE727793A4"><enum>(A)</enum><text>The officer’s performance of duty has fallen below standards prescribed by the Secretary of Defense.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H97C672B683F7488F9D49F8DF7C6113E2"><enum>(B)</enum><text>The officer has failed to satisfy the standards and qualifications established under section 20403 of this title by the Secretary of the Air Force.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H9EC34051863A4BE8AC0A0692B8E23E83"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Procedures for review of record of officers relating to certain other reasons</header> 
<paragraph id="H13A5E54B4AC34211B5909D50DA7A8AF4"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall prescribe, by regulation, procedures for the review at any time of the record of any commissioned officer (other than a retired officer) of the Space Force in a space force active status to determine whether the officer should be required, because of a reason stated in paragraph (2), to show cause for the officer’s retention in a space force active status.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD5B1E62821AF4F5285A30E2B6E88F482"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The reasons referred to in paragraph (1) are the following:</text> 
<subparagraph id="H37DDD3E05A4B492CA01A6AD62D8FFEBD"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Misconduct.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H94502C11FC9A4F329A8BCBEAADF56742"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Moral or professional dereliction.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H1A1BB1C407C84F9F9D7DE347944E72F8"><enum>(C)</enum><text>The officer’s retention is not clearly consistent with the interests of national security.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H0AE2157145B743C5B79FFB50F2AED820"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Secretary of defense limitations</header><text>Regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force under this section are subject to such limitations as the Secretary of Defense may prescribe.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="HC83F1D496B004B2BA9781C2A1731F01F"><enum>20502.</enum><header>Retention boards</header> 
<subsection id="HE706927990764AEFA539CAF2BE8DDE65"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Convening of boards to consider officers required to show cause</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall convene retention boards at such times and places as the Secretary may prescribe to receive evidence and make findings and recommendations as to whether an officer who is required under section 20501 of this title to show cause for retention in a space force active status should be retained in a space force active status. Each retention board shall be composed of not less than three officers having the qualifications prescribed by section 20506 of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H2F609D22BFB042369191E5A1A26D9966"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Fair and impartial hearing</header><text>A retention board shall give a fair and impartial hearing to each officer required under section 20501 of this title to show cause for retention in a space force active status.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H1B2E333CFC8940DBA662C843103BF2BC"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Effect of board determination than an officer has failed to establish that the officer should be retained</header> 
<paragraph id="H9E5E87EEC827430EA766C8FCF8B16E08"><enum>(1)</enum><text>If a retention board determines that the officer has failed to establish that the officer should be retained in a space force active status, the board shall recommend to the Secretary of the Air Force one of the following:</text> <subparagraph id="H5D6EA08EA8F24240A7EA9E5929AEAA63"><enum>(A)</enum><text>That the officer be transferred to an inactive status.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HAA27A17621AF48AB9E4D44DA4FC3ABFF"><enum>(B)</enum><text>That the officer, if qualified under any provision of law, be retired.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H05F1F499D659420DB6C2020CF170F1C4"><enum>(C)</enum><text>That the officer be discharged from the Space Force.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H92EEF12F997D4213A7AF544503119EC5"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, an officer as to whom a retention board makes a recommendation under paragraph (1) that the officer not be retained in a space force active status may be required to take leave pending the completion of the officer’s case under this chapter. The officer may be required to begin such leave at any time following the officer’s receipt of the report of the retention board, including the board’s recommendation for removal from a space force active status, and the expiration of any period allowed for submission by the officer of a rebuttal to that report. The leave may be continued until the date on which action by the Secretary of the Air Force on the officer’s case is completed or may be terminated at any earlier time.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H8CECDC688E62409F839A4F45FDC5BFEC"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Effect of board determination than an officer has established that the officer should be retained</header> <paragraph id="HD58E8375B8F848AB946897BDAFBDD0CF"><enum>(1)</enum><text>If a retention board determines that the officer has established that the officer should be retained in a space force active status, the officer’s case is closed.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H76B6A7C52CA34787868300C5D0E2ED61"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An officer who is required to show cause for retention in a space force active status under subsection (a) of section 20501 of this title and who is determined under paragraph (1) to have established that the officer should be retained in a space force active status may not again be required to show cause for retention in a space force active status under such subsection within the one-year period beginning on the date of that determination.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H54CA822FCB024A699A4728A9E2FC9E75"><enum>(3)</enum> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="HB7E570514DD144CCAA83AF92DBA19072"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Subject to subparagraph (B), an officer who is required to show cause for retention in a space force active status under subsection (b) of section 20501 of this title and who is determined under paragraph (1) to have established that the officer should be retained in a space force active status may again be required to show cause for retention at any time.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0CD234B0012347BAAD0767D32F8789FE" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text>An officer who has been required to show cause for retention in a space force active status under subsection (b) of section 20501 of this title and who is thereafter retained in an active status may not again be required to show cause for retention in a space force active status under such subsection solely because of conduct which was the subject of the previous proceedings, unless the findings or recommendations of the retention board that considered the officer’s previous case are determined to have been obtained by fraud or collusion.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF37CBF3C286E40CC9FB7D7C42734A79D"><enum>(4)</enum><text>In the case of an officer described in paragraph (2) or paragraph (3)(A), the retention board may recommend that the officer be required to complete additional training, professional education, or such other developmental programs as may be available to correct any identified deficiencies and improve the officer’s performance within the Space Force.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H2CBDFCBD4DAA45338D6DC1AD62BBE856"><enum>20503.</enum><header>Removal of officer: action by Secretary upon recommendation of retention board</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The Secretary of the Air Force may remove an officer from space force active status if the removal of such officer from space force active status is recommended by a retention board convened under section 20502 of this title.</text></section> <section id="H76B2DF6FF596471A9249EB5A697C6A5B"><enum>20504.</enum><header>Rights and procedures</header> <subsection id="H0D1BBA7B60DB465D85B2C5817DADF21D"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, each officer required under section 20501 of this title to show cause for retention in a space force active status—</text> 
<paragraph id="H4AA0A0B555074AAD9CA3803D44D780D5"><enum>(1)</enum><text>shall be notified in writing, at least 30 days before the hearing of the officer’s case by a retention board, of the reasons for which the officer is being required to show cause for retention in a space force active status;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H26AE869DB2634C298682F4055B7CFCAE"><enum>(2)</enum><text>shall be allowed a reasonable time, as determined by the board, to prepare the officer’s showing of cause for retention in a space force active status;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H806C491DF0224E4BB8476489E96E9445"><enum>(3)</enum><text>shall be allowed to appear either in person or through electronic means and to be represented by counsel at proceedings before the board; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HEF6F87BA398540E4B2438AF288D41684"><enum>(4)</enum><text>shall be allowed full access to, and shall be furnished copies of, records relevant to the officer’s case, except that the board shall withhold any record that the Secretary determines should be withheld in the interest of national security.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HB23C227ECFE0487FBF52F8E66845D7D0"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Summary of records withheld in interest of national security</header><text>When a record is withheld under subsection (a)(4), the officer whose case is under consideration shall, to the extent that the interest of national security permits, be furnished a summary of the record so withheld.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H7CBB35BA38324032A4A0A94B3C8FEB2E"><enum>20505.</enum><header>Officer considered for removal: voluntary retirement or discharge</header> <subsection id="H724856437C87443695D5BF24AFCCCBAE"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>At any time during proceedings under this chapter with respect to the removal of an officer from a space force active status , the Secretary of the Air Force may grant a request by the officer—</text> 
<paragraph id="H4DB981C2A4584DC0864B359528F98BD9"><enum>(1)</enum><text>for voluntary retirement, if the officer is qualified for retirement; or</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD0DBA174EA4E41F585565A785AFC4247"><enum>(2)</enum><text>for discharge in accordance with subsection (b)(2).</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H15820D5026774094BFD063AFFC0F58AA"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Retirement or discharge</header><text>An officer removed from a space force active status under section 20503 of this title shall—</text> <paragraph id="H4E3C3B057B684EC2B3292C5E43F278E7"><enum>(1)</enum><text>if eligible for voluntary retirement under any provision of law on the date of such removal, be retired in the grade and with the retired pay for which the officer would be eligible if retired under such provision; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H102F8110F4414A0E989214658EF68BB3"><enum>(2)</enum><text>if ineligible for voluntary retirement under any provision of law on the date of such removal—</text> <subparagraph id="HD99351B9CACE41E49306F95D2A1F0B38"><enum>(A)</enum><text>be honorably discharged in the grade then held, in the case of an officer whose case was brought under subsection (a) of section 20501 of this title; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H48CD0625079643A6A6E4D8AB8DD34922"><enum>(B)</enum><text>be discharged in the grade then held, in the case of an officer whose case was brought under subsection (b) of section 20501 of this title.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H559575E3B84048ADAC69733CD14B0D75"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Separation pay for discharged officer</header><text>An officer who is discharged under subsection (b)(2) is entitled, if eligible therefor, to separation pay under section 1174(a)(2) of this title.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H4A0FBF566F14491B9E3E3F38E24A2C7F"><enum>20506.</enum><header>Officers eligible to serve on retention boards</header> 
<subsection id="HCFE672C01C5A4AE99AECDD5F3DA0E945"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The provisions of section 1187 of this title apply to the membership of boards convened under this chapter in the same manner as to the membership of boards convened under chapter 60 of this title.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H972352B73DE24232B8B5528E7C4E7E19"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Retired air force officers</header> <paragraph id="HD75387AC7AA346809E9D6710CF694BAD"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Authority</header><text>In applying subsection (b) of section 1187 of this title to a board convened under this chapter, the Secretary of the Air Force may appoint retired officers of the Air Force, in addition to retired officers of the Space Force, to complete the membership of the board.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H6FB4A168D7194CEA992D64B70B4F43A1"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Limitation</header><text>A retired officer of the Air Force may be appointed to a board under paragraph (1) only if the officer served in a space-related career field of the Air Force for sufficient time such that the Secretary of the Air Force determines that the retired Air Force officer has adequate knowledge concerning the standards of performance and conduct required of an officer of the Space Force.</text></paragraph></subsection></section></chapter><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></section> <section id="HF4778ED600B046BF855C22E45B5785D5"><enum>1719A.</enum><header>Retirement</header> <subsection id="H3A4C0220EBB64436AA6C26A49BB37755"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Subtitle F of title 10, United States Code, as amended by section 1719, is further amended by adding at the end the following new chapter:</text>

<section id="HAEB115A604F74582BAB1C8A5AAE0DDC7"><enum>20601.</enum><header>Officers: voluntary retirement for length of service</header> 
<subsection id="H669C545EB69F43D983F65692664DE85E"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Twenty years or more</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force may, upon the officer’s request, retire a commissioned officer of the Space Force who has at least 20 years of service computed under section 20602 of this title, at least 10 years of which have been active service as a commissioned officer.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H16254C306B3447E5B98DEB14DF06B3E2"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Thirty years or more</header><text>A commissioned officer of the Space Force who has at least 30 years of service computed under section 20602 of this title may be retired upon the officer’s request, in the discretion of the President.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HEDE09DCF4D6B4830AA86C8BCE68D829B"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Forty years or more</header><text>Except as provided in section 20503 of this title, a commissioned officer of the Space Force who has at least 40 years of service computed under section 20602 of this title shall be retired upon the officer’s request.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HBE52A6CD6AE4448EA3B971DEE25498E4"><enum>20602.</enum><header>Officers: computation of years of service for voluntary retirement</header> <subsection id="HA87C20735C394B9FB61F449CC3E7C7D9"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Years of active service</header><text>For the purpose of determining whether an officer of the Space Force may be retired under section 20601 of this title, the officer’s years of service are computed by adding all active service in the armed forces.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HD673AC5472484B22907C0138F2C357C8"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Reference to section excluding service during certain periods</header><text>Section 972(b) of this title excludes from computation of an officer’s years of service for purposes of this section any time identified with respect to that officer under that section.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H9B8897A1A4464A74B312C7A774CC1F02"><enum>20603.</enum><header>Enlisted members: voluntary retirement for length of service</header> <subsection id="HDC843DFB8C964F1184C39A37950898A4"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Twenty to thirty years</header><text>Under regulations to be prescribed by the Secretary of the Air Force, an enlisted member of the Space Force who has at least 20, but less than 30, years of service computed under section 20604 of this title may, upon the member’s request, be retired.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H60598D9555794526850D097927158081"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Thirty years or more</header><text>An enlisted member of the Space Force who has at least 30 years of service computed under section 20604 of this title shall be retired upon the member’s request.</text></subsection></section> <section id="HCD7EC84C6DFC41C5B9D0EA4AA03CCCD5"><enum>20604.</enum><header>Enlisted members: computation of years of service for voluntary retirement</header> <subsection id="H9374DD24343E42E8A0D4A15D12026FCF"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Years of active service</header><text>For the purpose of determining whether an enlisted member of the Space Force may be retired under section 20603 of this title, the member’s years of service are computed by adding all active service in the armed forces.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H7B8F1106CF494C4E91F777CBA55B70CF"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Reference to section excluding counting of certain service required to be made up</header><text>Time required to be made up under section 972(a) of this title may not be counted in computing years of service under subsection (a).</text></subsection></section> <section id="H491A9F388792419793DFAE385835982A"><enum>20605.</enum><header>Applicability of other provisions of law relating to retirement</header> <subsection id="H501B20B0526A4069A1B5C3E33D5680FC"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Applicability to members of the Space Force</header><text>Except as specifically provided for by this chapter, the provisions of this title specified in subsection (b) apply to members of the Space Force as follows:</text> 
<paragraph id="H779FB571ECE14139BC813274527631F6"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to an officer of the Air Force shall apply to an officer of the Space Force.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HEA108073806F41DD9CF2BA0CFAC87571"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to an enlisted member of the Air Force shall apply to an enlisted member of the Space Force.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF5AA8B8BD8EA41D5BD56BC9D5FA49F82"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to a regular officer shall apply to an officer who is on sustained duty in the Space Force.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4E70C5AD3CA5459AA63E6D7FD09A82D2"><enum>(4)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to a regular enlisted member shall apply to an enlisted member who is on sustained duty in the Space Force.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H588C31CB558D4E06B56ECED739A1D197"><enum>(5)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to a reserve officer shall apply to an officer who is in a space force active status but not on sustained duty.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H459EC9A424A54F99941D08B68351D5AD"><enum>(6)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to a reserve enlisted member shall apply to an enlisted member who is in a space force active status but not on sustained duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H92E6E0C2F66647B8BED5616F01DC0B71"><enum>(7)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to service in a regular component shall apply to service on sustained duty.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H2DF8ED163F4C40AEA792336B84CC5036"><enum>(8)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to service in a reserve component shall apply to service in a space force active status not on sustained duty.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H23A3888F4CED4AEBBF8B19D89B01CB3B"><enum>(9)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to a member of the Ready Reserve shall apply to a member of the Space Force who is in a space force active status prior to being ordered to active duty.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7E620ED37E0E435D900EBFDA01EC11E3"><enum>(10)</enum><text>Provisions pertaining to a member of the Retired Reserve shall apply to a member of the Space Force who has retired under chapter 1223 of this title.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H8F9B5295D8124A7799B6D5C342880AB0"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Provisions of law</header><text>The provisions of this title referred to in subsection (a) are the following:</text> <paragraph id="HE950355525B947D9AC391C8F96FAEC71"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Chapter 61, relating to retirement or separation for physical disability.</text></paragraph>

<paragraph id="H1EDFB3785C1543EA818809077B576CE1"><enum>(8)</enum><text>Chapter 1225, relating to retired grade.</text></paragraph></subsection></section></chapter><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection> <subsection id="H7ECCD321F62F4D20AAA8532DCCE5BB1A"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Conforming amendments</header><text>Title 10, United States Code, is amended as follows:</text>

<section id="H0933D63A1D984DDCA8AB198A82D7A628"><enum>1731.</enum><header>Transition period</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">In this subtitle, the term <quote>transition period</quote> means the period beginning on the date of the enactment of this Act and ending on the last day of the fourth fiscal year beginning after the date of the enactment of this Act.</text></section> <section id="H4861F97CF9FB48288CA753EFB6DF9849"><enum>1732.</enum><header>Change of duty status of members of the Space Force</header> <subsection id="HC2B58F3DB39C497590C01E691B505D0F"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Change of duty status</header> <paragraph id="HE5F17921CD6A4CDAB3847CB9D1857BF6"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Conversion of status and order to sustained duty</header><text>During the transition period, the Secretary of the Air Force shall change the duty status of each member of the Regular Space Force to space force active status and shall, at the same time, order the member to sustained duty under section 20105 of title 10, United States Code, as added by section 1715. Any such order may be made without regard to any otherwise applicable requirement that such an order be made only with the consent of the member or as specified in an enlistment agreement or active-duty service commitment.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H16AEED154DFE48F1AF2539994CFB9A13"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>For purposes of this section, the terms <quote>space force active status</quote> and <quote>sustained duty</quote> have the meanings given those terms by subsection (e) of section 101 of title 10, United States Code, as added by section 1713(a).</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HBA3F1235AA9E4204B13A6F374B02B788"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Effective date of change of duty status</header><text>The change of a member’s duty status and order to sustained duty in accordance with subsection (a) shall be effective on the date specified by the Secretary of the Air Force, but not later than the last day of the transition period.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H8A9290C6C5C24A1A9A3335490E094E6E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1733.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Transfer to the Space Force of members of the reserve components of the Air Force</header> 
<subsection id="H22F5B0B0A97C4EA7ACEA57F8B4A3FD42" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Transfer of members</header> 
<paragraph id="H0B2DE7C2384D4FA6B7BD2E474DB5D5B7" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">During the transition period, the Secretary of Defense may, with the officer’s consent, transfer a covered officer of a reserve component of the Air Force to, and appoint the officer in, the Space Force.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6E6292409A8D4AF7950EADF15A9DE88B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Enlisted members</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">During the transition period, the Secretary of the Air Force may transfer each covered enlisted member of a reserve component of the Air Force to the Space Force, other than those members who do not consent to the transfer.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8BBAF9F2E33C4947A2FAF227D7E23003" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Effective date of transfers</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each transfer under this subsection shall be effective on the date specified by the Secretary of Defense, in the case of an officer, or the Secretary of the Air Force, in the case of an enlisted member, but not later than the last day of the transition period.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H55B999D69D47423BAC7A549104D99D7E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Regulations</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Transfers under subsection (a) shall be carried out under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense. In the case of an officer, applicable regulations shall include those prescribed pursuant to section 716 of title 10, United States Code.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H3EB86146805740B0B8838420985765F9" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Term of initial enlistment in Space Force</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In the case of a covered enlisted member who is transferred to the Space Force in accordance with subsection (a), the Secretary of the Air Force may accept the initial enlistment of the member in the Space Force for a period of less than 2 years, but only if the period of enlistment in the Space Force is not less than the period remaining, as of the date of the transfer, in the member’s term of enlistment in a reserve component of the Air Force.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H4E58A594DCCB4957BCCEA23AC519093B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">End strength adjustments upon transfers from reserve components of the Air Force</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">During the transition period, upon the transfer of a mission of the Air Force Reserve to the Space Force—</text> 
<paragraph id="HA42DA5AC467847CBA1C6B9FDBBEBE233" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the end strength authorized for the Space Force pursuant to section 115(a)(1)(A) of title 10, United States Code, for the fiscal year during which the transfer occurs shall be increased by the number of billets associated with that mission; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB10F46B42F8448B0819A8DCD7FB07E7D" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the end strength authorized for the reserve components of the Air Force pursuant to section 115(a)(2) of such title for such fiscal year shall be decreased by the same number.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HDD9C80E0F0DC424EBDC3737B12DA48AA" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Administrative provisions</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">For purposes of the transfer of covered members of the Air Force Reserve in accordance with subsection (a)—</text> <paragraph id="H0DE5B2DF3FE24663A970101C132A837F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Air Force Reserve, the Air National Guard, and the Space Force shall be considered to be components of the same Armed Force; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H34FF0325CAB0441A9509C323F16C9734" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Space Force officer list shall be considered to be an active-duty list of an Armed Force.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H05898096D1E54E3A8FD6A72DB7AD5D65" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(f)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Retraining and reassignment for members not transferring</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">If a covered member of a reserve component of the Air Force does not consent to transfer to the Space Force in accordance with subsection (a), the Secretary of the Air Force may, as determined appropriate by the Secretary in the case of the individual member, provide the member retraining and reassignment within a reserve component of the Air Force.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBA05DCAFDD9F47FC9D7DA81941BB5B4C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(g)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Covered defined</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">For purposes of this section, the term <term>covered</term>, with respect to a member of a reserve component of the Air Force, means—</text> <paragraph id="HE9A45BCCD4F34BC68C870E1D587BC85E" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a member who, as of the date of the enactment of this Act, holds an Air Force specialty code for a specialty held by members of the Space Force; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H15BC2B13C064480C88E8DC9AEAD5261F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any other member designated by the Secretary of the Air Force for the purposes of this section.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="H05C8EC4C34A048A6A3332756950CA7D2" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>1734.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Placement of officers on the Space Force officer list</header> <subsection id="H4A97CC18EC5E4E8C88CD1AD2DAEB81A1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Placement on list</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers of the Space Force whose duty status is changed in accordance with section 1732, and officers of the reserve components of the Air Force who transfer to the Space Force in accordance with 1733, shall be placed on the Space Force officer list in an order determined by their respective grades and dates of rank.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="HBAFB3A5F35204E3CBDCC55B9BE3307E8" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers of same grade and date of rank</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Among officers of the same grade and date of rank, placement on the Space Force officer list shall be in the order of their rank as determined in accordance with section 741(c) of title 10, United States Code.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H235E3843646045FE98087B745DF310C1"><enum>1735.</enum><header>Disestablishment of Regular Space Force</header> <subsection id="H6DDEBFE9C2D54269B133C2F2B73EB670"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Disestablishment</header><text>The Secretary of the Air Force shall disestablish the Regular Space Force not later than the end of the transition period, once there are no longer any members remaining in the Regular Space Force. The Regular Space Force shall be disestablished upon the completion of the change of duty status of all members of the Space Force pursuant to section 1742 and certification by the Secretary of the Air Force to the congressional defense committees that there are no longer any members of the Regular Space Force.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H5B917F080C1241B3BF1A05565AF8A495"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Publication of notice in federal register</header><text>The Secretary shall publish in the Federal Register notice of the disestablishment of the Regular Space Force, including the date thereof, together with any certification submitted pursuant to subsection (a).</text></subsection> <subsection id="H87AF77E0ED054EE9A57123FBC666A9A6"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Conforming repeal</header> <paragraph id="HAC51B8C1C74D4585B1D0E6EF0F2075E1"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Repeal</header><text>Section 9085 of title 10, United States Code, relating to the composition of the Regular Space Force, is repealed.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HCD6A5BA8C62D41798CDC38BC3F07E313"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Effective date</header><text>The amendment made by this subsection shall take effect on the date on which the certification is submitted under subsection (a).</text></paragraph></subsection></section> <section id="HCF63714AF1B542198B91DE7087D2D2F9"><enum>1736.</enum><header>End strength flexibility</header> <subsection id="H47FE6889B743489698A2E956D6B6E07D"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Additional authority to vary end strengths</header> <paragraph id="HA8ECDCCF0CBA4F93AE26AD0AA9E9D371"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Authority</header><text>Notwithstanding section 115(g) of title 10, United States Code, upon determination by the Secretary of the Air Force that such action would enhance manning and readiness in essential units or in critical specialties, the Secretary may vary the end strength authorized by Congress for a fiscal year as follows:</text> 
<subparagraph id="HB6A9ECCFCEEF4113A5224856810E4049"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Increase the end strength authorized pursuant to section 115(a)(1)(A) of such title for a fiscal year for the Space Force by a number equal to not more than 5 percent of such authorized end strength.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H8990F17A9CCB4D8DBD6B04283EC850F4"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Decrease the end strength authorized pursuant to section 115(a)(1)(A) of such title for a fiscal year for the Space Force by a number equal to not more than 10 percent of such authorized end strength.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H7EE9A18B2AA94E39B78C745FC29BDF22"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Termination</header><text>The authority provided under paragraph (1) shall terminate on the last day of the transition period.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HF2114D211E524FE2AC34DD02F7941914"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Temporary exemption for the Space Force from end strength grade restrictions</header><text>Sections 517 and 523 of title 10, United States Code, shall not apply to the Space Force during the transition period.</text></subsection></section> 
<section id="H155D81BAACF84EC7AB34EC7E381E77B6"><enum>1737.</enum><header>Promotion authority flexibility</header> 
<subsection id="H7A011E06314A4A638C01BB3B1E84C448"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Promotion authority flexibility</header><text>During the transition period, the Secretary of the Air Force may convene selection boards to consider officers on the space force officer list for promotion, and may promote Space Force officers selected by such boards, in accordance with any of the following provisions of title 10, United States Code:</text> <paragraph id="HE3CD7B567B3F47FB8846F3012AB8E27B"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Chapter 36.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HA3071F09C65745ACBE6D9DB5ABBDCD18"><enum>(2)</enum><text>Part III of subtitle E.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H6A19AC519D0842CABA4064E14E4628F2"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Chapter 2005, as added by section 1716.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HFED6F8842E9F4F1EB479C186C4EFA797"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Coordination of provisions</header> 
<paragraph id="HD8AB071A73314D278C86B36E313ABC9E"><enum>(1)</enum><text>For a selection board convened pursuant to subsection (a) to consider members of the Space Force for promotion in accordance with chapter 36 of such title—</text> <subparagraph id="HAE8B80211B9249E78C644107C8C8C5D5"><enum>(A)</enum><text>provisions that apply to an officer of a regular component of the Armed Forces shall apply to an officer of the Space Force; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H271795B9E28B47A5A3D04B5CB28D768D"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the space force officer list shall be considered to be an active-duty list.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HDE6C118419F24E82A1C0A8B80DC9E01E"><enum>(2)</enum><text>For a selection board convened pursuant to pursuant to subsection (a) to consider members of the Space Force for promotion in accordance with part III of subtitle E of such title—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H46AD798E962A4E81BC9B1E1D4631F13B"><enum>(A)</enum><text>provisions that apply to an officer of a reserve component of the Armed Forces shall apply to an officer of the Space Force; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H42FAC0CE6D634E809B33A91419BB6780"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the space force officer list shall be considered to be a reserve active-status list.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HEB1C780900E548B89DBF948CFBBF41DA"><enum>(3)</enum><text>For a selection board convened pursuant to subsection (a) to consider members of the Space Force for promotion in accordance with either chapter 36 or part III of subtitle E of such title—</text> <subparagraph id="H85B860EBC50040B7BC0F8993D23FE976"><enum>(A)</enum><text>section 20213 of such title shall apply to the composition of the selection board;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HDEA92D66E16B4F09BB94344731A8BE12"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the provisions of chapter 2005 of such title regarding officers on the space force officer list eligible to be considered for promotion to the grade of brigadier general or major general shall apply;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H6E2CB4C5C42549EABFCB31421C30963D"><enum>(C)</enum><text>section 20216 of such title shall apply; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HC8520619FFB04D0A8124B17950F67CFD"><enum>(D)</enum><text>the provisions of chapter 36 or part III of subtitle E of such title, as the case may be, regarding failure of selection for promotion shall apply.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H929DE235142C4F66839996C4029759BB"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Effect of using new chapter 2005 authorities</header><text>If the Secretary of the Air Force convenes a selection board under <external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/10/2005">chapter 2005</external-xref> of title 10, United States Code, as added by section 1716, to consider officers on the space force officer list in a particular grade and competitive category for selection for promotion to the next higher grade, the Secretary may not convene a future selection board pursuant to subsection (a) to consider officers of the same grade and competitive category under chapter 36 or part III of subtitle E of such title.</text></subsection></section></subtitle>

<section id="HA056ADA0D7DE4CF584B948DEE9103EA2"><enum>1809.</enum><header>National Cold War Center designation</header> 
<subsection id="HE05A1CDE9E5646BEAB00D2847E491DA2"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Purposes</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The purposes of this section are—</text> <paragraph id="H969018E8AAB54835983B22628C5C3E16"><enum>(1)</enum><text>to designate the museum located at Blytheville/Eaker Air Force Base in Blytheville, Arkansas, including its future and expanded exhibits, collections, and educational programs, as a <quote>National Cold War Center</quote>;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HBDEE4CE73E154EB981C708183FFD1F03"><enum>(2)</enum><text>to recognize the preservation, maintenance, and interpretation of the artifacts, documents, images, and history collected by the Center;</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HD6AB40542CC843ADB63601726470DAA0"><enum>(3)</enum><text>to enhance the knowledge of the American people of the experience of the United States during the Cold War years; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HB119E60F6BEA40D4885B3326D4C88CC8"><enum>(4)</enum><text>to ensure that all future generations understand the sacrifices made to preserve freedom and democracy, and the benefits of peace for all future generations in the 21st century and beyond.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H4BFA887B95D34F52A5845F09D33AF8F2"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Designation</header> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HEA9E0E099951454AB6ECE6183853B92A"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text>The museum located at Blytheville/Eaker Air Force Base in Blytheville, Arkansas, is designated as a <quote>National Cold War Center</quote>.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H1EF9E3C1614D47D6B9784B0967AC8B8F"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Rule of construction</header><text>Nothing in this section shall preclude the designation of other national centers or museums in the United States interpreting the Cold War.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H1858BEACB8EB4646AA6951A342DBEC4F"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Effect of designation</header><text>The National Cold War Center designated by this section is not a unit of the National Park System, and the designation of the center as a National Cold War Center shall not be construed to require or permit Federal funds to be expended for any purpose related to the designation made by this section.</text></subsection></section>
