<section id="HE843BDFE7B374C68807132BEC0A572D9" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>5101.</enum><header>Prohibition of demand for bribe</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 201 of title 18, United States Code, is amended—</text> <paragraph id="H3912B9B3870C49B8A8BA977CA5289ED5"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in subsection (a)—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H7D6B8963AAA34338B498D04ADABB5AAC"><enum>(A)</enum><text>in paragraph (2), by striking <quote>and</quote> at the end;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H4F7EC366AE3E43EB889D53A0D480A86E"><enum>(B)</enum><text>in paragraph (3), by striking the period at the end and inserting a semicolon; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H24131E15D2774240816BA28ED6471E03"><enum>(C)</enum><text>by adding at the end the following:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFCD39727FE1C497983136A935319A0AF"> <paragraph id="H46E18048F93B4DA5AEB3996B8B615490"><enum>(4)</enum><text>the term <term>foreign official</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HC5520B329AAA45FDBCDB666EEEBBF01C"><enum>(A)</enum> 
<clause id="HB43708526E944CE790B419E35E18EE16" commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text>any official or employee of a foreign government or any department, agency, or instrumentality thereof; or</text></clause> <clause id="H404559CA4CA9404BA4600511D2F6139D" indent="up1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">any senior foreign political figure, as defined in section 1010.605 of title 31, Code of Federal Regulations, or any successor regulation;</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H64AD28897A9E4C07ABB92573738D334B"><enum>(B)</enum><text>any official or employee of a public international organization;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA88BE16B65EA4F4BBAAF56A504D2E140"><enum>(C)</enum><text>any person acting in an official capacity for or on behalf of—</text> 
<clause id="H5D6608AB2BC74630B70404B2E4E4E313" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a government, department, agency, or instrumentality described in subparagraph (A)(i); or</text></clause> <clause id="H0FA2F97DBC644A59A62BB00B618C853C" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a public international organization; or</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HAF9CD70066C94508A31D3BCAD01EDD37"><enum>(D)</enum><text>any person acting in an unofficial capacity for or on behalf of—</text> <clause id="HB2914DF683DE4D61B8DA8E615D06158F" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a government, department, agency, or instrumentality described in subparagraph (A)(i); or</text></clause> 
<clause id="H4639C5320D61414B89D1C6932AC2A149" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(ii)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">a public international organization; and </text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H13BA373806574C32BB63DA0985149BC1"><enum>(5)</enum><text>the term <term>public international organization</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H6E4CEA0ADFE44F49BC530D83E49366F2"><enum>(A)</enum><text>an organization that is designated by Executive order pursuant to section 1 of the International Organizations Immunities Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/22/288">22 U.S.C. 288</external-xref>); or</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HE0645BFF22B9496AB6098E4C1F330A46"><enum>(B)</enum><text>any other international organization that is designated by the President by Executive order for the purposes of this section, effective as of the date of publication of such order in the Federal Register.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><after-quoted-block>; and</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H9F93E920C19E4639BC6422D07A72B620" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(2)</enum><text>by adding at the end the following:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H972FFF7ABA0D4C998B95112B59261A6F"> <subsection id="H48B81AC66B644A869245402F655F23F0"><enum>(f)</enum><header>Prohibition of demand for a bribe</header> <paragraph id="HF98BA52072BA4DB2B457960821FAC970"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Offense</header><text>It shall be unlawful for any foreign official or person selected to be a foreign official to corruptly demand, seek, receive, accept, or agree to receive or accept, directly or indirectly, anything of value personally or for any other person or nongovernmental entity, by making use of the mails or any means or instrumentality of interstate commerce, from any person (as defined in section 104A of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/78dd-3">15 U.S.C. 78dd–3</external-xref>), except that that definition shall be applied without regard to whether the person is an offender) while in the territory of the United States, from an issuer (as defined in section 3(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/78c">15 U.S.C. 78c(a)</external-xref>)), or from a domestic concern (as defined in section 104 of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/78dd-2">15 U.S.C. 78dd–2</external-xref>)), in return for—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H65CF5054E30E434F8EBB24773DD14418"><enum>(A)</enum><text>being influenced in the performance of any official act;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H8B6ACF6D61F64DF18AB8382B9FED44A0"><enum>(B)</enum><text>being induced to do or omit to do any act in violation of the official duty of such foreign official or person; or</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H23CBDE5157BB43918B6C14485BF08065"><enum>(C)</enum><text>conferring any improper advantage,</text></subparagraph><continuation-text continuation-text-level="paragraph">in connection with obtaining or retaining business for or with, or directing business to, any person.</continuation-text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H48CE1677CB78467B88396E3E5C0E59AC"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Penalties</header><text>Any person who violates paragraph (1) shall be fined not more than $250,000 or 3 times the monetary equivalent of the thing of value, imprisoned for not more than 15 years, or both.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H079951020CA14427AE28EED2FEE9F8BB"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Jurisdiction</header><text>An offense under paragraph (1) shall be subject to extraterritorial Federal jurisdiction.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HC19DFD2A463741F7BE372411AF3C248E"><enum>(4)</enum><header>Report</header><text>Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of the Foreign Extortion Prevention Act, and annually thereafter, the Attorney General, in consultation with the Secretary of State as relevant, shall submit to the Committee on the Judiciary and the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate and the Committee on the Judiciary and the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives, and post on the publicly available website of the Department of Justice, a report—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H62FEFDC5344743B6B0C1BCBBB51069F2"><enum>(A)</enum><text>focusing, in part, on demands by foreign officials for bribes from entities domiciled or incorporated in the United States, and the efforts of foreign governments to prosecute such cases;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H3448244906FD4E6B8F15FE81E7452FC6"><enum>(B)</enum><text>addressing United States diplomatic efforts to protect entities domiciled or incorporated in the United States from foreign bribery, and the effectiveness of those efforts in protecting such entities;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H73EEE09EDE2D4B3D89EC65161F9DC1AF"><enum>(C)</enum><text>summarizing major actions taken under this section in the previous year, including enforcement actions taken and penalties imposed;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HC6FE8A7048A3419AA7C6A85E9703C117"><enum>(D)</enum><text>evaluating the effectiveness of the Department of Justice in enforcing this section; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HEA2670224611466C9BC20D164E90441A"><enum>(E)</enum><text>detailing what resources or legislative action the Department of Justice needs to ensure adequate enforcement of this section.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFB55D98F029542F7B1D46EA1158C6855" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(5)</enum><header>Rule of construction</header><text>This subsection shall not be construed as encompassing conduct that would violate section 30A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/78dd-1">15 U.S.C. 78dd–1</external-xref>) or section 104 or 104A of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/78dd-2">15 U.S.C. 78dd–2</external-xref>; <external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/15/78dd-3">15 U.S.C. 78dd–3</external-xref>) whether pursuant to a theory of direct liability, conspiracy, complicity, or otherwise.</text></paragraph></subsection><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></section> 
<section id="H77C73C9AF45D480BBA5CFC038C98F01A" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>5102.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Preventing child sex abuse</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H0DF4DA7DF32C4E27B112F5DCBEAEA7C1"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Short title</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">This section may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Preventing Child Sex Abuse Act of 2023</short-title></quote>.</text></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3082A2690B104AECB29867E244EC2CA5"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Sense of Congress</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The sense of Congress is the following:</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HD523730291CD4C73A29027C619D6D94D"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The safety of children should be a top priority for public officials and communities in the United States.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF1DB1283C34049948F8738CF9B3E519B"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">According to the Rape, Abuse &amp; Incest National Network, an individual in the United States is sexually assaulted every 68 seconds. And every 9 minutes, that victim is a child. Meanwhile, only 25 out of every 1,000 perpetrators will end up in prison.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H437C2CEA173741708972AC1FA88C39DC"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The effects of child sexual abuse can be long-lasting and affect the victim’s mental health. </text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAB0F53C282804DE5BDFB04FA07EEE6F6"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Victims are more likely than non-victims to experience the following mental health challenges:</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE3D866365B85402B87F7B03B02F1DB2D"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Victims are about 4 times more likely to develop symptoms of drug abuse.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H13D14FA135954A259111931D382C8F82"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Victims are about 4 times more likely to experience post-traumatic stress disorder as adults.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3BA755CA02BA4674BEF5746DFBAE24FF"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Victims are about 3 times more likely to experience a major depressive episode as adults.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF34781429601402DBAA82F712F97A30E"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The criminal justice system should and has acted as an important line of defense to protect children and hold perpetrators accountable.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H57747B72A8364A69AEB612F4864D9F1F"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">However, the horrific crimes perpetuated by Larry Nassar demonstrate firsthand the loopholes that still exist in the criminal justice system. While Larry Nassar was found guilty of several State-level offenses, he was not charged federally for his illicit sexual contact with minors, despite crossing State and international borders to commit this conduct. </text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HDC990897AADC4F90A33B02D0894B5202"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The Department of Justice has also identified a growing trend of Americans who use charitable or missionary work in a foreign country as a cover for sexual abuse of children.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H52B0429E91F145B89159565722FC7C3E"><enum>(8)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">It is the intent of Congress to prohibit Americans from engaging in sexual abuse or exploitation of minors under the guise of work, including volunteer work, with an organization that affects interstate or foreign commerce, such as an international charity.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H76E78770A6EA498F8687AA429A510F1D"><enum>(9)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Federal law does not require that an abuser’s intention to engage in sexual abuse be a primary, significant, dominant, or motivating purpose of the travel. </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H6769D359075D479696F1022A0C8A3C27"><enum>(10)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Child sexual abuse does not require physical contact between the abuser and the child. This is especially true as perpetrators turn increasingly to internet platforms, online chat rooms, and webcams to commit child sexual abuse.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H238E3C49C4AE435DA5D03FE05170B897"><enum>(11)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">However, a decision of the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit found the use of a webcam to engage in sexually provocative activity with a minor did not qualify as <quote>sexual activity</quote>.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H27CEB0CEA3114D7196868031070D563C"><enum>(12)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Congress can address this issue by amending the definition of the term <term>sexual activity</term> to clarify that it does not require interpersonal, physical contact.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H44F1D905436F46BD9F3E8835AF936108"><enum>(13)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">It is the duty of Congress to provide clearer guidance to ensure that those who commit crimes against children are prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H797025F98A2F46ED9D6BC0A48656022E"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Interstate child sexual abuse</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 2423 of title 18, United States Code, is amended—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1921DCB59535439398F91F08726FA8F0"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in subsection (b), by striking <quote>with a motivating purpose of engaging in any illicit sexual conduct with another person</quote> and inserting <quote>with intent to engage in any illicit sexual conduct with another person</quote>;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB1308AA3E4584C64835083508D2AE45F"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by redesignating subsections (d), (e), (f), and (g) as subsections (e), (f), (g), and (i), respectively; </text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H8E4CE558D991495186E0A91F08EA9004"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in subsection (e), as so redesignated, by striking <quote>with a motivating purpose of engaging in any illicit sexual conduct</quote> and inserting <quote>with intent to engage in any illicit sexual conduct</quote>; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HEB0237506B6A4EA18307399092A87ED7"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by inserting after subsection (g), as so redesignated, the following:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H5949B0E5687E4127B453EC71A2E97719"> <subsection id="HC760482A647942DFA26AF9503F6732C7" commented="no"><enum>(h)</enum><header>Rule of construction</header><text>As used in this section, the term <term>intent</term> shall be construed as any intention to engage in prostitution, sexual activity for which any person can be charged with a criminal offense, or illicit sexual conduct, as applicable, at the time of the transportation or travel.</text></subsection><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H0875E027BB8F4991AD991A26541E77EB"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Abuse under the guise of charity</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 2423 of title 18, United States Code, as amended by subsection (c) of this section, is amended—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAAE25EB534E34715BBDD76756403423C"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">by inserting after subsection (c) the following:</text> 
<quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3FB1E6E862AA4B50A99C1A1D6D9B8A7F"> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H0084EC672DB54A30811B3235455A940F"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Illicit sexual conduct in connection with certain organizations</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Any citizen of the United States or alien admitted for permanent residence who—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H807859D598DE43AE86AA02A372A361A0"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">is an officer, director, employee, or agent of an organization that affects interstate or foreign commerce;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HC41F6D7806D34AF287D285830FE44CDA"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">makes use of the mails or any means or instrumentality of interstate or foreign commerce through the connection or affiliation of the person with such organization; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1D68DD5B9CA14DEAA528AE04F0809658"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">commits an act in furtherance of illicit sexual conduct through the connection or affiliation of the person with such organization, </text></paragraph><continuation-text commented="no" continuation-text-level="subsection">shall be fined under this title, imprisoned for not more than 30 years, or both.</continuation-text></subsection><after-quoted-block display="yes">; </after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H42A722E753D74FDE86EB263C20405DD1"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in subsection (f), as so redesignated, by striking <quote>or (d)</quote> and inserting <quote>(d), or (e)</quote>; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H8639FDD6F34D47B39E654B7F0F5BF9D7"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">in subsection (i), as so redesignated, by striking <quote>(f)(2)</quote> and inserting <quote>(g)(2)</quote>.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H47BF4E303935438FBC0243934B2D861B" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(e)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Sexual activity with minors</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Section 2427 of title 18, United States Code, is amended by inserting <quote>does not require interpersonal physical contact, and</quote> before <quote>includes</quote>. </text></subsection></section> <section id="H360615FC29DE4E459AACCC89839D091F" section-type="subsequent-section"><enum>5103.</enum><header>Recognition as corporation and grant of Federal charter for National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated</header> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1740F9C693164CC1A769145EC77D9211"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Part B of subtitle II of title 36, United States Code, is amended by inserting after chapter 1503 the following:</text> 
<quoted-block style="USC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H4AE398500A80400187A70B1357E09D2A"> 
<chapter commented="no" level-type="subsequent" id="HA8225931701846F08221CF2DAB0DFCF3"><enum>1504</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated</header>

<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H2B6D986DF0E149BC847E7AEB19564BE8"><enum>150401</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Organization</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated, a nonprofit corporation organized in the United States (referred to in this chapter as the <term>corporation</term>), is a federally chartered corporation.</text></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H487084A2156C4FA8886B890B0E143698"><enum>150402.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Purposes</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The purposes of the corporation are those stated in the articles of incorporation, constitution, and bylaws of the corporation, and include a commitment—</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H00185FD87F5A48E9AA1008D1561FA52D"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to uphold and defend the Constitution of the United States while respecting the sovereignty of the American Indian Nations;</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE28F93260F0342EEAE9B9D3D2CDEA883"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to unite under one body all American Indian veterans who served in the Armed Forces of United States;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA4F66EC120164A2EBE45954F4F2CDEE0"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to be an advocate on behalf of all American Indian veterans without regard to whether they served during times of peace, conflict, or war;</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H91AE2EA1A7284B599E64BB53FFE93395"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to promote social welfare (including educational, economic, social, physical, and cultural values and traditional healing) in the United States by encouraging the growth and development, readjustment, self-respect, self-confidence, contributions, and self-identity of American Indian veterans;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1B6A25975A8B40ACAA9931C4AC78D19E"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to serve as an advocate for the needs of American Indian veterans and their families and survivors in their dealings with all Federal and State government agencies;</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF1CBB30C813D417DB119FBCAF9A1CB09"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to promote, support, and utilize research, on a nonpartisan basis, pertaining to the relationship between American Indian veterans and American society; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H771FEAF6786D43C7AB8E83AFC9D2D420"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">to provide technical assistance to the Bureau of Indian Affairs regional areas that are not served by any veterans committee or organization or program by—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H83AEA2599E614ED2A4F777129D6FDB21"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">providing outreach service to Indian Tribes in need; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H6E1C8070331E40929D46C4A6D802D3A3"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">training and educating Tribal Veterans Service Officers for Indian Tribes in need.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H092DB431C1294EB8A1DFCE78D08C133C"><enum>150403.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Membership</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Subject to section 150406, eligibility for membership in the corporation, and the rights and privileges of members, shall be as provided in the constitution and bylaws of the corporation.</text></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="HCBA870865F0244F2ACF7BB674AD318BE"><enum>150404.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Board of directors</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Subject to section 150406, the board of directors of the corporation, and the responsibilities of the board, shall be as provided in the constitution and bylaws of the corporation and in conformity with the laws under which the corporation is incorporated.</text></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="HF36F57475B594165BA6B26547383000C"><enum>150405.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Officers</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Subject to section 150406, the officers of the corporation, and the election of such officers, shall be as provided in the constitution and bylaws of the corporation and in conformity with the laws of the jurisdiction under which the corporation is incorporated.</text></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="HE8E164AFD0114A4D809E328FFC02B76B"><enum>150406.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nondiscrimination</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">In establishing the conditions of membership in the corporation, and in determining the requirements for serving on the board of directors or as an officer of the corporation, the corporation may not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, handicap, or age.</text></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H4B6278B44C5F404EAAFBDA3BDCC1755D"><enum>150407.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Powers</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The corporation shall have only those powers granted the corporation through its articles of incorporation, constitution, and bylaws, which shall conform to the laws of the jurisdiction under which the corporation is incorporated.</text></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H7B1914AC93C747AE9D7FC22635673264"><enum>150408.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Exclusive right to name, seals, emblems, and badges</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H068B9BE5EB8B4A7395A90EA4B1C2F0FA"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The corporation shall have the sole and exclusive right to use the names <quote>National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated</quote> and <quote>National American Indian Veterans</quote>, and such seals, emblems, and badges as the corporation may lawfully adopt.</text></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H4F192CCF48384608A98EA759B386660E"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Effect</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section interferes or conflicts with any established or vested rights.</text></subsection></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H1301BB4934354B8B863AD015D966E65D"><enum>150409.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Restrictions</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H0402AE32297F43DB839763D3AA44B2B5"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Stock and dividends</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The corporation may not—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H855A9E3F00DC4D8FA5581DB06F181941"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">issue any shares of stock; or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1E4C4E006826436CBF9CA09AB3E46697"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">declare or pay any dividends.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H6E9670E8691C467DB949B42A48B12444"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Distribution of income or assets</header> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H510505A6AAD64A9495595B91D1E773DC"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The income or assets of the corporation may not—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H752E5C50F9C5462DB8FA26B4E55A9C89"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">inure to any person who is a member, officer, or director of the corporation; or </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H2F5E1EEFECE24FC4A8D340020A964F2E"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">be distributed to any such person during the life of the charter granted by this chapter.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H24D4166E20E34FD2A16A99B8E6835CBC"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Effect</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this subsection prevents the payment of reasonable compensation to the officers of the corporation, or reimbursement for actual and necessary expenses, in amounts approved by the board of directors.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H39DCD5680F1D43DF96A3CE95C8F2F051"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Loans</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The corporation may not make any loan to any officer, director, member, or employee of the corporation.</text></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H441AB7DF3249462E9EDE8455939FE2E8"><enum>(d)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">No federal endorsement</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The corporation may not claim congressional approval or Federal Government authority by virtue of the charter granted by this chapter for any of the activities of the corporation.</text></subsection></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H89A499398615425CB4BDE8EBB6F2B8CE"><enum>150410.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Duty to maintain tax-exempt status</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The corporation shall maintain its status as an organization exempt from taxation under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.</text></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H424DEE36FCB849E68BDDF94C75A8E8F2"><enum>150411.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Records and inspection</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H106A90166D744B02B57A04C1EAD698E1"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Records</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The corporation shall keep—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HC124DE5711C84AD1A2FB17643E740A84"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">correct and complete books and records of accounts;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HD2AF1844D45E4BBB88B58CFBE707C02F"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">minutes of any proceeding of the corporation involving any member of the corporation, the board of directors, or any committee having authority under the board of directors; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HCEE3723E673E4F7BBF4479A451727230"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">at the principal office of the corporation, a record of the names and addresses of all members of the corporation having the right to vote.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H57EF3EDAE91E4BCF925512DE9088CD65"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Inspection</header> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H929DEFB683004A4EB690C3DA6129699B"><enum>(1)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">All books and records of the corporation may be inspected by any member having the right to vote, or by any agent or attorney of such a member, for any proper purpose, at any reasonable time.</text></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H34AD3C44DA7C42288B552814802AAF52"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Effect</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Nothing in this section contravenes—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAF48C12634684C37A014DB9EB8ED3C62"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the laws of the jurisdiction under which the corporation is incorporated; or </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H864D7D99CA45474FA79E8A092759341A"><enum>(B)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the laws of those jurisdictions within the United States and its territories within which the corporation carries out activities in furtherance of the purposes of the corporation.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="HF232FEDFC8FD4E5DA91196BD6DA5553E"><enum>150412.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Service of process</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">With respect to service of process, the corporation shall comply with the laws of—</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H4FEF458944244DA2A38B7001AE360973"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the jurisdiction under which the corporation is incorporated; and</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HFBFC610A2DC54257B1D37B359B75C269"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">those jurisdictions within the United States and its territories within which the corporation carries out activities in furtherance of the purposes of the corporation.</text></paragraph></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="HA49D0AC68BD04CC09552C6CFB57C560D"><enum>150413.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Liability for acts of officers and agents</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">The corporation shall be liable for the acts of the officers and agents of the corporation acting within the scope of their authority.</text></section> 
<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H2F58E652EA84423C8844B3386AA34216"><enum>150414.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Failure to comply with requirements</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">If the corporation fails to comply with any of the requirements of this chapter, including the requirement under section 150410 to maintain its status as an organization exempt from taxation, the charter granted by this chapter shall expire.</text></section> <section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" section-type="subsequent-section" id="H8CA395D90CBB4DB9B7E13E36859B5EE3"><enum>150415.</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Annual report</header> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H09C4EB75043A4F2AB908DD8617637683"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The corporation shall submit to Congress an annual report describing the activities of the corporation during the preceding fiscal year.</text></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HABC23940749445AF844A9020CE72B0BD"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Submittal date</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Each annual report under this section shall be submitted at the same time as the report of the audit of the corporation required by section 10101(b).</text></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HCBF9AEDCADB44C4ABCA28D0762B1B3EC"><enum>(c)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Report not public document</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">No annual report under this section shall be printed as a public document.</text></subsection></section></chapter><after-quoted-block display="yes">.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HDD98B5BF130E42A0985E69B6C0E1A682"><enum>(b)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Clerical amendment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The table of chapters for subtitle II of title 36, United States Code, is amended by inserting after the item relating to chapter 1503 the following:</text> <quoted-block style="USC" id="H2A23E7A5FAE74CEA91D00858EAE06E81" display-inline="no-display-inline"> <toc regeneration="no-regeneration"> <multi-column-toc-entry level="section"><toc-enum>1504.</toc-enum><level-header level="section">National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated</level-header><target>150401</target></multi-column-toc-entry></toc><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block> </subsection></section> <section id="H3C3B7CBDB7E54A74B7B146C568C1B90E"><enum>5104.</enum><header>Visa availability for government employee immigrant visa program</header> <subsection id="H3788B510D7BB4E7AB32F42C4650AC533"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Beginning in fiscal year 2024, subject to subsection (b), visas shall be made available to a special immigrant described in section 101(a)(27)(D) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/8/1101">8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(27)(D)</external-xref>) if a visa is not immediately available for issuance to the special immigrant under section 203(b)(4) of that Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/8/1153">8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(4)</external-xref>).</text></subsection>

<subparagraph id="H423ACF3ACB934CBBBCEC7D8CC7D49E52"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the total of the reductions in available visas under this subsection for all previous fiscal years.</text></subparagraph></paragraph><after-quoted-block>; and</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> <paragraph id="HDD341845B2034DE2A67A93CF05258F01"><enum>(2)</enum><text>by adding at the end the following:</text>

<subparagraph id="HA138E8DCBEFC4A8ABF275977D0FEBEFE" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Paragraph (1) shall not apply in a fiscal year following a fiscal year for which the sum calculated under paragraph (2)(A), minus the number in paragraph (2)(B), is zero.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H5EEADEA40A4A4A02A06D3738834901BF" indent="up1"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Nothing in this paragraph may be construed—</text>

<paragraph id="HB1F46EEEA5CC4DD89EA395C9BBF57148"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">In the event that the number of visas available for a fiscal year under section 201(e) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/8/1151">8 U.S.C. 1151(e)</external-xref>) is reduced to a number fewer than 50,000, not fewer than 3,000 of such visas shall be made available for individuals described in section 5104 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024.</text></paragraph><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HBCE7AAAEAF2646088CCAFA851A7CF0CF"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Rule of construction</header><text>Nothing in this section or the amendments made by this section may be construed to modify the number of visas available under section 203(b)(4) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/8/1153">8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(4)</external-xref>) to special immigrants described in section 101(a)(27)(D) of that Act (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/8/1101">8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(27)(D)</external-xref>).</text></subsection></section></title>

<toc-entry idref="H740C9B6B07A948059BDC7D101AA7D0F6" level="section">Sec. 5201. Establishment of higher rates of regularly scheduled overtime pay for United States Border Patrol agents classified at GS–12.</toc-entry></toc> 
<section commented="no" id="H740C9B6B07A948059BDC7D101AA7D0F6"><enum>5201.</enum><header>Establishment of higher rates of regularly scheduled overtime pay for United States Border Patrol agents classified at GS–12</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 5550 of title 5, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following:</text> <quoted-block style="OLC" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB341318AE48040F9AD51E860E893CF1D"> <subsection id="HA1D82B67588647E6A3BC591D958866A3"><enum>(h)</enum><header>Special overtime pay for GS–12 border patrol agents</header> <paragraph id="HF7B3C9C929D344DDBB7F7AC46104F424"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Notwithstanding paragraphs (1)(F), (2)(C), and (3)(C) of subsection (b), a border patrol agent encumbering a position at grade GS–12 shall receive a special overtime payment under this subsection for hours of regularly scheduled work described in paragraph (2)(A)(ii) or (3)(A)(ii) of subsection (b), as applicable, that are credited to the agent through actual performance of work, crediting under rules for canine agents under subsection (b)(1)(F), or substitution of overtime hours in the same work period under subsection (f)(2)(A), except that no such payment may be made for periods of absence resulting in an hours obligation under paragraph (3) or (4) of subsection (f).</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HC8C22DEE33E24AEB8625F976E34455BA"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Computation</header><text>The special overtime payment authorized under paragraph (1) shall be computed by multiplying the credited hours by 50 percent of the border patrol agent’s hourly rate of basic pay, rounded to the nearest cent.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HB89C64F5BDE34781AE3407281FE3195C"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Limitations</header><text>The special overtime payment authorized under paragraph (1)—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H7C6B124D1EDE42D8BD3D05A3221C49C5"><enum>(A)</enum><text>is not considered basic pay for retirement under section 8331(3) or 8401(4) or for any other purpose;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA870C066CCC343F384C233BA82CDA3B1"><enum>(B)</enum><text>is not payable during periods of paid leave or other paid time off; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H194A3DEA644E4586959363F16357689D"><enum>(C)</enum><text>is not considered in computing an agent’s lump-sum annual leave payment under sections 5551 and 5552.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection><after-quoted-block>.</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></section></title> <title id="H5EC1F7103BA249CA8A270D64FD58540B"><enum>LIII</enum><header>Federal Data and Information Security</header> <toc container-level="title-container" quoted-block="no-quoted-block" lowest-level="section" idref="H5EC1F7103BA249CA8A270D64FD58540B" regeneration="yes-regeneration" lowest-bolded-level="division-lowest-bolded"> <toc-entry idref="H8C35732DC9FF44A9AF39530F0A696130" level="section">Sec. 5301. <section id="H1B8D83E4663541C3B83438E8B29E1C3B"><enum>5302.</enum><header>Federal Data Center Consolidation Initiative amendments</header> 
<subsection id="H4B385B82D97E410C8BF931A0003A5C5C"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Findings</header><text>Congress finds the following:</text> <paragraph id="H3E9227CC0F454CB99E111B683EA15948"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The statutory authorization for the Federal Data Center Optimization Initiative under section 834 of the Carl Levin and Howard P. <quote>Buck</quote> McKeon National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2015 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/44/3601">44 U.S.C. 3601</external-xref> note; <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/113/291">Public Law 113–291</external-xref>) expired at the end of fiscal year 2022.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H0822FA116C204E23835928035636F12A"><enum>(2)</enum><text>The expiration of the authorization described in paragraph (1) presents Congress with an opportunity to review the objectives of the Federal Data Center Optimization Initiative to ensure that the initiative is meeting the current needs of the Federal Government.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HDB8F7670A7A64400BC16AE730AE5073D"><enum>(3)</enum><text>The initial focus of the Federal Data Center Optimization Initiative, which was to consolidate data centers and create new efficiencies, has resulted in, since 2010—</text> 
<subparagraph id="HD5FC2F2F05F741A09452D4971EA64628"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the consolidation of more than 6,000 Federal data centers; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H9F7518B2F38140C49997DC431020A43B"><enum>(B)</enum><text>cost savings and avoidance of $5,800,000,000.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H979DD7E5817B45C6AEC7CF8978C38A36"><enum>(4)</enum><text>The need of the Federal Government for access to data and data processing systems has evolved since the date of enactment in 2014 of subtitle D of title VIII of the Carl Levin and Howard P. <quote>Buck</quote> McKeon National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2015.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HEB4B1E98292440CAB7F6422FB811D8D7"><enum>(5)</enum><text>Federal agencies and employees involved in mission critical functions increasingly need reliable access to secure, reliable, and protected facilities to house mission critical data and data operations to meet the immediate needs of the people of the United States.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H8619C31C26884EA599904A5543FC1B5B"><enum>(6)</enum><text>As of the date of enactment of this title, there is a growing need for Federal agencies to use data centers and cloud applications that meet high standards for cybersecurity, resiliency, and availability.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H8625CF4E1BFF4A49B739825A37893774"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Minimum requirements for new data centers</header><text>Section 834 of the Carl Levin and Howard P. <quote>Buck</quote> McKeon National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2015 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/44/3601">44 U.S.C. 3601</external-xref> note; <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/113/291">Public Law 113–291</external-xref>) is amended—</text> 
<paragraph id="HB9142D3B9B0649809DD2DE1533B3CE29"><enum>(1)</enum><text>in subsection (a), by striking paragraphs (3) and (4) and inserting the following:</text> <quoted-block id="H8F360877E4EF4C3EAA5FB553316BFC9F" style="OLC"> <paragraph id="H917DEED600BB455CBB7899577F95FEA0"><enum>(3)</enum><header>New data center</header><text>The term <quote>new data center</quote> means—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H3482D24FFE43421DB590D6881E0A68D1"><enum>(A)</enum> 
<clause id="HE4AB2AFA4BF14AE18F8408AAE79F6B0D" display-inline="yes-display-inline"><enum>(i)</enum><text>a data center or a portion thereof that is owned, operated, or maintained by a covered agency; or</text></clause> <clause id="HE09365AFB1B04E70B8491CBE265B3BD1" indent="up1"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>to the extent practicable, a data center or portion thereof—</text> 
<subclause id="H6850740D868C441B8E8F873FDC359DB8"><enum>(I)</enum><text>that is owned, operated, or maintained by a contractor on behalf of a covered agency on the date on which the contract between the covered agency and the contractor expires; and</text></subclause> <subclause id="H9620C8F7A61B443DB42635AE3969D7B0"><enum>(II)</enum><text>with respect to which the covered agency extends the contract, or enters into a new contract, with the contractor; and</text></subclause></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HB0D4E13DBFB741CD82457E75DEAC7E6B"><enum>(B)</enum><text>on or after the date that is 180 days after the date of enactment of the Federal Data Center Enhancement Act of 2023, a data center or portion thereof that is—</text> <clause id="HD6A6AAFAC219466B87514D0241044DB6"><enum>(i)</enum><text>established; or</text></clause> 
<clause id="H28EE2A527EBD46E0BCC68DED6A0EBEAF"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>substantially upgraded or expanded.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph><after-quoted-block>;</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> <paragraph id="H4D54EFC01C474AA0B834BFAC9D04EAAC"><enum>(2)</enum><text>by striking subsection (b) and inserting the following:</text> 
<quoted-block id="H3CF6AA0402434CD88DCFBE125FC81CCB" style="OLC"> 
<subsection id="HEE653933EAD245EB8BC0711AEA053082"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Minimum requirements for new data centers</header> 
<paragraph id="H8AC64C8A05AF4C1AA0677FDCF1E5E7E0"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of the Federal Data Center Enhancement Act of 2023, the Administrator shall establish minimum requirements for new data centers in consultation with the Administrator of General Services and the Federal Chief Information Officers Council.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HFFB346FC7D9D4123AAB83CAEAEFF9916"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Contents</header> <subparagraph id="HA05512A1EA244F4C9B1CCCBFA68F54C7"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The minimum requirements established under paragraph (1) shall include requirements relating to—</text> 
<clause id="HCC3ED905719E4ECC90B09FF8D6BB54AA"><enum>(i)</enum><text>the availability of new data centers;</text></clause> <clause id="H3273A645E6244E42B9F049850EE5F999"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>the use of new data centers, including costs related to the facility, energy consumption, and related infrastructure;</text></clause> 
<clause id="H30170892EA784DBBAA9F68AFDC9FC888"><enum>(iii)</enum><text>uptime percentage;</text></clause> <clause id="H37E94697878847D7B11F03A0C39052ED"><enum>(iv)</enum><text>protections against power failures, including on-site energy generation and access to multiple transmission paths;</text></clause> 
<clause id="HBFFFD08DB45D44079959075745895244"><enum>(v)</enum><text>protections against physical intrusions and natural disasters;</text></clause> <clause id="H5DFDD69DE4B5423CA2A35E363AB0C6AB"><enum>(vi)</enum><text>information security protections required by subchapter II of <external-xref legal-doc="usc-chapter" parsable-cite="usc-chapter/44/35">chapter 35</external-xref> of title 44, United States Code, and other applicable law and policy; and</text></clause>

<paragraph id="H8A532516068445E4A56093DF3A3FB98F"><enum>(5)</enum><header>Report on new data centers</header><text>During the development and planning lifecycle of a new data center, if the head of a covered agency determines that the covered agency is likely to make a management or financial decision relating to any data center, the head of the covered agency shall—</text> <subparagraph id="HB952D602EC5042A9BFFB10A4B4D0F5C7"><enum>(A)</enum><text>notify—</text>

<paragraph id="H9CEE5AC7BE7F4A96BA2608B42232EEBB"><enum>(6)</enum><header>Use of technology</header><text>In determining whether to establish or continue to operate an existing data center, the head of a covered agency shall—</text> <subparagraph id="H3C45D0C1B4FE4189B08B0687242E72BF"><enum>(A)</enum><text>regularly assess the application portfolio of the covered agency and ensure that each at-risk legacy application is updated, replaced, or modernized, as appropriate, to take advantage of modern technologies; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H89891DFFD30141E3AE000E0F61D18F37"><enum>(B)</enum><text>prioritize and, to the greatest extent possible, leverage commercial data center solutions, including hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, co-location, interconnection, or cloud computing (as defined in section 3607 of this Chapter) rather than acquiring, overseeing, or managing custom data center infrastructure.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H2D4F90A8CC0D4849A9D85113157C1F98"><enum>(7)</enum><header>Public website</header> <subparagraph id="H5D93E383BCB64212BD1E4BAAA6ECE0AF"><enum>(A)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The Administrator shall maintain a public-facing website that includes information, data, and explanatory statements relating to the compliance of covered agencies with the requirements of this section.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HD58653451CC444E989D4BFEA540696E3"><enum>(B)</enum><header>Processes and procedures</header><text>In maintaining the website described in subparagraph (A), the Administrator shall—</text> <clause id="H8700AB7A6D244B0FABB76A1A1B4C538C"><enum>(i)</enum><text>ensure covered agencies regularly, and not less frequently than biannually, update the information, data, and explanatory statements posed on the website, pursuant to guidance issued by the Administrator, relating to any new data centers and, as appropriate, each existing data center of the covered agency; and</text></clause> 
<clause id="H2BBC670845CB4E0AADCD1C11CB6BBBA5"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>ensure that all information, data, and explanatory statements on the website are maintained as open Government data assets.</text></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection><after-quoted-block>; and</after-quoted-block></quoted-block></paragraph> <paragraph id="HABB13C6735CE4DDCA10D9137EE796482"><enum>(3)</enum><text>in subsection (c), by striking paragraph (1) and inserting the following:</text>

<paragraph id="H47DE4F2E96424F2F9CA417CDB6962679"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>The head of a covered agency shall oversee and manage the data center portfolio and the information technology strategy of the covered agency in accordance with Federal cybersecurity guidelines and directives, including—</text> <subparagraph id="H766656E6D3B343DCBE03AB1BC604DBFA"><enum>(A)</enum><text>information security standards and guidelines promulgated by the Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology;</text></subparagraph>
