<section id="H41DBD456F9214841877686BC117A13F6"><enum>7405.</enum><header>Assessment of threat posed to United States ports by cranes manufactured by countries of concern</header> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H5AF8D8E99C0948CD81C156BB67B6FDF9"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H2D229BB1D6344E59902CC3D524F80ABA"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Appropriate committees of Congress</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>appropriate committees of Congress</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H145D401803704BC7A7A58158F87CB08B"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the congressional intelligence committees;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HCECF48A189D9489D8774B9B239D6284C"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs, the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs, the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation, and the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H175FB3763DF1407FA5ADA88622E43ECD"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Oversight and Accountability, the Committee on Financial Services, the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H33879F4188694A438ACE6D0128C3FF06"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Country of concern</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>country of concern</term> has the meaning given that term in section 1(m)(1) of the State Department Basic Authorities Act of 1956 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/22/2651a">22 U.S.C. 2651a(m)(1)</external-xref>). </text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HA25FDC5932624CB5959F246A95C14093"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Assessment</header><text>The Director of National Intelligence, in coordination with such other heads of the elements of the intelligence community as the Director considers appropriate and the Secretary of Defense, shall conduct an assessment of the threat posed to United States ports by cranes manufactured by countries of concern and commercial entities of those countries, including the Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co. (ZPMC). </text></subsection> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HAAC3BE9D6E77441F9D46E4FEE452A5FD"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Report and briefing</header> <paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HB402CC6CE8544C58B1D904465F4BA482"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Director of National Intelligence shall submit a report and provide a briefing to the appropriate committees of Congress on the findings of the assessment required by subsection (b). </text></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H3A77F92EC86B4CDE9369599A8AA9407F"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Elements</header><text>The report and briefing required by paragraph (1) shall outline the potential for the cranes described in subsection (b) to collect intelligence, disrupt operations at United States ports, and impact the national security of the United States.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H239744A701A6401B8784B261C509D675" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Form of report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The report required by paragraph (1) shall be submitted in unclassified form, but may include a classified annex.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HE19CA026377C4308B5AD75762D23B16C" section-type="subsequent-section" display-inline="no-display-inline" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>7406.</enum><header>Intelligence assessment of influence operations by People’s Republic of China toward Pacific Islands countries</header> 
<subsection id="H4A56F0C3017D4DF0AB00ED38142604AB" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Assessment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Assistant Secretary of State for Intelligence and Research, in consultation with the heads of the other elements of the intelligence community that the Assistant Secretary determines appropriate, shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees an assessment of influence operations by the People’s Republic of China toward Pacific Islands countries. </text></subsection> <subsection id="H20CB182148554304A59A506554B3451D" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Elements</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The intelligence assessment under subsection (a) shall include the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="H57BC884D594A4E359EA4A727B34C094B" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><text>A description of recent and potential future efforts by the People’s Republic of China, using either overt or covert means, to enhance its security, political, diplomatic, or economic ties with Pacific Islands countries.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H793F3368CAC642E5B2EC761074468DAD" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment of how the People’s Republic of China views the success of its efforts to expand influence in Pacific Islands countries, and the importance of such efforts to its national security, foreign policy, and economic development objectives.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE742A4EA11C6444F9DF01E9BF940F7AA" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><text>An identification of Pacific Islands countries in which the People’s Republic of China has established, or is seeking to establish, an intelligence presence or intelligence partnerships.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HCA9CFC548EEA43EA83CAE5D728C66437" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment of the degree to which the People’s Republic of China is using economic or other forms of coercion to pressure the Pacific Islands countries that diplomatically recognize Taiwan (the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Palau, Nauru, and Tuvalu) into instead recognizing the People’s Republic of China.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE6E09EAB0AF84E1999E4D084EE2CF0E4" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(5)</enum><text>An analysis of how specific Pacific Islands countries are responding to efforts by the People’s Republic of China to increase bilateral engagement.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBDC431F4119A42339E66094F0221242C" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment of the influence of the People’s Republic of China in the Pacific Islands Forum (the main multilateral organization of the region) and of the efforts of the People’s Republic of China to establish parallel regional organizations and recruit Pacific Islands countries to participate.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H14BF365BF48F4AD69F107653CB505303" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(7)</enum><text>An analysis of opportunities for the United States to counter influence operations by the People’s Republic of China in the Pacific Islands region that undermine the national security or economic interests of the United States.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H9DE008419E1C4D9DB1C41F43AC2E7900" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Form</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The intelligence assessment under subsection (a) may be submitted in classified form.</text></subsection> 
<subsection id="H600A9E283E314CD981C67F24C1EED3F5" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> <paragraph id="HA47030EEE67047E3A3E235053724D080" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Appropriate congressional committees</header><text>The term <term>appropriate congressional committees</term> means—</text> 
<subparagraph id="H627C01960A4A43DAA1AB13D320CAB5FF" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the congressional intelligence committees;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph changed="not-changed" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HE47B1C84EEDA462393D24F3009BAA125"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Committee on Foreign Relations, the Committee on Armed Services, and the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H303C3F4EEF1B4AC8A24651DB9BCEEC56" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the Committee on Foreign Affairs, the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Appropriations, and the Select Committee on the Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party of the House of Representatives.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF03BC89ED96C44A5B431494CCE95C878" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Pacific Islands countries</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The term <term>Pacific Islands countries</term> includes the Federated States of Micronesia, Fiji, French Polynesia, Kiribati, the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Nauru, Palau, Solomon Islands, Tonga, Samoa, Niue, Tuvalu, and Vanuatu.</text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H3CBBE1B1B82E42CF9A47BA16E9DC240A" section-type="subsequent-section" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>7407.</enum><header>Independent study on economic impact of military invasion of Taiwan by People’s Republic of China</header> 
<subsection id="H6990C31EC46145E6A38018D1139D0CFE" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Requirement</header><text>Not later than 60 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Director of National Intelligence shall seek to enter into a contract with an eligible entity to conduct a comprehensive study on the global economic impact of a military invasion of Taiwan by the People’s Republic of China or certain other aggressive or coercive actions taken by the People’s Republic of China with respect to Taiwan.</text></subsection> <subsection id="H216DFC09590D45A7A8EDF29E1FD4400B" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Matters included</header><text>The study required under <internal-xref idref="H6990C31EC46145E6A38018D1139D0CFE" legis-path="__(a)">subsection (a)</internal-xref> shall include the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="H7E275E5727D141FB818CBD47633CF90F" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">An assessment of the economic impact globally, in the United States, and in the People’s Republic of China that would result from an invasion of Taiwan by the People’s Republic of China under various potential invasion and response scenarios, including with respect to the impact on—</text> <subparagraph id="H5D44847385544026AED8456BFA768554" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(A)</enum><text>supply chains;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HF3660B9EC2BD46928DED067F1C0EC50C" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(B)</enum><text>trade flows;</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HA44B2EC1C66141BC8D10522CAA45306E" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(C)</enum><text>financial markets;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="HD679E975B4154EDEA129D4A520AC1715" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(D)</enum><text>sovereign debt; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H54A4F01666F64203AA6A5FF54124BE89" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(E)</enum><text>gross domestic product, unemployment, and other key economic indicators.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H168783F2420F47CFA6C10BC5EF067897" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><text> An assessment of the economic impact globally, in the United States, and in the People’s Republic of China that would result from of an aggressive or coercive military, economic, or other action taken by the People’s Republic of China with respect to Taiwan that falls short of an invasion, including as a result of a blockade of Taiwan.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H7C181B96D40048BFB04F87A7D7EF71A7" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The development of economic policy options, to include sanctions and supply chain restrictions, designed to cause escalating impacts on the economy of the People’s Republic of China during a preconflict phase.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HF6ADF3AC66454A8AAB3B43D563F97A25" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Report</header> 
<paragraph id="H5C07000CE4614909939F130FD54E77BA" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the eligible entity that the Director of National Intelligence enters into an agreement with under <internal-xref idref="H6990C31EC46145E6A38018D1139D0CFE" legis-path="__(a)">subsection (a)</internal-xref> shall submit to the Director a report containing the results of the study conducted under such subsection. </text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HBB908EB061F6498BAE68E45DE9B2F0D2" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Submission to Congress</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 30 days after the date the Director receives the report under <internal-xref idref="H5C07000CE4614909939F130FD54E77BA" legis-path="__(c)(1)">paragraph (1)</internal-xref>, the Director shall submit the report to—</text> 
<subparagraph commented="no" changed="not-changed" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H9AD6F7470B744A1E8B8EC3A7949BFA92"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the congressional intelligence committees; </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph changed="not-changed" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HDC23D10B9836488D90CD68657D37998F"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Foreign Relations, the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs, and the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph changed="not-changed" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H631297E75D9D42A9AC7459BCC4DF913B"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the Committee on Armed Services, the Committee on Foreign Affairs, and the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives. </text></subparagraph></paragraph> <paragraph id="H8484D6AD3CFF460C88027AC199D65423" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Form of report</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The report required under this subsection shall be submitted in unclassified form, but may include a classified annex.</text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="H766114DD5FBE49E6940E0AF0B334BFFC" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Eligible entity defined</header><text>In this section, the term <term>eligible entity</term> means a federally funded research and development center or nongovernmental entity which has—</text> <paragraph id="H004B9987FC204000AC4F886545D5DFD1" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><text>a primary focus on studies and analysis;</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H1CFCB8B03F7B45859B8DF0D1990C9B40" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><text>experience and expertise relevant to the study required under <internal-xref idref="H6990C31EC46145E6A38018D1139D0CFE" legis-path="__(a)">subsection (a)</internal-xref>; and</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5EC9715ACEBB44F19FB73A1C259C8C86" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><text>a sufficient number of personnel with the appropriate security clearance to conduct such study. </text></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HA0A6F90464CF424B8B313ED7185BB722" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>7408.</enum><header>Report by Director of National Intelligence on Uyghur genocide</header> 
<subsection id="HA034034839354CB8AD352260769D94C2" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Report on Uyghur genocide</header> 
<paragraph id="HC5F2E8717A914EA1952E033DE8CC36C7" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Submission</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Director of National Intelligence, in coordination with the relevant heads of the elements of the intelligence community, shall submit to the appropriate committees of Congress a report on the Uyghur genocide.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H5654E456903F4F67830735ACDE3FE763" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><header>Matters</header><text>The report under paragraph (1) shall address the following matters:</text> 
<subparagraph id="H61185CEE886D4647B03753B17987786C" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Forced sterilization, forced birth control, and forced abortion of Uyghurs.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H63489FDEC4F64CD4AC1E82D902B8D2F0" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Forced transfer of Uyghur children from their families.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H38B317E3C0154DF8B7E000C2E728AA1C" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(C)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Forced labor of Uyghurs, inside and outside of Xinjiang.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="HFEDD1C9A2C1743A18D5C7CA3189C9A23" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(D)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The work conditions of Uyghur laborers (including laborers in the textile, automobile and electric vehicle, solar panel, polyvinyl chloride, and rare earth metals sectors), including an identification of any company that is—</text> 
<clause id="H624E92C71E78417D97D67A9F9D0489C7" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(i)</enum><text>organized under the laws of the People’s Republic of China or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction of (or over which control is exercised or exercisable by) the Government of the People’s Republic of China; and</text></clause> <clause id="H93BD445A350747A08D50DA7692AA6E7D" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(ii)</enum><text>employing forced Uyghur laborers from Xinjiang.</text></clause></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H153A945C02D749939689C539A163B968" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(E)</enum><text>Any other forms of physical or psychological torture against Uyghurs.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H45B99D5703FC446085CC257B6F000D31" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(F)</enum><text>Any other actions that infringe on the rights of Uyghurs to live freely in accordance with their customs, culture, and religious practices.</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H1A93E03306FE42F89B5BDDAC0D004D61" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(G)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The methods of surveillance of Uyghurs, including surveillance via technology, law enforcement notifications, and forcing Uyghurs to live with other individuals for monitoring purposes.</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H0E83DE5F7C7246558D90AF5F594C56B1" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(H)</enum><text>Such other matters as the Director of National Intelligence may determine appropriate.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF4D12679EE6A4BC8A526D3E739BB1E09" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><header>Form</header><text>The report under paragraph (1) shall be submitted in unclassified form, but may include a classified annex.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="HD918341BFE024B1185B1C98CC5ABC387" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Definitions</header><text>In this section:</text> 
<paragraph commented="no" changed="not-changed" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H85F628DFF33B4F45AA1B33C6A10C0D3E"><enum>(1)</enum><header>Appropriate committees of Congress</header><text>The term <term>appropriate committees of Congress</term> means—</text> <subparagraph commented="no" changed="not-changed" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H7848578D225A49DC9DA80A4E951AC20E"><enum>(A)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">the congressional intelligence committees; </text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph changed="not-changed" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HC51A7C1A927C446DA54DAE6A197AC762"><enum>(B)</enum><text>the Committee on Foreign Relations and the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and </text></subparagraph> <subparagraph changed="not-changed" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="HF5932779E07D412BA78E764F0839F5FB"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the Committee on Foreign Affairs and the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives. </text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph commented="no" changed="not-changed" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H595E3C3721E746DA85468598CD85DB5A"><enum>(2)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Intelligence; national intelligence</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">The terms <term>intelligence</term> and <term>national intelligence</term> have the meanings given those terms in section 3 of the National Security Act of 1947 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/50/3003">50 U.S.C. 3003</external-xref>). </text></paragraph></subsection></section></subtitle> <subtitle id="H0716709009304F8D9DF4803044DACAE3" style="OLC"><enum>B</enum><header>Other foreign countries</header> <section id="H8328868DA7FB429F90F1A06A62F69383"><enum>7411.</enum><header>Report on efforts to capture and detain United States citizens as hostages</header> <subsection commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H1EEFDDC131184950889E61DC2865E366"><enum>(a)</enum><header display-inline="yes-display-inline">Definition of appropriate committees of Congress</header><text>In this section, the term <term>appropriate committees of Congress</term> means—</text>

<subsection id="HBB8031094D444447A3AD1A46276D176C"><enum>(c)</enum><header>Elements</header><text>The report required by subsection (b) shall include, regarding the arrest, capture, detainment, or imprisonment of United States citizens and lawful permanent residents, the following:</text> <paragraph id="H29DE507886474851A45EA86E137B0B99"><enum>(1)</enum><text>The names, positions, and institutional affiliation of Venezuelan individuals, or those acting on their behalf, who have engaged in such activities.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF7DC6717770149398C9D5E0C37CAFAB4"><enum>(2)</enum><text>A description of any role played by transnational criminal organizations, and an identification of such organizations.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H9908674819274448849A8111B0AB1D7A"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Where relevant, an assessment of whether and how United States citizens and lawful permanent residents have been lured to Venezuela.</text></paragraph>

<subsection id="HD1BDA747EDB94F19B0547FC2C8A97A29" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(d)</enum><header>Form</header><text>The report required by subsection (b) shall be submitted in unclassified form, but may include a classified annex.</text></subsection></section> <section id="H5C0E30A145A0438F973C38067B399909" section-type="subsequent-section" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>7412.</enum><header>Intelligence assessments regarding Haiti</header> <subsection id="HD1AAEA86B9BD47F9B4E8DD945FC88E7A" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Intelligence community assessment</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline"> The Director of National Intelligence, acting through the National Intelligence Council, shall produce an intelligence community assessment regarding Haiti. Such assessment shall include each of the following:</text> 
<paragraph id="HACE1091C1C254797A1BE5F688C554C80" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><text>An analysis of the security, political, and economic situation in Haiti, and its effect on—</text> <subparagraph id="H196F15F43D754ED18E2DFEC8D6BCB9C7" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(A)</enum><text>the people of Haiti;</text></subparagraph> 
<subparagraph id="H0618D90814C8456DA65B5742116BC22C" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(B)</enum><text>other countries in the Caribbean region; and</text></subparagraph> <subparagraph id="H131ADB1E16F54A2DAFDD70244DD74C58" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(C)</enum><text>the United States, including Puerto Rico and the United States Virgin Islands, as a result of increased out-migration from Haiti to the United States, the increased use of Haiti as a transshipment point for illicit drugs destined for the United States, or any other relevant factor or trend.</text></subparagraph></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HE1813FBB1EB541BBB0E4BE131B4ED8A7" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><text>A description of opportunities available to improve or stabilize the security, political, and economic situation in Haiti.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="HF8C702A97AA94474BBA75592305AC289" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><text>An identification of specific events or actions in Haiti that, were they to occur individually or in combination, would serve as signposts indicating the further deterioration or collapse of the security, political, and economic situation in Haiti. </text></paragraph></subsection> 
<subsection id="HB84BBA1A2219401B81FDAC8592DD80C0" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Intelligence assessment</header><text>The Director of National Intelligence shall produce an intelligence assessment based on a review of the intelligence products pertaining to Haiti that were written by elements of the intelligence community and provided to policymakers during the period of time beginning on January 1, 2021, and ending on July 7, 2021. Such assessment shall include each of the following:</text> <paragraph id="H928DCF0A895B4D2DAD4E88252B49B16D" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(1)</enum><text>An analysis of whether, during the time period covered by the assessment, the intelligence community provided policymakers with adequate indications and warning of the assassination of Haitian President Jovenal Moise on July 7, 2021.</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="H19769E21DCD4428DA9E4F8B665C00861" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(2)</enum><text>An analysis of whether, during such time period, the intelligence community provided policymakers with useful and unique insights, derived from both covertly collected and open-source intelligence, that policymakers would not otherwise have been able to obtain from sources outside of the intelligence community.</text></paragraph> <paragraph id="H905C9D5D2C9E47A1BFC3945FCE6D6898" commented="no" changed="not-changed"><enum>(3)</enum><text>Based on the analyses conducted under paragraphs (1) and (2), any recommendations to improve indications and warning or to otherwise enhance the utility for policymakers of intelligence products that the intelligence community prepares on Haiti, specifically, or on other countries characterized by chronic insecurity, instability, and poverty. </text></paragraph></subsection>

<section commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline" id="H6BD50C66EED4431F87E0746AC214FB92"><enum>7413.</enum><header>Monitoring Iranian enrichment of uranium-235</header> 
<subsection id="H3405CFCA9E604F36B92596F1EAB2E81A"><enum>(a)</enum><header>Significant enrichment activity defined</header><text>In this section, the term <term>significant enrichment activity</term> means—</text> <paragraph id="HA426A13F9A5C46078133AABD37862659"><enum>(1)</enum><text>any enrichment of any amount of uranium-235 to a purity percentage that is 5 percent higher than the purity percentage indicated in the prior submission to Congress under subsection (b)(1); or</text></paragraph> 
<paragraph id="HF62F5ABE2B994E62A282675D40A87B98"><enum>(2)</enum><text>any enrichment of uranium-235 in a quantity exceeding 10 kilograms.</text></paragraph></subsection> <subsection id="H41F3F2239C7148DB8E81687E7A8FE84F"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Submission to Congress</header> <paragraph id="HAD470FA0886A4DA69D276C4F16BB759A"><enum>(1)</enum><header>In general</header><text>Not later than 48 hours after the Director of National Intelligence assesses that the Islamic Republic of Iran has produced or possesses any amount of uranium-235 enriched to greater than 60 percent purity or has engaged in significant enrichment activity, the Director shall submit to Congress such assessment, consistent with the protection of intelligence sources and methods.</text></paragraph>
